chapters.title: Chapter 2830 The Existential Dungeon Apocalypse! II
paragraphs: 2830 The Existential Dungeon Apocalypse! II
Elodie's face was filled with seriousness as she felt the vibrant Concepts of the Extremity of Quintessence coursing through the large Raid Boss in the distance as she took it very seriously.

She knew that in this new landscape, she had to quickly claim position and power if she wished to climb through the ranks and fully utilize the Existential Extremity Authorities enacted by the Extremity of Quintessence.
A great chance and opportunity lay here.

Something beside Vacuous and Vitalis...and she had joined its camp as she didn't just need to hold a high position within these lands, she also had to make sure the bid to overturn Vacuous and Vitalis would succeed!
It was a daunting task when she thought of going against the Ones Above Extremity, but someone had to.
She may as well make the stand.
[Let's go!]
BOOM!
A heavy and ecstatic battle began.
In another Record.
Within a Record of the Golden Difficulty.
Shattered clocks the size of cosmoswere stretched out in a stellar domain as purple rivers of time flowed chaotically all around.

In the flat surface of one Titanic purple clock, a few thousand Entities at the First and Second Gradations of Extremity were clustered as they stared ahead at a shrouded force of thousands of Enders of Extremity!
At the lead of this party of 9,999 was none other than Lilith.

Even though she didn't have any strong connections, there were many others like her in these new lands as her Queue had filled up rapidly, and she waited for the maximum number of participants to fill up before she entered the Golden Difficulty of the Existential Raid Rift!
There were many foreign Entities that she didn't know all around her, and above her figure- the banner of the party leader shone brightly as she radiated a commanding air.
She was a Dimensional Hellion Ruler in the past.
She had led vast armies and commanded powerful entities of her time.
The air of a commander never left her as she looked at her forces and tried to do what every commander did- pick out the talents and who would be of greatest use in battle.

Her Extremity of Hatred selected multiple people in her line of sight as her eyes squinted when not too far behind her left side, she saw an exceedingly beautiful young woman with a crimson gold horn on her forehead and a fiery gold Armament.
The power she emanated was unique as she even held a sense of fanaticism when she looked around her!
[You are?]
Her words reached the young woman and shook her out of her focus as she replied calmly.
[Ayame, of the Infinite Extre-]
Ayame cut herself off and didn't finish her words.
She was no longer Ayame of the Infinite Extremity.
As she felt the traces of genuine Infinity flowing through her, she fully affirmed her new path and belonging as she utterly firmly.
[Just Ayame.]
WAA!
She could read records intricately as when she saw the rewards of the Existential Raid Rift laid out, she knew that the contribution and effort that a being out would be reflected in its rewards!

If she remained anchored into the Third and Fourth Gradation Extremities of the past Infinite Extremity that had arrived in these new lands with her, she would simply be riding their coattails and not obtain genuine power and rewards herself.
So she expanded her breadth and joined a random Queue of the Golden Difficulty.
And now, here she was.
She gazed at the Party Leader named Lilith and nodded towards her as before their eyes, a prompt rose.

[Prove your concepts of Extremity and take down the GoldenRaid Boss- Devilish Time Unveiler. Failure to do so will result in a complete wipe out and restriction of using the Existential Raid Rift for 12 hours.]
HUUM!
The shrouded Legions became clear thousands of massive Enders of Extremity were revealed.

They ranged from pristine Dragons, White Tigers, and Phoenixes at the First and Second Gradations of Extremity, with the Raid Boss of this Record being a Titanic entity who was in the form of an emaciated skeleton andadorned in a purple robe radiating the vicissitudes of time as his aged face showed shrewdness and might!
His hands grasped a buzzing Armament of Extremity in the form of a purple and golden dagger- reminiscent of the Dagger of Time that Noah fought the Devilish Time Unveiler for in the past.
Rune Scriptures of Time, Chronos, and Continuity flowed around the massive body of the Devilish Time Unveiler as he grasped the Dagger of Time and smiled with longing, his voice echoing out grandly.
[Stop.]
The same word he heard the Extremity of Quintessence utter before his records came to a complete halt what seemed like ages ago.
He uttered it once more as a purple gold light erupted out- reality being brought to a halt in this whole Domain as the the Challengers would have to struggle to even move in an area of stopped time!
In the distance, the gaze of the Daughter of Hatred was cold as the air of a commander radiated around her.
[On me!]
WAA!
In this Record as well, a hectic battle began with a bang.
It was now the 999th millisecond after Noah stretched out his records towards Infinity.
[The Quintessential Annals of Extremity have reached a profound Culmination and successfully forged into Existence.]
[An Achievement that can only be termed Quintessential!]
[Within a Second of Infinity, you have made achievements others could not make for eons.]
[The Existential Extremity Authority of Infinity has been greatly elevated.]
[The Existential Extremity Authority of Quintessence has been greatly elevated.]
[The Existential Extremity Authority of Tyranny has been greatly elevated.]
An array of prompts cascaded over Noah's eyes as within a second, he underwent so many shocking changes that other beings could not even imagine!

[The Authority of Existential Dungeon Apocalypse supported by three Existential Extremity Authorities and other concepts of Quintessential designation has fully come to fruition with limitations and rulings that allow for the possibility of a truly Quintessential future.]
[The effects of the 17th Boundary Layer of Infinity have come to an end.]
1,000 Milliseconds...had passed since Noah had stretched his Records towards Infinity!

chapters.title: Chapter 2831 The Existential Dungeon Apocalypse! III
paragraphs: 2831 The Existential Dungeon Apocalypse! III
The effects of the 17th Boundary Layer of Infinity came to an end.
It was a layer that enacted something which brought about heavy consequences and sets of choices for a period of 1 second!

And in that passage of 1,000 Millisecond, Reality had so drastically changed that Noah went from being a resident of the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains to being cleansed out of it, attaining Extremity, separating the Infinite Hyperversal Haven from the Records of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity as due to the Quintessential Annals of Extremity...it now sat in a state of existence and nonexistence!
Too many things had happened in this one second.
But even with all of this...Noah was just getting started.

[Over 50% of all operational costs of the Existential Extremity Authorities of Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny will have to be directed towards the feature of Existential Dungeon Apocalypse to allow what it seeks to be actualized in reality.]

[The feature of Existential Dungeon Apocalypse seeks to cause the emergence of Existential Dungeons in the Domains of other Existential Hyperversal Domains. At the time of emergence and thereafter, an Absolute Existential Authority and Limitation will be enacted.]

[The First Absolute Existential Authority and Limitation is that the Native Existential Hyperversal Authority and Invading Existential Hyperversal Authority will have no effect on the emerging Existential Dungeon.]

[The Second Absolute Existential Authority and Limitation is that the Primogenitors/Controllers/Originators/Influencers of the Native Existential Hyperversal Authority and the Primogenitors/Controllers/Originators/Influencers of the Invading Existential Hyperversal Authority will not be capable of entering the Existential Dungeons.]

[The Third Absolute Existential Authority and Limitation is that only the Inhabitants of the Native Existential Hyperversal Domains and Invading Existential Hyperversal Domains can fight for hegemony and dominion of an Existential Dungeon.]

[Once an Existential Dungeon emerges, it will devour and assimilate the surrounding Authorities, Existences, and Reality. If the Native Existential Hyperversal Domains wish to stop this process, their inhabitants will have to enter the Existential Dungeon and eliminate all Entities within that contain a Signature of the Existential Dungeon.]

[After a sufficient time passes without all Invading Entities within the Existential Dungeon are destroyed, a Dungeon Break will occur and release an explosion of authority that devours all Records of Existence of a hundredth of the Invaded Existential Hyperversal Domain.]
A heavy set of rules and limitations.
But it was the only way Noah and the concepts supporting him could see to achieve a realistic and achievable purpose of the Existential Dungeon Apocalypse.

The first point was to make it so that after its emergence, Noah's Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny could not have any effect on the Existential Dungeons, and this same limitation was applied to the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities as no dazzling Scripture or thundering light would be capable of destroying a recently appearing Existential Dungeon!
This...was Noah and the Infinite Hyperversal Haven delving into one of the true usaages of Existential Extremity Authorities.
Absolute Existential Authorities.
Absolute Existential Limitations.
For one to have an astounding authority, they could place upon themselves an equally astounding limitation!

For the Absolute Existential Authorities and Limitations that should make the feature of Existential Dungeon Apocalypse possible, this was why over 50% of all operational costs of Noah's Existential Extremity Authorities were required.
But what it could achieve was something stupendous!

Noah himself as the Originator of his Existential Extremity Authorities would not be able to descend within an Existential Dungeon, and nor would any of the Originators or Controllers of the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities.
So...who would fight on Noah's behalf? And who would fight on the behalf of the Ones Above Extremity?
The amount of power both sides could unleash would be dependent on just how strong the Existential Extremity Authorities of their domains were- and how powerful the Inhabitants within would be!
This...was Noah's design.
This was his construct.
Soon enough, he would have to see just how it would unfold when it was applied and laid out in reality!
But before that, he had many things he needed to do to prepare.
One was to wait for the Inhabitants of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven to acclimate and grow much stronger through the Existential Raid Rifts, and the other was Noah himself.
Understanding and quantifying the current state of his body, origin, and soul.
Rising as high as he could across the Gradations of Extremity and continuing to elevate Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny.
And of course...the convergence of his Concepts that had now reached Extremity into profound Dynamis of Extremity.
What would Indefatigable be after the influence of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority was removed?
Where would Lotra, Thanatos, or Oraculum now be at?!

All of these things were under his consideration as at this moment in time, a second after he had stretched out his records towards Infinity...he gazed out at the vast Infinite Hyperversal Haven around him.
Its current Aletheian Havens that were elevating in grandeur and majesty even now.
The buzzing Extremity Vein causing all Havens to rotate as if they were mere constellations.
The Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portals of Infinity.
The massive Existential Raid Rift!
All of these things were his accomplishments as he was truly just getting started!
As his gaze passed over everything, his eyes twinkled as he came upon the figures of Barbatos, Adelaide, and a few others who were nearing the light of the massive Existential Raid Rift.

When it came to the progress and workings of this construct that would eel ste his Existential Extremity Authorities, Noah knew the Infinite Hyperversal Haven was more than enough as through their connection, he already knew of every single happening within it.
The loss his son and some of his closest Vassals faced.
The past members of the Seven Clans and Major Inheritances as they acclimated to this new reality.
And now...there were beings like Barbatos, Adelaide, and Athena.
Those affected by the Extremity of Harems as their power was greatly inflated to be a portion of Noah's!
With all of this power...what exactly would they be able to achieve?

chapters.title: Chapter 2832 The Existential Dungeon Apocalypse! IV
paragraphs: 2832 The Existential Dungeon Apocalypse! IV
In the rims of the light of the Existential Raid Rift.
The figure of Barbatos was pulling Adelaide along, the Frozen Queen sighing as the Necromancer of Chaos wasn't taking no for an answer.
[Sis Adelaide, we may not be able to do it if you don't come as well. And isn't it fun to play with reality shaking power every now and then? Since we have it now, we can't just sit idle.]
Barbatos' gorgeously small but blessed figure spoke with strength as for this occasion, she made sure to have even the Frozen Queen who didn't care much about power participate!
She was adorned in a dazzling black dress while Adelaide had a snowy blue relic wrapped around her, their figures followed by Katelyn, Athena, Xiaomi, Eowyn, Tiamat, Anna, Halcyon, and Valentina.
They were the Entity who were closest to the Extremity of Quintessence, and those chosen by the Extremity of Harems to exhibit 50% of his power!
At the words of Barbatos, Adelaide gave in with a smile while looking at the massive Raid Rift ahead of them, her red lips parting to reply.
[Since you collected all of us here, I can only think that you're about to do something crazy like choose the highest Difficulty?]
The Frozen Queen knew the women around her well as the moment her words finished, the figure of Barbatos patted her blessed chest with pride.
[Isn't it going to be fun? It feels like we're given a huge cheat compared to others as if we successfully clear it, all names below Little Fish will be ours.]
Tempting words left her mouth as the women behind him turned contemplative, with Eowyn rising her brows as her sandy gold hair flowed with majesty.
[And if we fail in the highest Difficulty?]
A valid question was asked.
And the figure of Barbatos harrumphed as she replied while communicating with the light of the Existential Raid Rift.
[Hmph, you think Little Fish would actually allow it for us to die? Even if it's facing a False Death...hmph, if he allows it, he won't be getting any from me for at least...12 hours!]
Barbatos spoke strongly as she clenched her fist with determination.
She turned around to the women behind her who were rolling their eyes as she continued.
[That goes for you all too...if Little Fish somehow allows for us to be killed, hold out for at least half a day!]
The Necromancer of Chaos made her position be known as...
[Let's just enter and see what we're facing, Sis Barbatos.]
The War Princess, Athena, spoke out with blinding battle intent as she wanted to see.
Just how tremendous was the power of the man they relied on?
She wanted to know.
Around her and all others, 9 Illusory wheels of light circled them as her body felt like it was coursing with endless power.
She always aspired to understand the depth of power of the man she had given her heart to as now...she wanted to let loose!
Barbatos smiled gleefully at her reply as after ascertaining the gazes of all others, she made her selection as their figures became wrapped in a grand purple light of tyranny!
[The Tyrannical Difficulty of the Existential Raid Rift has been chosen.]
HUUM!
This booming prompt echoed out across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as the wills of many Entities or their Extremity Clones that had not entered the Existential Raid Rift gazed upwards.

Around this same time, the figure of Henry, Kazuhiko, Emperor Penguin, and others who had faced defeat in the Obsidian Difficulty were thrown out of the Rift with dazed looks, their defeat eyes also rising and seeing the massive prompt changing to form an illusory screen as massive as the Existential Raid Rift below it!
On this screen, fiery crimson red light flashed as a scene was shown within for all others to witness.
Atop a massive crimson infinity symbol the size of a Large World, the figures of Barbatos, Adelaide, Athena, Eowyn, Xiaomi, Katelyn, Elena, Tiamat, Anna, Halcyon, and Valentina appeared.

Around them, different colored dignity Symbols of the same size and stature floated grandly as they looked like stellar bodies in a starry space, and far, far ahead of them, on top of an even bigger royal purple Infinity symbol...there was the visage of a woman adorned in a crimson and gold battle Armament that gave off a feel of an oppressive Middle Grade Armament of Extremity!
But if one were to look closer, it wasn't that what she wore was giving off the pressure of such an Armament, but it was her whole body that was emanating such a feeling.
She was the Entity who had been within a core area of the Extremity of Quintessence while he underwent his transformations.
The Relic that began all of this was she was just a Ruination Core.
The Extremity of Ruination.
The Existential Sword of Quintessence.
The Zenith Quintessential Middle Grade Armament of Extremity.
The Raid Boss of the Tyrannical Difficulty of the Existential Raid Rift- Ruination!
Her gaze was cold as she looked at the distant Infinity symbol that four women stood on.
There were no Enders of Extremity around her as in this domain, she was a lone Boss.

In the distance, the figures of Barbatos and others had their gazes change as they felt an overwhelming sense of pressure pressing down onto their existence, all of them recognizing the distant figure of Ruination as Noah's weapon as at this moment...her gaze became interlocked with all of theirs!
The Existential Sword of Quintessence looked at the Harem of the Extremity of Quintessence, her lips opening with calmness and serenity as she uttered out.
[Are you worthy?]
HUUM!
Three words.
A simple question.
But it was one that boomed in the souls of the Harem of the Extremity of Quintessence as they heard many different things from these words.
Are you worthy of his grace?
Are you worthy of being beside him?
Are you worthy to stand on the precipice of power in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven?!
These were the words they heard in their hearts as collectively, all of their eyes turned fiery!

At such words, Adelaide floated to the forefront as her blue eyes burned with determination, Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures beginning to swirl around her as...the Extremity of Plot was activated.
[I was always worthy!]
BOOM!
Ecstatic power emerged an instant later as a blue light flashed, glaciers erupting in front of her along with a storm of snow and ice that carried destructive Extremity Rune Scriptures forward!

[Since you collected all of us here, I can only think that you're about to do something crazy like choose the highest Difficulty?]
The Frozen Queen knew the women around her well as the moment her words finished, the figure of Barbatos patted her blessed chest with pride.
[Isn't it going to be fun?
It feels like we're given a huge cheat compared to others as if we successfully clear it, all names below Little Fish will be ours.]
Tempting words left her mouth as the women behind him turned contemplative, with Eowyn rising her brows as her sandy gold hair flowed with majesty.
[And if we fail in the highest Difficulty?]
A valid question was asked.
And the figure of Barbatos harrumphed as she replied while communicating with the light of the Existential Raid Rift.
[Hmph, you think Little Fish would actually allow it for us to die?
Even if it's facing a False Death...hmph, if he allows it, he won't be getting any from me for at least...12 hours!]
Barbatos spoke strongly as she clenched her fist with determination.
She turned around to the women behind her who were rolling their eyes as she continued.
[That goes for you all too...if Little Fish somehow allows for us to be killed, hold out for at least half a day!]
The Necromancer of Chaos made her position be known as...
[Let's just enter and see what we're facing, Sis Barbatos.]
The War Princess, Athena, spoke out with blinding battle intent as she wanted to see.
Just how tremendous was the power of the man they relied on?
She wanted to know.
Around her and all others, 9 Illusory wheels of light circled them as her body felt like it was coursing with endless power.
She always aspired to understand the depth of power of the man she had given her heart to as now...she wanted to let loose!
Barbatos smiled gleefully at her reply as after ascertaining the gazes of all others, she made her selection as their figures became wrapped in a grand purple light of tyranny!
[The Tyrannical Difficulty of the Existential Raid Rift has been chosen.]
HUUM!
This booming prompt echoed out across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as the wills of many Entities or their Extremity Clones that had not entered the Existential Raid Rift gazed upwards.

Around this same time, the figure of Henry, Kazuhiko, Emperor Penguin, and others who had faced defeat in the Obsidian Difficulty were thrown out of the Rift with dazed looks, their defeat eyes also rising and seeing the massive prompt changing to form an illusory screen as massive as the Existential Raid Rift below it!
On this screen, fiery crimson red light flashed as a scene was shown within for all others to witness.
Atop a massive crimson infinity symbol the size of a Large World, the figures of Barbatos, Adelaide, Athena, Eowyn, Xiaomi, Katelyn, Elena, Tiamat, Anna, Halcyon, and Valentina appeared.

Around them, different colored dignity Symbols of the same size and stature floated grandly as they looked like stellar bodies in a starry space, and far, far ahead of them, on top of an even bigger royal purple Infinity symbol...there was the visage of a woman adorned in a crimson and gold battle Armament that gave off a feel of an oppressive Middle Grade Armament of Extremity!
But if one were to look closer, it wasn't that what she wore was giving off the pressure of such an Armament, but it was her whole body that was emanating such a feeling.
She was the Entity who had been within a core area of the Extremity of Quintessence while he underwent his transformations.
The Relic that began all of this was she was just a Ruination Core.
The Extremity of Ruination.
The Existential Sword of Quintessence.
The Zenith Quintessential Middle Grade Armament of Extremity.
The Raid Boss of the Tyrannical Difficulty of the Existential Raid Rift- Ruination!
Her gaze was cold as she looked at the distant Infinity symbol that four women stood on.
There were no Enders of Extremity around her as in this domain, she was a lone Boss.

In the distance, the figures of Barbatos and others had their gazes change as they felt an overwhelming sense of pressure pressing down onto their existence, all of them recognizing the distant figure of Ruination as Noah's weapon as at this moment...her gaze became interlocked with all of theirs!
The Existential Sword of Quintessence looked at the Harem of the Extremity of Quintessence, her lips opening with calmness and serenity as she uttered out.
[Are you worthy?]
HUUM!
Three words.
A simple question.
But it was one that boomed in the souls of the Harem of the Extremity of Quintessence as they heard many different things from these words.
Are you worthy of his grace?
Are you worthy of being beside him?
Are you worthy to stand on the precipice of power in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven?!
These were the words they heard in their hearts as collectively, all of their eyes turned fiery!

At such words, Adelaide floated to the forefront as her blue eyes burned with determination, Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures beginning to swirl around her as...the Extremity of Plot was activated.
[I was always worthy!]
BOOM!
Ecstatic power emerged an instant later as a blue light flashed, glaciers erupting in front of her along with a storm of snow and ice that carried destructive Extremity Rune Scriptures forward!

chapters.title: Chapter 2833 The Tyrannical Difficulty!
paragraphs: She was always worthy.
Adelaide stated these words powerfully as in the frozen lands of her home, Noah discovered the Spiritual Lands.
This was where everything began.
She had been with him side by side as she didn't wish for any honor or power- just eons of happiness and companionship!
Was she worthy?
She was always worthy!
BOOM!

With her bidding, Cerulean Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures flourished and caused glaciers of unfathomable proportions to form and proliferate outwards- turning into malleable waves of cold light that barreled to surge and overwhelm the lone figure of Ruination.
A figure that gazed at the incoming surge of power calmly as her hand pointed out, and her finger...tapped.
Thousands of Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures flashed as a crimson light of Ruination bloomed.

The incoming glaciers of frozen might were stopped in their place before they soon began to shatter, destructive might washing over them as everything that Adelaide had thrown out was negated right away!
{You may be worthy...but you know nothing of hardship. Nothing of the power you hold in your hands.}
HUUM!

The voice of Ruination was cold as she snapped her fingers thereafter, her body beginning to course with Existential Extremity Authorities as all around her...dozens of massive illusory Armaments of Extremity began to appear.
They continued to proliferate until they reached a full one hundred.
And each one...emanated a genuine aura of a Middle Grade Armament of Extremity!
Massive Swords, Hammers, Scythes, Flails, Spears, Bows, Shields, Bats, and Rifles radiated their own light of power as a single feature of Ruination was activated.
A feature that was simply known as {Existential Armament Armory}!

Moving autonomously, the 100 Illusory Middle Grade Armaments of Extremity pulsed and shot out from the infinity symbol Ruination stood on- surging towards their targets who were spurred by the words and actions of Ruination!

Barbatos bellowed out with blazing eyes as the space behind her split to release the blazing auras of 3 Titanic Undead that each emanated auras at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity, with a bony throne forming behind her as Necromancy was unveiled with grandeur!
Eowyn breathed out as a sandy gold light of dreams covered her, chains of dreams blooming with her at the center and striking out!
Athena grasped the spear in her hands as the War Princess felt the many authorities flowing in her and called out to a single one.
{The spear in my hands...has always been a Middle Grade Armament of Extremity.}
The Extremity of Plot was activated.

A blaring illusory light of a Middle Grade Armament of Extremity emerged from the spear in the hands of the War Princess as she grasped it tightly before shooting out towards the descending Legion of Armaments!

The visage of Katelyn was calm as the light of endless mirrors was reflected in her glazed pupils. Her calculating eyes flashed as her body buzzed with the Extremity of Plagiarism, shocking words leaving her mouth.
{Why is my weapon over there?}
WAA!
Reality bent and distorted.
A moment later, an illusory Middle Grade Armament of Extremity in the form of a Sniper Rifle appeared in front of her and altered its size.

She grasped it naturally as if it was always hers, her pupil lining up with the scope as she pulled the trigger and caused a bean of Extremity Rune Scriptures to shoot out like a cosmic cannon of light!
Each woman tried to familiarize themselves with the unique power flowing through them and utilize it to bring about an ecstatic result.
{The Extremity of Harem watches with reserved expectations!}
Above all of this shocking reality playing out, a concept watched what was unfolding as a great battle that would showcase the power of terrifying Concepts of Extremity bloomed.
It was being broadcasted above the massive cerulean Existential Raid Rift as many eyes were drawn to it- power they hadn't yet thought possible being unveiled before them!
In another part of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

A golden construct with archways and pillars lining it could be seen floating serenely, rivers of Quintessence, Tyranny, and Infinity flowing around it and surging every now and then as within the depths of the many tall golden pillars supporting this construct...astounding things were occuring!

The figure of a beautiful middle aged woman could be seen within as she stood in front of multicolored cauldrons by the dozens- cauldrons that were systematically drawing in their own unique authorities. This figure was none other than the Quintessential Dowager as she oversaw the progression of the Alchemy Hall and its current task of producing Planalith Krystallos.
Refined and extremely pure versione of compressed Extremity Authority that when devoured...it could aid one in the progression of the Gradations of Extremity!
Amelia Osmont smiled as she came in front of one cauldron that radiated golden colored light, her hands waving forth and causing the lid of the cauldron to fly out as from within...
9 golden pills of light spotless arose as they emanated profound waves of Providence.
She blinked with a sense of awe as one of them fell in her hands.

{9 Low Grade Providence Planalith Krystallos...are you sure this is fair to others? How does the production of Planalith Krystallos actually go for those within the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains?}
Her focus was serene and calm as she asked, and in the next moment, a respectful voice of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven cascaded down from above as there was a reply.

{From Records glimpsed before, Entities at the Fifth or Sixth Gradation are the ones who gain enough capability to begin undergoing Planalith Krystallos Refinement. Tremendous concentration is required along with the subtle refinement as it can fail at any time.}
Amelia Osmont heard this as she couldn't help but smile.
She looked at the hundreds of dazzling cauldrons within the Alchemy Hall as she shook her head with a smile.

{And yet my son has you capable of forging the Planalith Krystallos of dozens of Extremity Authorities all at once...with 9 Low Grade Planalith Krystallos being produced on the low end as for some...}
HUUM!

She waved her hands towards a nearby cauldron that was radiating a particularly profound royal purple light, its lid flying off as from within...three dazzling iridescent amethyst Middle Grade Tyranny Planalith Krystallos bloomed!

chapters.title: Chapter 2834 Love that cannot be repaid!
paragraphs: The Quintessential Dowager gazed at the three dazzling royal purple colored Middle Grade Tyranny Planalith Krystallos as her eyes were filled with a sense of brilliance.
{The best possibility is even something as great as this...}
Low Grade Planalith Krystallos could be forged en masse.
When she saw such a scene and was also exposed to Records of how other Entities had to Refine things like this, Amelia Osmont couldn't help but feel her heart overflowing with pride.
The one who made all of this responsible was none other than her son.
She gazed at the many dazzling Cauldrons constantly drawing in authority as she asked to the open space around her.
{Do you think he knows? How proud I am of him?}
The Quintessential Dowager said such words as her eyes were full of contentment for how far her son had come!
Yet her words were so striking that even the Infinite Hyperversal Haven didn't reply right away, its voice only coming out milliseconds later.
{I'm sure he knows, but it would not hurt to tell him.}
The pride of a mother seeing their child do so exceedingly well.
The impossible mission of a son to pay back all the grace from their parents for raising them!

Amelia Osmont had toiled for months while the Extremity of Quintessence was in her belly. She went through the difficulty of childbirth with the technology of their time as after that, she raised him from a little baby that couldn't even protect itself.

The late nights of picking up night shifts to support her family, hoping that his father would not be drunk enough to not even be capable of looking after him while she was at work- just until she came back.
When she did come back from her shifts as the sun rose, the yelling she had to endure as her husband told her how Noah's crying had kept him up all night!

How she had to feed him, change him, and cover his ears to not hear the yelling and arguments constantly occurring around him- making sure to always show a smile on her face even as tears trickled down her face.
She had to show her son a trace of happiness even if there wasn't any.
This was a mother's love- and it could never be repaid!
Amelia Osmont shook her head as the memories of her past faded in the back of her mind.
Her son had come far. But she was still his mother. So she replied to the advice of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
{I'll be sure to tell him then.}
A moment after, she waved her hands towards the two empty cauldrons and spoke out.
{Let's have Quintessence and Infinity...}

The cauldrons buzzed with power as wisps of Colorless and Cerulean light began to flow into them, their lids closing as another round of Planalith Krystallos Refinement began in these vibrant constructs!
Behind the dazzling figure of the Quintessential Dowager, a mountain of Planalith Krystallos was already beginning to form as by the time that Ruination multiplied them...oh!
Utter brilliance was occuring in this space, and this was only the Alchemy Hall.
In an entirely separate space, the Blacksmith's Forge shone with an even more astounding radiance as Low Grade and Middle Grade Armaments of Extremity were designed and forged quintessentially!
All of this happened in the background.
All of this occurred and came to fruition because of a single being.
And currently, this being sought to attain even greater heights of power as the further he went, the grander all authorities within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven became!
So at this moment in time.
The will of the Extremity of Quintessence buzzed as its vision shifted to the murky waters of the Gradations of Extremity.
Currently, he withstood a heavy pressure and might at the very Zenith of the murky layer of the Fourth Gradation of Extremity.
The absence of any changes within these murky waters told Noah many things as he looked around.

He had established the Quintessential Annals of Extremity, broken off from Vitalis and Vacuous, and had the whole Infinite Hyperversal Haven in a state of existence and nonexistence...and yet no changes had occured within the murky waters of the Gradations of Extremity!
As if Noah's Quintessential Annals, Vitalis and Vacuous Annals...as if none of these affected the Gradations of Extremity!

The only change Noah had seen so far was what had already occured since he attained Existential Extremity Authorities- the fact that he didn't have the overabundance of chains holding him down and making his progress across the Gradations so extremely slow.

It may mean that if there were any Primogenitors or Controllers of other Existential Extremity Authorities...they may be capable of the same versatility and movement across the Gradations of Extremity as Noah!

This thought also caused him to be even more careful as all this time, he was able to gaze at trillions of others from the First Gradation of Extremity until now, but what if in these murky waters...he met another Entity who could freely move and be cognizant like him?
What if he came across the Ones Above Extremity in these murky waters of the Gradations of Extremity?!

The thought caused his will to spread it all around him as the dazzling colors of light around his body retreated, his Colorless Hyperversal Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures pulsing with authority as around his body, illusory chains appeared all around him.

From illusory, they gradually became real as if he was chained in these murky waters of Gradations of Extremity like all others, and he then gazed at the demarcation of the Fourth and Fifth Gradations of Extremity as....
{The Extremity of Cultivation proceeds forward without issues.}
{The Extremity of Ascendancy seeks even more transformations!}
His existence had grown enough and been refined enough by the pressure in the surroundings to the extent it now felt weak to him, and his body warped as a moment later...
HUUM!
He disappeared without any fluctuations and reappeared above within the entry of the murky waters of the Fifth Gradation of Extremity.
Ever clearer.
Slightly less murky.

His surroundings didn't buzz as everything was concealed, but waves of authority and pressure were surging into him from all around as his existence refined it, his Extremity Rune Scriptures increased by the thousands, and his soul ascended ever higher!
This time, he wanted to see just how far his Extremity Authorities could take him.
He wanted to see what Gradation he would manage to reach with the terrifying concepts he held!

chapters.title: Chapter 2835 Quintessential Ascension! I
paragraphs: The waters of the Fifth Gradation of Extremity.
They were filled with much more clarity as if the further up one went, the clearer it would become.
At the lowest rungs, Noah's powerful will could see the figures of Entities around him still.
They were sparse and spread out, but they were there!
Around their bodies, there were significantly fewer chains compared to those below them in the Gradations of Extremity, and yet...they were still bound by chains.
Their expressions were stern with their eyes closed as if they sought to understand more about Extremity, with their bodies fluctuating as ever so slowly...they tried to inch upwards.
But their movement was abysmally slow.

As if they may just be inching upwards for all their lifetimes before the concepts supporting their souls waned and ever so slowly lost their extremes, their very existence beginning to break down in time.
Unless they could reach a higher level.
Unless they stayed true to the extremes of the concepts that took them here!
For Noah, it was entirely different.
His concepts burned brightly as they were backed by the might of three Existential Extremity Authorities.
And over 100 other concepts that had reached terrifying Extremes all surged within his existence as he...had no chains holding him down!
Within a few milliseconds, he acclimated to the tremendous pressure bearing down all around the early stages of the Fifth Gradation of Extremity.
His Existence acclimated and became strong enough to beat it.
And then....tens of thousands of his Colorless, Cerulean, and Amethyst Hyperversal Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures began to circle around his body.
For any others watching, they saw no fluctuations as they could only observe Noah's figure to have illusory chains like everyone else.
But Noah could see a vastly different sight as for him, everything was full of brilliance and colors as a moment later...he took a step.
HUUM!
His existence buzzed as he instantly disappeared from the early waters of the Fifth Gradation of Extremity and shockingly...his figure appeared at its middle point.
BOOM!

And the pressure of the waters around him were 10 times as heavier as before, but they only caused Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny to buzz as Noah still resisted it- Ascendancy pulsing and devouring the seething tendrils of the waters nearby into Noah's existence as once more, his existence underwent refinement and elevation!
His consciousness expanded wildly again as here, his will was drawn to a far distant location as there was a connection there.
When his eyes opened to the far distant location, he could see the chained figure of Extremity Solarium.
Her figure was bathed with a thin film of light as many Crimson Hyperversal Extremity Rune Scriptures swirled around her, and yet even she was proceeding forward slowly.
Noah only glanced in her direction as thereafter, he focused on the elevation of his own existence and the rapid production of Rune Scriptures of his concepts.
At this point, he reached 250,000 Rune Scriptures as thereafter, his body effortlessly acclimated to this middle region.
600 milliseconds had passed since he arrived here as thereafter, he took another step.
HUUM!

...And he once more covered great distances in a short period of time, his Quintessential Ascent only being stopped as the waters of the Gradations of Extremity became ever heavier and more intricate to pass!
But...he arrived at the furthest waters of the Fifth Gradation of Extremity.
Pressure barreled down from all around and threatened led to crush Noah, and yet his tens of thousands of Rune Scriptures swirling as his concepts withstood every single ounce of force!
{Your Existential Extremity Authorities forcefully withstood and crossed distances that took others years or eons to cross!}
{A Quintessential Achievement!}
He was cutting through everything with great force due to his concepts.

But as he went further, he came to realize that the waters of the Gradations of Extremity were truly not so simple as even though his concepts withstood the pressure, his swirling Extremity Rune creaked and shuddered as he approached the demarcation between the Fifth and the Sixth Gradation of Extremity!
Even though he was withstanding the pressure and making progress within milliseconds where others would take years, his Rune Scriptures still trembled at the immensity all around them!
{The Extremity of Cultivation seeks to better understand this conceptualization of the Gradations of Extremity.}
{The Extremity of Tyranny states why seek to understand when its rules can just be abolished and remade anew.}
{The Extremity of Infinity sees an endless path ahead that can be scaled and traversed.}
{The Extremity of Quintessence proceeds forward with caution.}
For others, it took years.
For the one who brought to fruition the Existential Extremity Authorities of Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny...
BOOOM!
{The line between the Fifth and Sixth Gradation of Extremity stands tall.}
{As profound and hard to scale this line is, since the Extremity of Cultivation has reached it...it has become a wall that can be scaled!}
He breathed steadily.
No wall could not be scaled...so long as he was capable of reaching it.
CRACK!
As tremendous night pressed on Noah all around, a fissure opened up on the line of demarcation right in front of him.
The moment this fissure appeared, Noah's concepts buzzed and began to emerge rapidly, their numbers increasing by tens of thousands as with a surge of brilliance...
SHAA!
Noah slid through the fissure and into an entirely new realm.
No murkiness could be seen
The waters were supremely clear as the chains crossing throughout were filled with a transparent light.
The Sixth Gradation of Extremity!

The moment Noah arrived, his gaze changed as he felt a great strain on his very existence, all of his concepts supporting him as from all around, heavy and thick transparent chains battled towards him!
It was the job of his concepts- of his Extremity Rune Scriptures to oppose these chains as d they swirled around him powerfully, expressing their shocking might as many of them were dead paths!
Powerful concepts of Extremity others couldn't even fathom.
Because of this, he had used brute force with them to go from the First Gradation of Extremity to the Sixth Gradation of Extremity within a few seconds!

chapters.title: Chapter 2836 Quintessential Ascension! II
paragraphs: He had used brute force to very quickly cross into the Sixth Gradation of Extremity- an achievement that even the Cimmerian Architect nor Extremity Solarium had made over the years as he...achieved it within seconds.
This was the obscene testament to his ridiculous Quintessential Zenith Concepts.
This was his shocking privilege and power as the Primogenitor of three Existential Extremity Authorities!
Which other Entity could say that as soon as they attained Extremity and stepped into the First Gradation of Extremity, they could ascend to the Sixth Gradation seconds later?!
Nobody could!
Nobody but the Extremity of Quintessence.

But the Sixth Gradation of Extremity...seemed to be inherently different as even though Noah felt an even more fearsome pressure descended as his concepts withstand it, the pressure still crashed through his Extremity Scripture and crushed into him like waves that began to cause injuries to his existence.
The shocking pressure acted as fuel, causing his Extremity Rune Scriptures to jump by the hundreds of thousands.
His Existential Extremity Authorities became even more refined and even more grandiose.
And yet he was also feeling his existence continuing to be injured!
{The Extremity of Quintessence shines illustriously and sees through all pretenses.}
{The Extremity of Cultivation nods at the assertions of Quintessence grimly.}

Noah's mind buzzed as he saw even as his Extremity Rune Scriptures exploded past 600,000 and rapidly continued upwards, their swirling around him withstood the pressure of this Gradation he had arrived into...but the waves always passed through the gaps of his Extremity Rune Scriptures and crashed into his existence- hounding him and threatening to push him down constantly.
Why was this?
HUUM!

His existence buzzed as he found that even though he was withstanding the pressure, because waves continued to drag through his Rune Scriptures and smash into his existence, he couldn't climb any higher.
Ever so slightly, he was even being pushed down as he only maintained his current position through the sheer power of his Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures!
In such a moment, his will spread out as he looked around this Gradation of Extremity.
Others may not be cognizant, but since he was...he could see and understand more.
And near him, he saw the visage of an old man.
His back was hunched as his face contained traces of age and vicissitude, with clear transparent chains entrenched into his existence and causing his progression to be so immensely slow.
And yet this being...stood stably in his position within the Sixth Gradation of Extremity.
As his Will that was in a unique state of existence saw this, his soul buzzed a moment later as he spoke out.
{I see.}

The reason why even though his concepts were powerful, the terrifying clear waters of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity still posed a tremendous challenge as they bypassed his Extremity Rune Scriptures and constantly smashed into his existence.
On the body of the hunched old man at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity...Noah could see that his Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures were not just swirling around his body.
They held...a flow.
Yes!
A flow!

And not just any flow, but his Extremity Rune Scriptures held a sense of interconnectedness as he eliminated many possible gaps that the crushing waves of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity could squeeze into, with only a few areas of his body still having gaps left behind as the clear waves entered through them and caused his figure to be stopped in place!
When Noah saw this scene, he instantly understood the intricacies of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity.
He looked at his own Extremity Rune Scriptures that were swirling around him haphazardly.
They felt no flow. No sequence.
They were powerful, yes. But they were each on their own.
Each one radiated a terrifying authority as each Rune Scripture held its own halo of light, none intermixing with each other as of course, this created many gaps.
Gaps that the terrifying pressure of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity crashed into and caused his body to remain in place.

He may have even been knocked down if it weren't for his Colorless Hyperversal Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures that due to the quality of Quintessence....they shared the same color and standing as their glow did not repel as much!

But for Noah to have his own flow of the hundreds of thousands of Extremity Rune Scriptures and close the gaps of authority due to them proudly standing in what their own extremes signifies...he had to converge them.

The myriad of different Concepts of Extremity has to achieve a profound convergence and resonance, their light no longer repelling each other as they would meld together seamlessly and birth a unique flow.
A convergence of multiple concepts that had escaped their own Extremes.
Something known as...a Dynamis of Extremity.
HUUM!
His existence pulsed gloriously as he instantly brought Quintessence forward.
Those who had already converged their concepts into Dynamis before they reached Extremity would have an easier time in doing so again since these concepts were already interlinked before.

Noah started with Quintessence as it held the Colorless light that had even affected all of his other concepts apart from Tyranny and Infinity, and it would be substantially easier to converge other concepts under this same light!
So his existence buzzed with understanding as he sought to withstand the crushing waves of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity by doing something all others had to do before or after they arrived here.
He had to bring together the flow of multiple extremes as for this, Noah began with Quintessence!
Its profound colorless light recalled all the concepts it had converged to before attaining Extremity as an instant after, its Colorless light pulled upon Providence.
And the tens of thousands of Extremity Rune Scriptures of Providence flowed from different parts of Noah's existence...and began to attach their Colorless light onto Quintessence!
A blinding light bloomed as a hue of gold ever so slowly emerged.
A few gaps were closed off as the moment Noah did this, he began to feel a shocking sense of power begin to rise.
After Providence, Destiny, Karma, Fate, and Fortune followed as a flow of golden light melded even more gaps- the new sensation Noah was feeling becoming even more pronounced as his Soul buzzed!
His soul buzzed as what it could see...was gradually changing.
It was as if a brand new reality was unfolding before him.
As if his vision was being altered to see something he couldn't see before!

chapters.title: Chapter 2837 What is Extremity? I
paragraphs: It was unique.
Noah's vision always saw more things than others, and this was elevated to a ridiculous level when he was capable of attaining the state of Quintessential Unity of Existence.
His Existential Extremity Authorities also quite literally allowed him to 'see' and be cognizant of the Gradations of Extremity!

Now, he came to the realization that from the First Gradation and through the Fifth Gradation of Extremity, one could barrel through them so long as they held enough quantity or quality of concepts of Extremity.
But when stepping into the Sixth Gradation of Extremity....this wasn't enough!
Just a swirling mess of Extremity Rune Scriptures was not enough as one had to make sure their Extremes...were intricately flowing across their existence.
So theoretically, someone like Noah who held over 100 Extremes in his body...would have an extremely difficult time to bring them all together.

And an Entity who only pursed a single concept to Extremity...may be able to attain a unique flow that didn't allow for any gaps around their existence! But would a single concept be strong enough to take them across the initial Gradations or even simply withstand the pressure of the Sixth Gradation? The answer was likely no.
Thus, entities pursued Extremity in multiple fields.
And they then sought to converge their extremes into Dynamis of Extremity!
Noah already had a skeleton of convergence of his concepts before they reached their Extremes as now...he only had to bring it all together.
His first convergence though, ended up involving an Existential concept as the very first one.

Who in the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains could say their Dynamis of Extremity held an Existential Concept of Extremity and multiple Quintessential Zenith Concepts alongside it? The answer was no one!
HUUM!
And this first convergence caused his vision to see something else as for the first time, Oraculum was truly coming to fruition.

After Quintessence began everything, Providence, Destiny, Karma, Fate, Fortune, Elysium, Wisdom, Dreams and multiple more Concepts of Extremity that had their Scriptures affected by the Colorless light of Quintessence all began to flow in together.
And the scene Noah saw...wasn't just the fact that above him, the gaps were becoming slowly covered as singular circles of Rune Scriptures began melding into each other.
He could see at the very center of the flow that had begun to form...the concepts themselves.
Extremity itself.
It seemed to be an ability of the forming Oraculum, but it caused his mind to enter a daze as if he was looking at his very own concepts for the first time!

It wasn't just that he could see them more clearly, but he saw that even though their Rune Scriptures were affected by Quintessence and made Colorless, at their core...each of his Concepts of Extremity held their own color.
Their own identity. Their own...emotion, desire, longing, weaving, and intent.
Weaving!
Intent!
What their extremes stood for and sought to do!
Noah saw that even though they were majorly affected by Quintessence, each concept of Extremity held its own profound longing and intent.

And once Noah fully realized the intent of the Concepts of Extremity, he shockingly found that he wasn't just able to see their current flow...but illusory golden pathways of where they were intending to go!

This scene caused his mind to buzz and illuminate as among the melding concepts entering under the umbrella of Oraculum, he came to focus on the concepts of the remaining 9 Decreta as he grasped onto their intent- their very sources entrenched in his soul...and he pulled them towards the flow Quintessence controlled as he altered their current pathway and flow to match the other concepts already converged into Oraculum.
And...
SHAA!
All remaining concepts relating to Decreta seamlessly joined the flow as over 25% of his body was now entirely covered by a Colorless light with absolutely no gaps.
His body stabilized in the Sixth Gradation of Extremity.

He saw the source of Ascendancy blare with a deeply hidden golden light as the clear waters of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity burned and turned into flows of authority that came to further elevate his existence and cause the propagation of even more Extremity Rune Scriptures.

But Noah wasn't fully paying attention to this as his very Existence was still stuck on the new vision he could see concepts of Extremity in, his soul feeling as if he was on the cusp of grasping something extremely critical, and that it was just outside of his grasp!
At this moment, his vision saw the amethyst color among the many sources flowing within him shine brightly.
He felt what this brightening of color wanted to do as he understood it even before...
{The Extremity of Tyranny urges you to focus on your current feeling and sensation.}
Even before the prompt came, he foresaw and understood what the Concept of Tyranny wanted to portray.
THUMP!
His existence felt a metaphorical heart beat as everything within him told him to test what he was currently seeing.
He had to better understand and fully cement the epiphany of the vision brought by Oraculum!
He needed to see and affirm whether what he saw for himself...was something he could see on all others.
What if he could read and understand the sources- the very desires of the Extremes of other Entities?
HUUM!
This thought caused a major part of his vision to redirect from the clear waters of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity as the eyes of his main body opened wide.
He needed to test something.
And naturally for this, he needed a test subject.
But there were abysmally few who could even match him at this moment as he quickly locked onto a possibility, and the figure of his main body disappeared!
Inside of a Record.
Within the Obsidian Difficulty of the Existential Raid Rift.
BOOM!
A cataclysmic light smashed into the figure of the Obsidian Raid Boss- Oppenheimer.

Around him, Records of Enders of Extremity lay defeated as he alone, unfettered and filled with the Extremes of the Extremity of Quintessence...he faced the terrifying Entity who was known as the Cimmerian Architect!

He saw the source of Ascendancy blare with a deeply hidden golden light as the clear waters of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity burned and turned into flows of authority that came to further elevate his existence and cause the propagation of even more Extremity Rune Scriptures.

But Noah wasn't fully paying attention to this as his very Existence was still stuck on the new vision he could see concepts of Extremity in, his soul feeling as if he was on the cusp of grasping something extremely critical, and that it was just outside of his grasp!
At this moment, his vision saw the amethyst color among the many sources flowing within him shine brightly.
He felt what this brightening of color wanted to do as he understood it even before...
{The Extremity of Tyranny urges you to focus on your current feeling and sensation.}
Even before the prompt came, he foresaw and understood what the Concept of Tyranny wanted to portray.
THUMP!
His existence felt a metaphorical heart beat as everything within him told him to test what he was currently seeing.
He had to better understand and fully cement the epiphany of the vision brought by Oraculum!
He needed to see and affirm whether what he saw for himself...was something he could see on all others.
What if he could read and understand the sources- the very desires of the Extremes of other Entities?
HUUM!
This thought caused a major part of his vision to redirect from the clear waters of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity as the eyes of his main body opened wide.
He needed to test something.
And naturally for this, he needed a test subject.
But there were abysmally few who could even match him at this moment as he quickly locked onto a possibility, and the figure of his main body disappeared!
Inside of a Record.
Within the Obsidian Difficulty of the Existential Raid Rift.
BOOM!
A cataclysmic light smashed into the figure of the Obsidian Raid Boss- Oppenheimer.

Around him, Records of Enders of Extremity lay defeated as he alone, unfettered and filled with the Extremes of the Extremity of Quintessence...he faced the terrifying Entity who was known as the Cimmerian Architect!

chapters.title: Chapter 2838 What is Extremity? II
paragraphs: It was an experience that the Cimmerian Architect would never forget as truly, even though she stood at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity- the Raid Boss she faced who was designated to be at the peak of the Fourth Gradation of Extremity was matching her power.
By challenging the Obsidian Difficulty Solo, she had taken care of all other Enders as the only enemy left was Oppenheimer, and even though she had the upper hand....
HUUM!

The massive body of this Raid Boss seemed to have the vitality of multiple Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity as the extremes of Prana and Life coursed through him, which when supported by the Existential light of Quintessence...allowed him to survive the relentless attacks of someone as powerful as the Cimmerian Architect.
But soon enough, she would grind his Vitality Values out entirely as her intuition told her that the rewards would be grand.
They may even be enough to stabilize and propel her towards a distant but close Sixth Gradation of Extremity.
{Come o-}
BZZT!
Her words came to a halt as the massive figure of Oppenheimer also came to a stop.
Because in front of their eyes, a terrifying authority bloomed as shockingly- the Extremity of Quintessence himself appeared within this Record.
When he did, the eyes of the Raid Boss- Oppenheimer, flickered brightly as he bowed down and kneeled.
While the Cimmerian Architect...
{I know I didn't fucking challenge the Tyrannical Difficulty...come on!}
She felt exasperated at the unfolding reality as towards her words, the Extremity of Quintessence had his eyes shining brilliantly as his voice was resolute.
{Just a minor interference for me to test something. Attack me. Think of it as a spar.}
She felt his gaze lock onto her as her eyes became somber.
A spar.
She had fought him just seconds ago in a battle with other Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity.
Before they were all almost smitten out of existence.
At that time, she could somewhat match his power.
This was before he had fully undergone his changes as the Primogenitor of multiple Existential Extremity Authorities.
So where would he be now? And how close could she match him when she herself had Quintessence coursing through her?
Her soul buzzed.
And her concepts followed as she laid the groundwork with the Extremity Rune Scriptures of Intuition.
And...her very existence was alarmed a moment later as the moment she made the Extremity of Quintessence her target, an unbelievable sense of danger and oppression was transmitted from Intuition!
The Cimmerian Architect felt this sensation.
And then there was Noah.
What he was seeing was an entirely new reality!
The moment his words had finished, he saw the few hundred thousand Extremity Rune Scriptures swirling around the existence that was the Cimmerian Architect.
In the past, she was someone who controlled Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vacuous.
Her power was profound!
And yet at this moment, Noah very clearly saw the extremes of her concepts.
Their intent, purpose, weaving and longing!
And he saw how they looked in comparison to his own extremes.
Like flickering stars holding their own dim glow in the form of Extremity Rune Scriptures, they exerted their extremes.
His concepts looked different.
They looked like weavings of dazzling suns that shone with a blinding radiance, while when he gazed at the concepts of the Cimmerian Architects, they looked like dim stars.
As he saw this and compared the two, the forming Oraculum seemed to bloom with information as he instantly understood why.
The image of his concepts as blinding suns showed their endless radiance to eventually have the capability to light up and become something even more.
Something Existential.
His concepts were Dead Paths, and thus, they looked different.

His other concepts that weren't initially Dead Paths...they also held similar blinding Radiances as after being taken to the height of Quintessential Zenith Concepts, their difficulty in attaining Extremity and traversing across the Gradations was just as high!
But their brightness left open a possibility for advancement as it seemed...a Dead Path was one of the pathways to turn a concept into something Existential!
Did this mean Vitalis and Vacuous were Dead Paths, or did they take other routes to become Existential? Or were they always Existential to begin with and they were never even dead paths?
This question buzzed in Noah's mind as he came to gaze upon Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny.
Their Colorless, Cerulean, and Amethyst colors were not mere blinding suns within Noah's body...but each one held a dazzling iridescent glow that covered his whole existence entirely.
He could now see the pristinely circular auras of colorless, cerulean, and amethyst layered over his body- over his very existence as their brilliance stretched out for light years.
Their brilliance went on to cover everything round him...stretching out all the way across the very Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
They affected everything.
They held an intricate balance over his existence that currently seemed to be capable of supporting these three fairly new Existential Extremity Authorities.
As their authorities grew, the breadth of his existence had to also grow alongside them as if he wasn't strong enough, they could not progress forward!
This also brought into question whether he could elevate more concepts into the Existential level and still support them with his existence.
It felt like there would be a limit.
But he didn't know what this limit currently was. One more? Three more? Six more?
He couldn't tell.
But currently, he began to feel.

He felt the sensation and the very intent of the extremes of the Cimmerian Architect before she even activated her Rune Scriptures to channel their authority as at this moment, he came to focus on the foremost authority she put forward.
Intuition.

In his vision, it flickered with a white light as tens of thousands of Rune Scriptures holding a portion of its source were going to light up in order to read the current reality and upcoming reality before it sent this feedback into the mind of its Master- the Cimmerian Architect.
But since Noah could see what this extreme intended to do even before it did so...
HUUM!

The amethyst glow of Tyranny that was circling around him but also had its light illuminating light years all around...he manipulated it's intent and obscured the Extremity of Intuition from exerting it's authority.

And the eyes of the Cimmerian Architect became alarmed and somber as she found out...Intuition could not reach much about what was coming, and due to such a shocking phenomenon, it only warned her of immense danger!
As if the enemy she faced was not that could be understood by even the Extreme of Intuition!
The Extremity of a Concept.
What exactly was the Extremity of something?
The furthest point of something. The utmost limit there could be. The apex, pinnacle, or the very zenith of what that 'thing' was.
At this moment, when Noah observed the Extreme of the concept of Intuition swirling around the Cimmerian Architect, he felt it's intent and weaving clearly as if he were looking at a clear formula.
He felt its longing and emotion as this concept...sought foreknowledge.
It sought to understand things before they unfolded, and it longed for nothing more than to understand...even without understanding. To act on instinct.
The moment Noah was able to read its longing like this...
{You have grasped the Weaving of Intuition.}
His own existence blinked as an instant later, he saw a Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scripture of Intuition form in front of him.
Since he was able to gaze at and see the intent of this extreme.
Its longing and desires.
Naturally...he was able to attain its Extremity after understanding its desires!
And under him, this Extreme could be elevated to an even grander level.
HUUM!
His existence buzzed.
{The emerging Existential Dynamis has allowed you to begin understanding the Weaving of Extremity.}
{You are at a point of unfathomable brilliance.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2839 The Weaving of Extremity! I
paragraphs: He was standing at a point of unimaginable brilliance!
The rims of his pupils were now burning with golden flames as he looked at the Cimmerian Architect.
Her eyes showed tremendous somberness as after Intuition only told her of danger, she mobilized the Extremity of Epoch to buy herself more time.
And yet under Noah's gaze, he was able to clearly see the Intent of this concept even before it bloomed.
He was able to see its weaving before it even exerted its extreme!
He saw the flow of the Extremity Rune Scriptures as before it could assemble its authority and express it outwardly, Noah now understood that he could disrupt its flow.
The easiest way to do so was just like how he had disrupted the flow of Intuition with Tyranny a moment ago.
This was because Tyranny, Quintessence, and Infinity were pervasive and all around his domains and Records.
He could mobilize them anywhere within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
But even if he didn't use these...
HUUM!
He mobilized the intent of Plot.

At this moment, he could better understand the extreme of Plot as while grasping its longing, the speed at which it could erupt was that much grander as its Colorless light warped from him and instantly appeared near the body of the Cimmerian Architect- and it went on to wrap around the flow of the Rune Scriptures of Epoch as before they could express their extreme...
They were overcome.
Suppressed!
Oppressed!

It was such a stifling thing that twice in a row now, the Cimmerian Architect had simply tried to do what she always did and mobilize her Concepts of Extremity, and yet she came to find none of them could even activate and express their Extremity!
When this reality dawned on her, her eyes trembled with utter disbelief and shock as such a sensation...was not entirely foreign to her.
She had felt something similar when she sparred against the only two beings she cared for in the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.
Entities at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity.

But even what they could do...was not as disastrous as what she was facing now as against them- she could at least activate her Concepts of Extremity as only thereafter did she realize they could easily counter her concepts and stop them!
This was the gulf she always faced when she gazed at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity.
But why did this unfathomable Entity in front of her...seem so much more terrifying?!
{YA!}
At such an instance, she bellowed out.
Her existence didn't like this sense of pressure and oppression.
So it shone brightly as Epoch, Time, Chronology, Intuition, Omen, Aeon, and more concepts began to weave together.
In the distance, Noah saw this scene as the golden flames around his pupils became ever brighter.
He saw more than ten concepts surrounding the Cimmerian Architect begin to resonate with each other as the haphazardly swirling Rune Scriptures around her attained a flow.

The gaps over large parts of her body became closed as he found that now...it would become just slightly harder to read the weaving of the concepts resonating and converging with each other to form a flow!
Harder.
But for him, not impossible.
He read the flow of the converging concepts of Extremity as its identity emerged in his mind.
{Ephemeris...}
The pupils of the Cimmerian Architect trembled.
She heard the name of the Absolute Dynamis of Extremity she was just calling forth from the mouth of her current enemy.

Around her, reality was about to begin distorting, with a domain of her Dynamis about to be expanded as in it, vicissitude and age would scream grandly as under its authority, she could express the most terrifying Extremes of her concepts!
And yet...
Noah's burning eyes read the flow of the forming Dynamis.
He saw the mixing of emotions and desires within it as a moment later, he mobilized the intent of Quintessence around the Cimmerian Architect.
He saw the blinding radiance representing Quintessence listen to his directions as he had it insert itself into the forming flow around the Cimmerian Architect!
And he...disrupted this flow.
An ancient hazy purple light of eons and age that was about to form was halted in its place as shockingly, the Dynamis never truly formed to express its authority.
The eyes of the Cimmerian Architect felt what occurred around her with a dazed expression.
It was only after a few milliseconds passed that her dazed expression left her face, her intent for battle entirely fading away as she brought her hands down!
{Fuck.}
She cursed out as she didn't attack any longer.
She didn't need to.

She understood that the being in front of her had somehow, in the span of seconds since he attained Extremity...grown so much that he could not stop her very concepts of Extremity from even expressing their authority.
Why the hell would she even think of fighting such a being?!

As for Noah himself, he saw the dismantling of the Dynamis of Ephemeris as the longer he saw the parts it was made of, the more he understood the intent and longing of the extremes that were trying to make it as...
{You have grasped the Weaving of Epoch}
{You have grasped the Weaving of Chronology.}
{You have grasped the Weaving of Aeon...}
He came to understand the extremes of another Entity seamlessly even without plundering and plagiarizing them as brand new Colorless Rune Scriptures formed around his body.
This was the result of the profound state he was in as Oraculum formed and generated this shocking new viewpoint for him!
He wanted to explore it more and understand the weaving of his own concepts and other concepts of Extremity as his gaze locked onto the visage of the Cimmerian Architect while he spoke out.

{You mentioned powerful Entities in the higher Gradations of Extremity or Primogenitors making their abodes deep within Recorded or Unrecorded Histories...do you have the coordinates of such Histories?}
His words emanated shocking battle intent as the Cimmerian Architect could see Noah wanted to find other targets to bully.
Those who may be even stronger than her as he wanted to test himself!
