chapters.title: Chapter 2840 The Weaving of Extremity! II
paragraphs: He wanted to test himself as for this, they may have to go the depths of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity where the gazes of the Ones Above Extremity may not be as pervasive.
Their gazes could reach there, but they may have some more time before these Entities took action!
But even if their gazes were pervasive, there was Noah's own capabilities as he held the distinction of an Indeterminate Quintessential I Existence.

He was in a constant paradoxical state of uncertainty, of existence and non-existence as apart from the Quintessential Annals of Extremity, it was nearly impossible for other Entities, Authorities, or Annals of Extremity to perceive him!
This state he attained wrapped around his entire existence as at this moment, he could also wrap it around another existence easily akin to the expansion of a domain.
So he gazed at the Cimmerian Architect whose eyes flickered with many emotions in a short period of time before she sighed.

{I know some, but I...I do not want to implicate them in all this. If any Records of me or you discussing or talking with them are established, they will likely be targeted by Vacuous and Vitalis as well. And unlike me, I don't know if they will make the same choice just as quickly before everything is too late...}
A solid reasoning and reply.
But Noah simply waved his hands at it as he spoke powerfully.
{I won't appear there for a discussion, and my existence will not even be perceived by the Ones Above Extremity.}
As he spoke, Noah's body flickered to release hundreds of Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Intuition that had rapidly begun to propagate.

They were made visible to the Cimmerian Architect as they flowed to instantly appear in front of her, with Noah expressing their extremes into the Cimmerian Architect as when she saw the Rune Scriptures of what used to be just her concept expressed by him to show her his intention...
{Fuck.}
She cursed exasperatedly again before sighing and throwing out a bundle of light towards Noah's figure.
{I won't go. Just...don't go too hard on them and if possible, see if they can make their entry into your lands.}
The bundle of light contained information of Histories that had occured eons ago.

Histories of events that had long come and gone in the river of time as for any lesser being, even getting such information would mean nothing to them as how can they traverse across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity?
But for Noah? It was only simplicity.
He grasped the bundle of information as his eyes burned with even grander golden flames, his figure dividing into two as both of his parts disappeared an instant later!
All that he left behind was an exasperated Cimmerian Architect and a kneeling Raid Boss who now rose calmly.
The Cimmerian Architect ground her teeth as after Noah left, the Dynamis of Ephemeris began to circle around her once more.
{I've got some anger and frustrations to release big guy, you ready?}
WAA!
Reality pulsed and distorted as if an Eon full of age and time was being brought out.
At such a scene, Oppenheimer's figure only began to buzz with pristine waves of Destiny and Providence supported by Existential Extremity Authorities as he replied in kind.

{You are lucky to have met the current me before my authority was elevated to match the current authority of the Concepts the Master has achieved. You are even luckier for not witnessing and facing the advent of the Raid Boss- Commander Feng.}
{But of course, luck is also part of your strength...so let us continue.}
HUUM!
The Rune Scriptures of the Raid Boss began to move.
When the Extremity of Quintessence grew more powerful, so would the things enacted by him.
This wouldn't occur right away as it would be a gradual change, but even this was bound to be drastic!
At this moment, the Rune Scriptures of the Raid Boss- Oppenheimer...began to have their own flow.
{HO!}
And opposite him, the Cimmerian Architect bellowed out in frustration as she sought to be the first to clear a Raid Rift!
But she was not the only one.
In another Record.
Inside a Golden Difficulty Existential Raid Rift.
Burning flames of Hatred pushed away the distortion of space time as Lilith took on a devilish form, horns rising on her head as she bellowed out powerfully!
{Cut through it, Ayame!}

Her voice called out to the past Scion of Infinite Extremity as from her, immense heat formed into a pillar that tried to pierce through the barrier of time in front of them that was covering the Devilish Time Unveiler.

Only a few hundred of their party members remained as the rest had faced False Deaths, with their consciousness remaining in the Raid Rift as mere observers to see how their remaining party members would perform.
So long as they cleared the Raid Rift, all of them would gain the rewards!
RIIP!

Like a veil, the barrier of time around the Devilish Time Unveiler tore from the immense Heat that was now backed by genuine Infinity, and Lilith instantly took this chance to pass through it as in front of her- a Trident of molten Apollyon formed with hellish flames of Hatred to sink into the chest of the Raid Boss.
Yet her soul shuddered as on the Devilish Time Unveiler, she saw a cruel smile forming even as the Vitality Values of this Entity neared the bottom.
He grasped his Dagger of Time as the curvature of spacetime twisted, Lilith's figure beginning to move in reverse as its Vitality Values were slowly returning to their state moments ago!
She couldn't allow this to happen.
If he recovered here, they wouldn't be able to get near him again with the few remaining forces they had!
But how...
Lilith's eyes widened as she saw a path.
She was already within his domain.
She just had to make sure it remained pierced and that he didn't recover.
But for her current power to achieve that...she could only do it one way.
She closed her eyes as she uttered out.
{Heart of Hatred.}
HUUM!
Her heart stopped beating.

It then burst in a painful sequence and became a shocking force as a moment later, all of her existence began to burn with terrifying Extremes of Hatred as from her body- the illusion of a radiant burning heart formed.
The will of Lilith gazed behind her as she sent her thoughts to the only other person more powerful enough to finish things off.
{Finish it off. Please.}
She wanted to have the glory.
But she had to take this path in order to give others a chance!
Behind her, Ayame's eyes shook as she saw the resolve of this being who burned her very existence, and a moment later...
BOOM!
Hellish flames exploded out with such Hatred that the reversal of time around the Devilish Time Unveiler was stopped.
The extremes of Hatred...they burnt with great emotion and longing as the barrier around the Raid Boss became even more torn.

Ayame breathed out while watching such a scene as she pulled every ounce of the aspect of Infinity from her existence, blue flames rising around her as she locked onto the shocked figure of the Devilish Time Unveiler whose hands were forced to part with the Dagger of Time.
Her figure then turned into a singularity of blue flames as she struck out while carrying the will of the Daughter of Hatred who had burned herself!

It was only simplicity.

chapters.title: Chapter 2841 The Weaving of Extremity! III
paragraphs: Lilith watched the scene with a sharp gaze.
Never before would she ever think of letting someone else have the spot light.
But in this past moment, she made a surprising choice as even though she wouldn't be the one to claim the glory of victory, her efforts had led to it!
Those who had faced False Death would be allowed to watch the rest of the Raid.

At this moment, Lilith watched the blazing figure of Ayame scorch everything within infinite heat- sinking into the very existence that was the Devilish Time Unveiler as the last vestiges of his Authority that were ground down by thousands of Entities...finally depleted.
It was a surreal result.
HUUM!
The space they were in trembled and shook as Ayame's figure rematerialized at the spot where the Devilish Time Unveiler exploded into a bundle of Quintessential light.
Thereafter, a resplendent golden light shone out as a symphony of grandness bloomed.
Thereafter, Lilith felt her awareness collected and returned into her body once more as in the spot she faced False Death, she once more returned!
{Due to clearing the Golden Difficulty Existential Raid Rift, the penalty of the False Death has been cleared.}
{An Astounding Achievement!}
WAA!
A celestial golden light flourished as the 9,999 participants of this Rift all rose once more, their gazes rising up as there, in the space above the domain they were in...
Golden clouds formed as above these clouds, massive multicolored treasure chests opened with glorious light.
Within them, immense honor and loot seemed to be contained!
Lilith gazed at it as before her eyes and the eyes of many others, dazzling Golden prompts rose.
But the prompts every person saw were different.
{The party you led is the first to clear an Existential Raid Rift in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!}
{An Achievement worthy of being recorded in the Quintessential Annals of Extremity!}
{Your contribution in the clearing of this Existential Rift has been calculated.}
{You hold the highest contribution in the clearing of this Existential Rift!}
{Due to this distinction and being the first Raid Rift to be cleared, the chances to obtain the highest quality loot have increased Quintessentially.}
{You have obtained the Low Grade Infinity Planalith Krystallos!}
{You have obtained the Zenith Low Grade Armament of Extremity- Banner of the Disbeliever!}
{You have obtained 9x Early Entry Passes!}
Her eyes trembled.
The highest possible quality loot within this Raid Rift.
She actually attained a Planalith Krystallos of Infinity!
Above her, a radiant crystalline crystalloid that shone like a blinding blue sun came down, in addition to a crimson red banner and 9 rectangular looking talismans.
She was barely able to blink to see that above the visage of Ayame beside her, a similar cerulean crystalline star descended, along with a flaming sword!
Apart from them, no others had such dazzling loot.
At most, all 9,999 Entrants apart from them had some sort of a Planalith Krystallos descending above them, but none were as bright as the ones above Lilith and Ayame!
None contained the right for them to embark on an Existential concept of Extremity.

Seeing such a shocking prize before her, Lilith reached out and grasped onto it tightly, bringing it to her blessed chest as for her, the blinding blue light seemed like an endlessly shining star of hope that finally affirmed for her...that she could truly rise to a shocking height of power from here on out.
With a glimmer of light, she accepted her Loot and was escorted out of the Raid Rift along with all others.
After a mere blink of an eye, they found themselves within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

And all around them, fanfare still continued as their figures were shone a spotlight on, many eyes turning towards them briefly and looking away from the events on a shocking illusory screen that showed a terrifying battle of the Tyrannical Difficulty!
Lilith cared not for the gazes as she began to absorb the Infinity Planalith Krystallos right away.
While Ayame...her reappearance caused the eyes of a few being to lock onto her as one after another, they made their way over to her.
{Ayame...you went ahead of me this time and attained something good it seems.}
The figure of Erikson appeared.

His tan skin shone with valiant radiance as he seemed like a prince originating from far lands, his slippers throwing off this glorious image as after him, pink flowers bloomed as a young man in a white robe holding a pink sword appeared.
It was Atlas of the past Plum Sword of Extremity!
Following him was another young scion who had sculptures shining with a powerful light at his heel- it was Lodovico of the past Sculptors of Extremity!

One way or another, all had taken the widely spread Blood Source and were transported into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven before being smitten out of existence as now...these past Scions who completed with each other met once more in a land of profound opportunities.

But at this moment, one Scion was particularly in the lead as in her hands, Ayame grasped something that would actually get her started on a Concept of Extremity that would push her power to a fantastical level!

The methodology of refining and elevating the power of Noah's Existential Extremity Authorities with the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as a whole had began smoothly as the first party cleared an Existential Raid Rift.

Noah was doing his part in this larger picture as after ascending into the Sixth Gradation of Extremity, he was able to begin the conference of Oraculum that allowed for a stupendous capability to come to fruition.
The capability to begin understanding the Weaving of Extremity!
Initially, Noah had many theories when it came to just when he would grow capable enough to expand the Extremity...of Extremity.
As he now arrived on the precipice of this grand capability of understanding the Weaving of Extremity, he came to realize that this far off dream...may actually be possible at the end of this path!

chapters.title: Chapter 2842 The Weaving of Extremity! IV
paragraphs: This was Noah's strong belief as he began to gain a deeper understanding of Extremes!
The more he delved into it, the more he understood their emotions and longings...the more he understood that the very concept of the Extremity of Extremity was not something to be taken lightly.
Not something that could be achieved so simply!
He had initially thought that maybe after reaching the Ninth Gradation of Extremity, this theory could be made into a reality.
But he now understood that even if he had reached that height, it may have not been enough.
The key lay in understanding Extremity itself.
The key lay in understanding its weaving- why and how the extremes of many concepts moved the way they did!
And so, he set out to understand this by observing his own Extremes and comparing other extremes.
He sent out a part of himself in the form of a clone as at this moment, he stepped outside of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and into the Quintessential Annals of Extremity.

Into a construct of records upon records that were in a constant flux of existence and nonexistence- his will passing through it quickly as with his eyes burning with golden flames, he traced the Records that the Cimmerian Architect had given him as within moments...`
SHAA!
He was within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
More specifically, in the Vacuous Annals of Extremity as like a fish in water, he swam across a myriad of Records as he didn't hold an ounce of fear on whether he could be discovered!
{The Extremity of Tyranny burns with ambition.}
His power was affirmed.

His distinction as an Indeterminate Quintessential I Existence remained true as in his constant state of uncertainty, the gazes of the Ones Above Extremity were that much further from him- especially so within these layers of Records!
He crossed through them seamlessly as in time...
WAP!
As if he were tearing apart a veil, as if he tore open the pages of an ancient book that recorded eons of History...
He arrived in a domain.
It was serene and quiet, with its reality feeling a sense of a distortion as if the record was recently altered.

This wasn't the state it was in before as currently, the skies burned with a hazy glow of white flames of Anarchos, the land below being a sea of liquified Anarchos as atop them, a Forge and a Hall radiating an air of refinement could be seen.

In front of these two buildings, the majestic auras of two Entities could be seen as currently, they were adorned in white robes and sitting on the liquified sea of Anarchos while silently gazing at what could only be described as an obsidian coffin!
A tomb!
A tomb that within it, Noah could feel traces of Records and memories of none other than those of the Cimmerian Architect.
These two Entities...were actually in mourning.

They had altered this record and painted it white with Anarchos as while adorned in white robes, they were actually mourning the Cimmerian Architect as for them, she was thoroughly and undeniably dead!
At this scene, Noah shook his head while sighing.
{How quaint.}
HUUM!
Even though he had arrived in this Record some time ago, his two words were the only indication that he was here as an instant later...
{Who!}
BOOM!

The burly man that was sitting down rose with terrifying authority as he came to lock onto Noah, the woman beside him gazing up with cold eyes and doing the same as even with this...Noah also confirmed something.
Even Entities at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity...could not sense his presence easily in his state of existence and nonexistence!
Even as these powerful Entities rose, Noah felt his own existence pulse with brightness as his Extremes radiated their longing.
They began to weave as he tuned his senses and allowed them to run free!
{The Extremity of Paradox pulls upon the Existential Extremity Authorities of Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny.}
{Schrodinger's Quintessential Domain of Indeterminacy has been laid down in the surrounding Records!
WAA!

A mixture of Colorless, cerulean, and amethyst lights flashed as Noah felt they weaving together under the banner of Paradox, their Authority instantly altering the surroundings records and placing everything within it in a state of existence and non-existence!
This was only Noah being more careful as now, nothing within this domain would fall under the gazes of others.
He did this for this purpose.
But of course, when the powerful Entities at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity saw him do this, their extremes blared as they treated him like a powerful enemy!
Noah smiled at this as any misunderstandings could be cleared later.
At this point in time, he just wanted to see more extremes and understand their intent.
Their weaving!
{I. Asked. Who!}
BOOOM!

The burly man waved his hands back majestically as from his forge, an obsidian gold full body Armament radiating the aura of multiple pieces with the power of Middle Grade Armaments of Extremity descended unto his body gloriously, along with a fiery obsidian white hammer that blared with Perdition and Anarchos!

Beside him, the woman he sat with rose as a battle Armament shimmering with an obsidian hue covered her gorgeous visage, a radiant white bow appearing in her hands as she aimed it towards Noah with blazing intent.
All of this occurred as during it...Noah was reading the intent of the extremes of these two beings.
The weaving of their extremes told Noah many things as first and foremost...
{The Anvil of Anarchos- Sargon}
{The Purifier of Alchemy- Ishtar}
Their identities became clear to Noah.
Sargon and Ishtar!
Those who shared an intricate connection to the Cimmerian Architect.
At this moment, Noah saw that their bodies held not a single gap.
Their Extremity Rune Scriptures had a fantastical flow that pushed and pulled on each other, swirling around their existence as if they were dancing.
As if they were enduring a performance across eons!
It was why even though he could read their flow...
WAP!

Their extremes were still able to exert their authority rapidly- much faster than Elodie as within an instant, the reality before Noah had a blazing white arrow shimmering with cataclysm near him, while an illusory hammer swung from below intent of splintering everything above it!
A battle with Entities at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity...began like this!

Even as these powerful Entities rose, Noah felt his own existence pulse with brightness as his Extremes radiated their longing.
They began to weave as he tuned his senses and allowed them to run free!
{The Extremity of Paradox pulls upon the Existential Extremity Authorities of Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny.}
{Schrodinger's Quintessential Domain of Indeterminacy has been laid down in the surrounding Records!
WAA!

A mixture of Colorless, cerulean, and amethyst lights flashed as Noah felt they weaving together under the banner of Paradox, their Authority instantly altering the surroundings records and placing everything within it in a state of existence and non-existence!
This was only Noah being more careful as now, nothing within this domain would fall under the gazes of others.
He did this for this purpose.
But of course, when the powerful Entities at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity saw him do this, their extremes blared as they treated him like a powerful enemy!
Noah smiled at this as any misunderstandings could be cleared later.
At this point in time, he just wanted to see more extremes and understand their intent.
Their weaving!
Asked.
Who!}
BOOOM!

The burly man waved his hands back majestically as from his forge, an obsidian gold full body Armament radiating the aura of multiple pieces with the power of Middle Grade Armaments of Extremity descended unto his body gloriously, along with a fiery obsidian white hammer that blared with Perdition and Anarchos!

Beside him, the woman he sat with rose as a battle Armament shimmering with an obsidian hue covered her gorgeous visage, a radiant white bow appearing in her hands as she aimed it towards Noah with blazing intent.
All of this occurred as during it...Noah was reading the intent of the extremes of these two beings.
The weaving of their extremes told Noah many things as first and foremost...
{The Anvil of Anarchos- Sargon}
{The Purifier of Alchemy- Ishtar}
Their identities became clear to Noah.
Sargon and Ishtar!
Those who shared an intricate connection to the Cimmerian Architect.
At this moment, Noah saw that their bodies held not a single gap.
Their Extremity Rune Scriptures had a fantastical flow that pushed and pulled on each other, swirling around their existence as if they were dancing.
As if they were enduring a performance across eons!
It was why even though he could read their flow...
WAP!

Their extremes were still able to exert their authority rapidly- much faster than Elodie as within an instant, the reality before Noah had a blazing white arrow shimmering with cataclysm near him, while an illusory hammer swung from below intent of splintering everything above it!
A battle with Entities at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity...began like this!

chapters.title: Chapter 2843 The Weaving of Extremity! V
paragraphs: Those in the Sixth Gradation of Extremity seemed to be much more adept at expressing the intent of their extremes as they were even faster.

Around the existence of Sargon and Ishtar, the Anvil of Anarchos and the Purifier of Alchemy, Noah saw that the first attacks they sent out were mere expressions of their power as before these attacks even arrived, they followed up with their true power!
The flow around their body moved in a beautiful melody.
And at the forefront...were the spinning Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vacuous.

They converged tighter and led the flow of multiple other Concepts of Extremity into the serendipity of a Dynamis- of a type of power that caused the very Records they were in to tremble and begin to shatter as this Dynamis brought forth the extremes of nonexistence to a shocking level!
{Vacuity}
The Anvil of Anarchos called out coldly.
Vacuity. A term connected to Vacuous!
It meant empty space.
A space of utmost nothingness and nonexistence, and this was the Absolute Dynamis of Extremity that he put forth as his flow dictated that everything before him be erased!
These...were his converged Extremes.
They were so potent that the Purifier of Alchemy had no need to release any other authority as even it would be swallowed up in the emptiness about to ensue!
But when Noah saw the weaving of the many extremes including Vacuous around the Anvil of Anarchos and the subsequent expressions of their Extremes...he actually smiled.
Against all incoming attacks, he actually didn't urge any of his own extremes to retaliate as his eyes burning with golden flames could see many things right now.
And while the illusory hammer and massive flaming white arrow smashing towards him arrived first, he remained utterly as the moment they came to have an impact with his figure...
No sound occurred.
No horrific blast of impact.
The massive hammer and flaming white arrow of Anarchos...passed through him as if he didn't exist!
At such a scene, the eyes of the Anvil of Anarchos and the Purifier of Alchemy shone powerfully, with the extremes of the Dynamis of Vacuity coming right after.
Wherever this authority passed, the very records were erased into a blank whiteness As this whole landscape was being changed.
And yet against Noah...he smiled ever brighter as at this moment, Oraculum truly showed its majesty.
He read the Weaving of the Extremes contained in Vacuity.
And after he did so, his soul buzzed in joy as he felt like...he didn't need to oppose the extremes of these concepts!
They each held desires they wanted to express, and he wondered whether he had to always cancel out the extremes of other beings with his own that were more powerful!
At this moment, he went a different route.
He didn't deny the oncoming Extremes that were erasing everything out of existence.
He understood their intent as his figure stayed utterly still, the endless white nothingness coming to envelop him as he...went with its flow!

His Extremity Rune Scriptures of Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny simply imitated the flow of the extremes of multiple authorities as they gave him an instant of a buffer, and thereafter...his very existence followed the weaving of the concepts contained in the Absolute Dynamis of Vacuity.
{You are actively breaking down a Dynamis containing more than 9 Concepts of Extremity.}
{Vacuous has been excluded due to its unknown nature.}
{You have grasped the Weaving of Nihility}
{You have grasped the Weaving of the Void.}
{You have grasped the Weaving of Resiliency}
{You have grasped the Weaving of the Rancor...}

One after another, the concepts within the Dynamis were broken down as Noah grasped their intent and understood their extremes to the extent that Rune Scriptures of these concepts blossomed all around him!
{Your understanding of the Weaving of Extremity has Quintessentially been elevated!}
He performed a shocking fear as for him, it was just that.
For others...
The faces of the Anvil of Anarchos and the Purifier of Alchemy turned somber as in their vision, Noah's figure didn't even make a move.

A Dynamis with Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures at its forefront had descended to erase everything, and half of this current record was now gone due to it but...this Entity did not even make a move!
He didn't mobilize any authority to cancel theirs.
At this moment, he was the only thing standing serenely in the field of white emptiness- as if the extremes of their concepts would simply not work on him!
When such a thought arose, the eyes of the Purifier of Alchemy trembled subtly as she thought of a possibility.
{Could he be...}
She didn't finish her thoughts.
They were too disastrous to finish!
But when she looked at that demeanor.
At the utter confidence of their existence and power!
She could only think of one type of Entity a few of them had seen throughout the eons.
The Ones Above Extremity!
Such a possibility arose in her mind.

But this time, she didn't feel a sense of trepidation as her will gazed at the tomb behind them, thinking of the lost girl she had watched grow up who was wiped out of existence not too long ago as...anger rose in her heart.
She gazed at the being standing in a field of empty whiteness as she called out with anger and pain in her heart.
{You've already taken her from us, what more do you want? Us too? Will that satiate your cruelty?!}
The words came out rapidly as they were instantly understood by the Anvil of Anarchos beside her as his gaze rapidly changed.
It couldn't be, right?
He gazed up at the lone figure above them that was now gazing down with a content smile as at the words of Ishtar, he blinked while his eyes pulsed with golden flames of understanding.
She...actually mistook him for having an identity of the Ones Above Extremity due to the way he seamlessly handled the Weaving of Extremity!

chapters.title: Chapter 2844 The Weaving of Extremity! VI
paragraphs: She mistook his identity, but at the end of the day, her words were actually not wrong!
He had taken the Cimmerian Architect away from them.
But he didn't wipe her out of existence!
His eyes pulsed with golden flames as he gazed out calmly while speaking.
{As interesting as the comparison is, I am someone else entirely. And Elodie...she is not gone.}
His eyes radiated grandeur as he spoke.
He came to better see the weaving of Extremity as he affirmed that his current power could seamlessly handle Entities at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity.

He also understood how their manipulation of extremes was as now, he needed to fully understand the weaving of his own concepts while continuing to ascend across the waters of the Gradations of Extremity!
So he spoke towards these two powerful Entities as now that he was here and he read an intricate connection between them and the Cimmerian Architect...he may as well put them to use.
After all, he had the wondrous design that was the Existential Dungeon Apocalypse that he was holding off on using until his forces acclimated to their extremes and became more powerful.
But if he could put entities at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity to use already...he could begin devouring the records and authority of Vacuous and Vitalis much earlier!
Hearing his words, the Anvil of Anarchos and the Purifier of Alchemy had their wills buzz as they looked at him sharply.
They were pristine powerful entities as their minds worked fast.
The news he gave them was a shocking one as if he truly wasn't among the Ones Above Extremity, and he held news regarding Elodie...it had to be the last person that Elodie was fixated against!
{You...you are...?!}
Sargon grit his teeth while glaring towards Noah with blazing white flames.
Could he be?
The most recent Honored One that should be entirely dead?

If this were true, they were in as much danger as before when they thought he was among the Ones Above Extremity as wherever he went and whoever he associated with...may just be smitten out of existence!
Noah saw their many expressions and reactions as he spoke calmly while conjuring two Colorless Instance Dungeon Portals halfway between them.

{Listen to the Weaving of your Extremes and make a choice. Enter through these and your Records will be purged and baptized of anything to do with Vacuous and Vitalis, and you will escape the gazes of the Ones Above Extremity while getting to see Elodie once more. But make that choice quickly as even I don't fully know just how long and to what extent I can obscure the gazes of the Ones Above Extremity.}
As he spoke, Noah's visage began to disappear.

He left behind a shocking proposition that angered Ishtar and Sargon as his presence alone could show a sort of link between them, and who knew how far-reaching the gazes of the Ones Above Extremity were?!
After all, they held Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vacuous in their existence.
They had this Existential Authority flowing through them as just how much could its gaze be obscured?
Ishtar grit her teeth fiercely while glaring at Noah's fading figure, her own body turning into a dazzling stream of light as she bellowed out.
{Explain yourself!}
SHAA!

She shot out as Noah disappeared with a glimmer of light, her eyes burning with waves of power before she turned towards the two Colorless portals floating amidst the empty whiteness and disappeared into them!
{Ishtar!}
Sargon watched such a scene while his eyes danced with hesitation, but when he saw Ishtar sink into the portal seamlessly, he also grit his teeth and shot out!
It was a surreal scene.
When the Purifier of Alchemy first stepped into the portal, she felt a powerful Existential Extremity Authority swarm in on all sides as if she wished, she could put up a fight and resist it.

But she remembered the words of the Entity that had just appeared as when she listened to the Extremity of Premonition, her eyes formed a steely resolve as her uniquely flowing Scriptures let down their defenses!
And then...she felt the Existential Extremity Authority of Vacuous within her body and soul begin to burn as it rapidly began to be scorched out of existence!
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
The Banner of Quintessence flashed with brilliance as names constantly kept changing on it, a new name rising to the top ten as it was none other than Elodie- The Cimmerian Architect!
Within a blinding flash of light, she returned victoriously from soloing an Obsidian Difficulty Existential Raid Rift.
This...was the highest Difficulty of a rift to be cleared- and it was done so by a single Entity without a party!

Her figure was surrounded by brilliance as 9 treasure chests rotated around her, eight of them containing vibrant Planalith Krystallos as the last one held a crimson gold battledress emanating the aura of a Middle Grade Armament of Extremity!
The eyes of the Cimmerian Architect curved into a smile and seemed refreshed as she spoke while taking stock of what she had attained.
{Haha, that's a good fucking victory. And all of this is...loot?}
A dazzling Colorless Quintessence Planalith Krystallos fell in her fair hands as her smile became ever brighter.
Another Existential Extremity Authority to replace the loss of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
And the brilliance of this one seemed to be that much more enticing as she laughed powerfully while putting the treasure chests away!
At this same moment in time, space warped a light year away as with it, a terrifying aura silently spread out to observe its surroundings.

As the eyes of this Entity began to open wide with shock and disbelief, her powerful will covered nearby hundreds of light years as she managed to observe many beings...along with one with a refined and powerful aura who was laughing powerfully right now!
The one she had thought to be forever scorched out of existence.
She..she was actually...
Her body trembled with a mixture of emotions as ultimately, her booming voice echoed out only in the direction of the Cimmerian Architect!
{You're here fucking laughing as we remain in mourning this whole time?!}
The words caused the expression of the distant Cimmerian Architect to quickly change as she recognized this voice of anger across eons of records.
Her will buzzed and quickly located the fiery and gorgeous figure of the Purifier of Alchemy whose hair danced around madly as she barreled towards her like an explosive keg!
She was coming right at her with the power of someone at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity as the expression of the Cimmerian Architect rapidly became stern as she called out.
{Ishtar, wait...}
BOOM!
BOOM!
Heavy bursts of authority exploded out as at this moment, new entrants of much greater quality began to appear in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!

chapters.title: Chapter 2845 The Weaving of Extremity! VII
paragraphs: Her body was reforged with Quintessence as Vacuous Hyperversal Authority was scorched out of her existence.
After her transformation, strands of dark and white hair flowed to her shoulders as her fair skin glimmered with brilliance, her eyes holding three pupils within that glowed white, black, and gold!
The Purifier of Alchemy and all her glory looked this pristine as currently, multiple Extremes that she controlled weaved together into a flow that bombarded itself into the Cimmerian Architect.
{Selfish!}
BOOM!
Her body was still adorned in a white mourning dress as her power at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity caused the Cimmerian Architect to feel like a heavy weight was constantly pressing down on her!
Light years away in the far distance, Sargon appeared after Ishtar arrived to see this scene as his will spread around with disbelief.
The new lands he was in needed to be ascertained, yes.
But...he felt like a massive weight had been lifted off his shoulders when he saw the Cimmerian Architect alive and well!

He sat down on the space he was floating in and materialized a golden cup that came to be filled with a red liquid, his dark hair messily falling on his burly and muscular figure that was forged from iron working as he tipped the drink in his hands forward.
{I did not fail you, my friend.}
His gaze was deep.

He thought of the dying woman on the Seventh Gradation of Extremity who was on the cusp of achieving the Eighth Gradation, and yet she came to him...dying while holding the tiny hands of a small girl.
He remembered the words she said to him even now.
{Her name...is Elodie. Please, take care of her.}
She entrusted this girl to him and Ishtar who just happened to be at the time as they competed in forging and alchemy.
That time...he questioned how an Entity of the Seventh Gradation of Extremity could be dying.
How the many concepts of Extremity she held and all that power flowing in her existence...how could she possibly be withering away while her existence faded?!
In her final moments, the dying woman had smiled with reluctance as if she didn't want to day- gazing deeply at the young girl she was leaving behind as her very Existence began to splinter.

The eyes of the young girl she had brought were hazy and blank as if she couldn't see the scene in front of her, and she was only standing as a mute that would continue to do for a thousand years from this point.

But right before the dying woman perished...she spoke the words that told Ishtar and Sargon who they needed to keep away from, and who had caused someone of such a height of power like her to be dying as if she were a mere mortal entity that hadn't even grasped the flow of Mana.
{The Ones...Above Extremity.}
Her final words.

She then looked lovingly at the young girl she left behind as her body collapsed and began folding into itself, her Extremes waning and dying as Sargon and Ishtar watched Extremity Rune Scriptures dim and die right in front of their eyes!
This...was how they came across Elodie.

And they watched her grow up to who she was up until moments ago when he really thought he had failed his dying friend's last wishes, and what was more vile was that the daughter she entrusted them with...had also perished at the hands of the same Entities as her mother!
But no.
There she was.
{Ishtar!}
BOOM!
{You. Never. Fucking. Listen!} The Purifier of Alchemy was cursing while dishing out a loving punishment, which also showed where the Cimmerian Architect got her foul mouth from.
As Sargon watched this scene, he sighed with relief and contentment while speaking out- his voice only echoing around him.
{Am I correct to assume you to be Noah Osmont, the most recent Honored One?}
He spoke into the surroundings as if he knew there was a powerful will that may be listening!
After all, with his eyes at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity, he could see some things.
And currently, he saw the brilliance of more than two Existential Extremity Authorities serenely floating across every nook and cranny of these new lands he was in.
{You would be correct.}
WAP!

His surroundings fluctuated as a celestial man adorned in a royal purple rob appeared, his stature tall and standing above many others as his devilishly handsome looks and demeanor instantly caused all wills light years nearby to halt and come to stare at him!

In the distance, even the visage of Ishtar stopped as Elodie finally had the chance to breathe, her figure warping and slipping away as she actually came to float behind Noah's recently appearing figure.
{Fuck! You would've warned me that you brought them over!}

Her disheveled appearance still showed pristine beauty as her forehead glimmered with a dazzling scripture. She breathed heavily while gazing with defiance towards the far away Ishtar and looking cautiously at the nearby Sargon.
At this scene, Noah's eyes still burning with golden flames saw something unique.
He saw the flow of Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny all around him, yes.
But in addition to this...he was also seeing the flow of...Plot.
The Extremity of Plot.
Currently, its weaving was gleeful as its flow could be seen wrapping around himself...and then onto the many beings around him.
Plot.
Noah came to understand this extreme more as it was silently allowing itself to flow into the reality around it, ever so subtly moving the Unrecorded History towards a direction it considered ideal!
The authority it was expressing bordered on the same stage of not more than Paradox and its weaving was growing ever more powerful as it may just be the next one to elevate itself forward!

But then...Noah also saw the golden intent of something that wasn't as visible as all the others, but when he focused on its weaving, he found it focused on himself the most with astonishing brilliance.
It was the extreme of the Protagonist.
Like a silent king overseeing all others, it now bid its time tightly around Noah as its extreme...was Noah himself.
The Extremity of the Protagonist.
Its Intent was Noah.
Its weaving was Noah.
Noah was...the very extreme of the Protagonist.

After her transformation, strands of dark and white hair flowed to her shoulders as her fair skin glimmered with brilliance, her eyes holding three pupils within that glowed white, black, and gold!
The Purifier of Alchemy and all her glory looked this pristine as currently, multiple Extremes that she controlled weaved together into a flow that bombarded itself into the Cimmerian Architect.
{Selfish!}
BOOM!
Her body was still adorned in a white mourning dress as her power at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity caused the Cimmerian Architect to feel like a heavy weight was constantly pressing down on her!
Light years away in the far distance, Sargon appeared after Ishtar arrived to see this scene as his will spread around with disbelief.
The new lands he was in needed to be ascertained, yes.
But...he felt like a massive weight had been lifted off his shoulders when he saw the Cimmerian Architect alive and well!

He sat down on the space he was floating in and materialized a golden cup that came to be filled with a red liquid, his dark hair messily falling on his burly and muscular figure that was forged from iron working as he tipped the drink in his hands forward.
{I did not fail you, my friend.}
His gaze was deep.

He thought of the dying woman on the Seventh Gradation of Extremity who was on the cusp of achieving the Eighth Gradation, and yet she came to him...dying while holding the tiny hands of a small girl.
He remembered the words she said to him even now.
{Her name...is Elodie.
Please, take care of her.}
She entrusted this girl to him and Ishtar who just happened to be at the time as they competed in forging and alchemy.
That time...he questioned how an Entity of the Seventh Gradation of Extremity could be dying.
How the many concepts of Extremity she held and all that power flowing in her existence...how could she possibly be withering away while her existence faded?!
In her final moments, the dying woman had smiled with reluctance as if she didn't want to day- gazing deeply at the young girl she was leaving behind as her very Existence began to splinter.

The eyes of the young girl she had brought were hazy and blank as if she couldn't see the scene in front of her, and she was only standing as a mute that would continue to do for a thousand years from this point.

But right before the dying woman perished...she spoke the words that told Ishtar and Sargon who they needed to keep away from, and who had caused someone of such a height of power like her to be dying as if she were a mere mortal entity that hadn't even grasped the flow of Mana.
{The Ones...Above Extremity.}
Her final words.

She then looked lovingly at the young girl she left behind as her body collapsed and began folding into itself, her Extremes waning and dying as Sargon and Ishtar watched Extremity Rune Scriptures dim and die right in front of their eyes!
This...was how they came across Elodie.

And they watched her grow up to who she was up until moments ago when he really thought he had failed his dying friend's last wishes, and what was more vile was that the daughter she entrusted them with...had also perished at the hands of the same Entities as her mother!
But no.
There she was.
{Ishtar!}
BOOM!
{You.
Never.
Fucking.
Listen!} The Purifier of Alchemy was cursing while dishing out a loving punishment, which also showed where the Cimmerian Architect got her foul mouth from.

{Am I correct to assume you to be Noah Osmont, the most recent Honored One?}
He spoke into the surroundings as if he knew there was a powerful will that may be listening!
After all, with his eyes at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity, he could see some things.
And currently, he saw the brilliance of more than two Existential Extremity Authorities serenely floating across every nook and cranny of these new lands he was in.
{You would be correct.}
WAP!

His surroundings fluctuated as a celestial man adorned in a royal purple rob appeared, his stature tall and standing above many others as his devilishly handsome looks and demeanor instantly caused all wills light years nearby to halt and come to stare at him!

chapters.title: Chapter 2846 Ushering Apocalypse Unto Vitalis and Vacuous Domains! I
paragraphs: Noah's surroundings buzzed as the flow of extremes around him became even more intense, Sargon and Elodie quieting down and gazing towards him sharply.
He was wrong.
Plot may not be the next one to advance after all as the Protagonist that had its weaving become so intricately connected to Noah himself may just be the next one to take this step.
After all, the weaving it was trying to achieve was too grand!
Its weaving was to make Noah the leading figure- the main character of not just the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, but of the eons of Records that existed outside of it.
For that to happen, reality would distort and fold to his will as the implications of the weaving of the Protagonist were too grand in the large scheme of things!
Noah gazed at its silent royal grandeur as he committed himself to understand the Weaving of Extremity more and more in the days and weeks to come.
He came to the conclusion that if he truly understood it at its Zenith, doing something like expanding the Extremity of Extremity would be as easy as raising a hand.
And when that day came...
Woe to his enemies and any who stood against him!
And when that day came...
Woe to his enemies and any who stood against him!

{The Most Recent Honored One...you must have brought us here for a reason. In the eons of records I've seen and lived, I've never met a saint. Even the ones trying to depict themselves as saints have never been saints. So why are we here?}

A distance from him, Sargon, the Anvil of Anarchos, asked lightly while trying to grasp the unfathomable authority of this being. In the far distance, the record of Tatiana Nikolaievna who had been silently waiting for orders this whole time rose as she heard these words.
The visage of Extremity Solarium also raised her head as her golden hair burned with brilliance, her eyes filled with emotions as she had an idea for the answer to this question!

At an even further distance, the intense aura of the Fourth Gradation of Extremity pulsed around Svetlana as she also gazed forth towards the figure that seemed to be at the center of everything here.
Many eyes were on him as even his son currently had a gaze of extreme determination as if he had undergone a great internal change!
Why were they here?
Why were any of them here?
It was truly an Existential question as before Noah could reply...
{I'll take this one...} While gazing with defiance at the figure of Ishtar, Elodie harrumphed while beginning to speak serenely.

{We're all here because we were nearly scorched out of existence by the Ones Above Extremity, and if we want the freedom to pursue Extremity or what may be above it...we can't be so damn fearful and weak in front of these fuckers sitting Above Extremity, right?}
The Cimmerian Architect could see a tiny, small semblance of the weaving of Extremity as she spoke out with ingenuity.
She was jumping on Noah's camp as after the burst of loot she just received, she was much more of a believer!
In the distance, the figure of Ishtar began to burn with anger again while flying closer as her words through gritted teeth could be heard.
{Why are you inserting yourse-}

{Annnd!} Yet, the Cimmerian Architect didn't give her a chance as she actually came to float directly behind Noah, akin to standing behind an immovable shield as Ishtar had to come to a stop in front of him!
{And, in order to do that, we have to grasp the Existential Extremity Authorities around us as...do you all see that over there?}
Elodie pointed towards the massive illusory screen depicting the shocking battle in the Tyrannical Difficulty.

The figures of Barbatos, Adelaide, and other valiant women filled with Noah's power could be seen raging against Ruination who was seemingly growing even faster in strength than them, the extremes they expressed being shocking to look at!

{Battle power like that should be a minimum. Grasping Quintessence or Infinity like that...should be the basics. Thereafter, Vacuous and Vitalis have to slowly get their authorities ground down and weakened as for this...}
Elodie breathed out as her fair hand pointed to the tremendous back of the Entity she stood behind.
This was as far as Intuition could take her.
And Intuition told her to stop there.
The Cimmerian Architect had set the stage.
In front of her, Noah smiled calmly as like a regal Emperor addressing his people, his voice echoed out across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

{The means to elevate yourselves and Existential Extremity Authorities are already there in the form of Existential Raid Rifts. Now, to weaken the threat hanging above, the Existential Dungeon Apocalypse shall open in a limited fashion.}
WAA!

As he spoke, space began to twist and distort as in front of the massive cerulean Existential Raid Rift portal, a blaring light of purple bloomed as an amethyst Existential Dungeon Apocalypse Rift portal began to bloom!
A light of tyranny.
A light of glory.

A light of the conquest of the Extremity of Quintessence as he waged war not on the Ones Above Extremity...but the very Existential Extremity Authorities they held coursing across existence and nonexistence!

{The Existential Dungeon Apocalypse Rift will grant twice the Loot of the Existential Raid Rift, and only Extremity Clones of those at the Third Gradation of Extremity and higher are allowed entry in.}
The eyes of many watching and listening Entities shone at such words.
The visage of the Cimmerian Architect stared at the massive blooming purple rift with scrutiny as her intuition buzzed!
The Purifier of Alchemy and the Anvil of Anarchos were silent as they took everything in.
In a limited fashion, Noah had said.
He was moving with caution for the Existential Dungeon Apocalypse as the first ones would have Tier 5s and Tier 6 Hyperversal Extremities in the lead!
Akin to what had happened to his home world where massive dungeon monoliths descended and brought down apocalypse.
In this stage of Extremity of his life, he would be the one to send down dungeons to spread an Existential Apocalypse that planned to conquer Vitalis and Vacuous!
And Noah knew that the moment this began...there would be no way back as whatever enemies there were would become much more apparent.
Their numbers.
Their power.
Their might!
For this, Noah had to watch and understand carefully.
But at this point in time, he was ready to give an initial run of the feature of Existential Dungeon Apocalypse!

chapters.title: Chapter 2847 Ushering Apocalypse Unto Vitalis and Vacuous Domains! II
paragraphs: Within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, there were now two massive Rift Portals- one cerulean and one blazing with a tyrannical royal purple light at the very center as around them...an even more titanic Extremity Vein in the form of an Infinity symbol has multiple Aletheian Havens drifting in its celestial system!

The many Entities within, whether they be from the past Seven Clans or Inheritances of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains...they all gazed towards the two portals with scrutiny as at this moment, a bundle of light fell above the head of each entity at the Third Gradation of Extremity or higher containing information on the newly introduced Existential Dungeon Apocalypse and what it would entail.

The figure of Henry bathed in tendrils of liquid gold light also felt the bundle of information fall in his head as he looked towards his father who was surrounded by entities at the Fifth and Sixth Gradation of Extremity.
He then gazed at the massive illusory screen that showed his own Mother and the other Queens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven fighting against a powerful foe!
He thought of his loss at the hands of Oppenheimer.
He gazed behind him and saw the fractured pride of the Emperor Penguin, the visage of Kazuhiko stroking his Katana while sighing deeply.
The figure of the Oathkeeper with a grim expression and the Kraken with eyes of blazing wrath!
Each of them were their own people as they held their own hopes and dreams, and he...had let them down.
They followed him, and he let them down!
He reflected on himself as he felt every single cell within him holding the highest purity of his father's lineage.
He felt the particles of Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny flowing within him.
He then felt his own dazzling destiny as it coursed through his heart and very being. In this state of reflection and despondency...Henry Osmont entered a unique state of mind.
Who was he?
For the past weeks and months since his conception, he was always trying to forge his own path and live up to the vast and endless shadow of his father.
Forge his own path...but why?
Why did he try to forge his own path? He was the son of the Extremity of Quintessence.
The son of the Ruler of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
He was his only progeny as this distinction...was it not a part of him?
{The Extremity of Harems smiles with a guiding light.}
Why did he try to forge his own path and deny a part of his existence? Why could his unique and only position as the Son of the Extremity of Quintessence not be a part of his strength?!
HUUM!
Henry's body began to radiate a terrifying Colorless light as Quintessence rose.
His bloodline woke up with ferocity as it was crying out, as if asking why it had taken him this long!
PAH!
Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Quintessence began to flow around him.
And as his existence buzzed under this shocking epiphany, he borrowed the power of Quintessence and pulled out his power that he had unconsciously suppressed this whole time.
And shocking prompts began to bloom before his eyes.
{The Extremity of Cheats makes the incoming alteration and distortion of reality flow with ease.}
{In a unique state of Quintessential Unity of Existence borrowed from your lineage, you have grasped onto some of the capabilities of your Father.}
{You have embarked on the path of the Extremity of Nepotism.}
{You have embarked on the path of the Extremity of the Chaebol.}
{You have embarked on the path of the Extremity of Progeny.}
{You have embarked on the path of the Extremity of Bloodlines.}
{You have embarked on the path of the Extremity of Royalty.}
{You have embarked on the path of the Extremity of Scions.}

His body shone with a blinding authority as a dense cluster of Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures began to swirl around him, each one brimming with its own intent and emotion as the Son of the Extremity of Quintessence fully accepted his position!
He accepted who he was, and he then took this to its extreme.
{The 12 Hour Penalty for a False Death has been erased under the Extremity of Nepotism.}
{The amount of loot you can gain from all Existential Raid Rifts is now tripled.}
{The Extremity of Bloodlines allows your already pure lineage to attain a profound closeness and purity to the Extremity of Quintessence.}
WAA!

The aura Henry radiated quickly exceeded the Third Gradation of Extremity as he fully stepped on the Fourth Gradation, his visage shining with a blinding golden light as he began his own ascension upwards!
The Son of the Extremity of Quintessence...would be capable of forging his path with power from this moment on as he relied on who he was to an alarming degree.
In the distance, Noah looked at this and smiled silently as his gaze came to focus on Ishtar and Sargon.
His mere gaze spoke louder than words as these two Entities looked at each other, their bodies radiating a blinding light a moment later as identical forms of themselves appeared beside them!
It was two Extremity Clones of the Tier 6 Anvil of Anarchos and the Purifier of Alchemy.

Ishtar's gaze was cloudy as she looked sharply at the figure of the Cimmerian Architect floating regally behind Noah, her eyes flickering and locking with Sargon a moment later as she sent him a mental message.
{A chance to get back at them for what they did to Aryenis was not even a possibility before. With this...there actually may be a way to stand against them.}
Within the span of a nanosecond, they began to share mental messages with each other as Sargon's eyes held deep mysteries and understanding.
{...Maybe. But missing an Existential Extremity Authority within me feels slightly hollow. I won't be able to fight as per normal...}
{Premonition tells me he'll take care of that.} Before he could finish his words, Ishtar replied to him while nodding towards Noah who held a smile of understanding towards them!

Amongst those who had achieved their stage of power and could begin reading the Intent of Extremes, understanding came easy as after ascertaining the intent of the Extremity of Quintessence, the Clones of Ishtar and Sargon made a beeline towards the royal purple Existential Dungeon Apocalypse Rift portal and disappeared with a flicker of brilliance!

{Premonition tells me he'll take care of that.} Before he could finish his words, Ishtar replied to him while nodding towards Noah who held a smile of understanding towards them!

Amongst those who had achieved their stage of power and could begin reading the Intent of Extremes, understanding came easy as after ascertaining the intent of the Extremity of Quintessence, the Clones of Ishtar and Sargon made a beeline towards the royal purple Existential Dungeon Apocalypse Rift portal and disappeared with a flicker of brilliance!

chapters.title: Chapter 2848 Ushering Apocalypse Unto Vitalis and Vacuous Domains! III
paragraphs: When Sargon came to once more, he found himself transported to an entirely new domain.
Seemingly enclosed in the depths of a celestial star, a domain as big as a Large World filled with walls glimmering with hazy purple crystals could be seen.

As one went towards its center, the purple crystalline earth rose up akin to a mountain as at its peak, a grand throne radiating the grandeur of tyranny stood empty, but in front of it...three blinding Planalith Krystallos floated serenely!
{You have arrived in the Raid Boss Throne Room.}
{The Extremity of Systems affirms your distinction as the First Existential Dungeon Raid Boss and asks you to choose between the three Existential Extremity Authorities to traverse.}
Sargon's eyes flickered as he remembered Ishtar's words.
Noah Osmont.
The Most Recent Honored One!
It seemed they had much to learn about this being as freely, he was able to produce three Middle Grade Planalith Krystallos of three different Existential Extremity Authorities.
Sargon's burly figure forged by years of smithing rose towards the peak of the crystalline mountain as he gazed at the three dazzling circular Krystallos.
He tried to read what their extremes stood for.
He tried to understand them, but they were too complex for him to grasp the intent of!
So he listened to his existence and...reached out towards the dazzling amethyst Planalith Krystallos.

He chose Tyranny as the moment he grasped it, a blinding light shone that caused the other Krystallos to disappear, and Sargon took his seat on the purple throne gloriously while he began to absorb the Middle Grade Tyranny Planalith Krystallos!
{You are embarking on the path of the Extremity of Tyranny!}

The First Existential Dungeon Raid Boss appeared and took his place as in another domain within the Records of the feature of Existential Dungeon Apocalypse, Ishtar also sat on her throne as a blinding light of Infinity was grasped in her hands.
They were the first two entrants.

Back in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, the Cimmerian Architect calculated and deduced as an Extremity Clone of hers formed soon enough, surging into the purple rift of light as her main body still remained close to Noah.
{A Clone in the Existential Dungeon Raid, and the Main Body grinding the Existential Raid Rift...I'll collect enough Krystallos to break through the Sixth Gradation soon enough!}
Her eyes shone with brilliance as she planned ahead.

Around her, and across the vast Infinite Hyperversal Haven, many Extremity Clones of Entities at the Third Gradation of Extremity and higher were formed as they all quickly entered the massive purple portal.
The Seer of Sima shook her head while the Extremity of Foundation stood beside her, her cane currently buzzing with power as she also formed a Clone.
{Alright, let's hope this Existential War is the War to end all Wars...otherwise, I really will just retire.}
She spoke as if she was an aged old lady, even though her existence was more powerful than any common Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity!
With a flash of light, she and tens of thousands of other Extremities were wrapped by the purple light of tyranny as they joined a path of profound conquest.

At the same time, Noah and the Infinite Hyperversal Haven were monitoring everything to ensure the construct enacted would work as planned, with Noah making the definitive command at this moment as his Will echoed out silently at this moment.
{Let two Existential Dungeon Monoliths descend...one in Vacuous Hyperversal Domains, and one in Vitalis Hyperversal Domains!}
Tyranny blared madly within his heart.
{The Extremity of Apocalypse cheers on with Indeterminate glee!}
{The Extremity of Entropy is enthralled by the ensuing chaos and disorder!}
{The Extremity of Paradox is eagerly interested in seeing the results to unfold.}
{The Extremity of Systems watches its design closely.}
{The Extremity of Quintessence fearlessly pushes the gears forward and commences the feature of the Existential Dungeon Apocalypse.}
HUUM!

A blinding royal purple light of tyranny shone, the purple Existential Dungeon Rift Portal causing a shocking pulling force that seemingly grabbed a tremendous amount of authority from the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, the titanic Extremity Vein coursing with authorities visibly showing tendrils of such pristine waves of energy surging from it and into the purple rift!
And with a flash of brilliance, an irreversible step was taken.
The weaving of Extremity entered a new stage.
A new form of warfare was unveiled!
The Extremity of Quintessence observed closely as at this moment, he could feel two Monoliths crossing existence and non-existence.
Crossing myriads of Recorded and Unrecorded Histories as their destination...were two domains!
Within the Haven of Anarchos.

A sea of white flames churned chaotically as the head of a huge white serpent could be seen swimming serenely, its power at the First Gradation of Extremity prevalent as all around it, the sea stretched out for light years.
It was known as a Three-Eyed Light Flame Serpent.
Its eyes gave off a look of magnificence and power as this area was its domain, and it-
BOOM!

Its thoughts came to a halt as the reality light years above it seethed, the pride and magnificence in the eyes of the Light Flame Serpent fading to be replaced with terror as reality above became torn!

From the torn reality, records seemed to be spilling out as a massive purple monolith the size of a Cosmos descended- its mere existence radiating a shocking amount of power that caused anything near it to feel a sense of suffocation!
The moment it appeared, its royal purple light began to spread with a terrific pulling force as it seemed like the very surrounding reality was being drawn into it.
But not a nanosecond since in appearance...
RUMBLE!
The space above and around it shook heavily.
And an instant later, terrifying tendrils of Vacuous Extremity Authority converged and thundered down ragefully onto the massive purple Monolith!
BOOM! BOOM!

Within the flaming white sea, the body of the Light Flame Serpent trembled in fear at this scene as it stood anchored in its position, being the only Entity privy to what happened next as even with the heavy and terrifying thundering of obsidian tendrils of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority...the massive purple Monolith remained untouched!
Its spreading purple light remained unfettered.
A millisecond passed as just as quickly as the terrifying obsidian tendrils of light had descended, they faded.
And thereafter...
WAP!

Space tore open once more as if Records were spilling out into the open, and a figure that nearly caused the soul of the Light Flame Serpent in the far distant sea to shatter just by being somewhat near in proximity appeared!

chapters.title: Chapter 2849 Ushering Apocalypse Unto Vitalis and Vacuous Domains! IV
paragraphs: Within the Existential Dungeon Monolith that had made its descent in the Haven of Anarchos.

Inside pockets of records and infoldings of reality, the Raid Boss Throne Room stood strong as in this one, dazzling cerulean miniature dwarf stars flowed gorgeously all around in starry rivers, a cluster of them forming a massive throne that Ishtar now sat on as she was halfway through absorbing an ultramarine colored Planalith Krystallos!
Cerulean Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures had already begun to swirl around her as her pupils radiated a powerful blue light.
Beside her throne, the figure of the Extremity Clone of the Cimmerian Architect could be seen, along with the visage of the record of the Annals Inquisitor and the Seer of Sima!

All of them held gazes of slight trepidation at this moment as in front of them, blue dwarf stars clustered together to form an illusory screen that showed the region outside of the Monolith they had arrived in.
{Anarchos...}

The Cimmerian Architect spoke slowly the moment they arrived as before any of them could get their bearings, their surroundings thundered with obsidian storms of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority that caused them to feel a light of Extinction from it!
This was where their sense of trepidation came from.
Across eons, the Ones Above Extremity were always feared and rarely spoken about- with their power being absolute!

Could the construct of the Extremity of Quintessence truly protect them from their terrifying might within these Existential Dungeons? Based on the bundles of information they shifted through, the Ones Above Extremity themselves wouldn't even be able to enter these dungeons, much less destroy them.
What a terrifying capability that was if the Extremity of Quintessence had truly grasped it.

For him to be able to deny entry to entities either associated with or holding the identity of the Ones Above Extremity! And at this moment...they actually bore witness to the claims of the Extremity of Quintessence.

The terrifying tendrils of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority that could wantonly extinguish entities on the Gradations of Extremity...washed over the exterior of the massive Monolith they were in as they were unaffected.
The Existential Dungeon Monolith itself remained unaffected!
{Haa, Fuck...} The Cimmerian Architect breathed out a sigh as she felt her heart settling.
{I mean, not that I doubted him, but to be able to do this is pretty ridiculous isn't it?}
She continued to speak within this isolated room as Ishtar and the others were silent with a heavy atmosphere, and before anyone could reply...
BOOM...WAP!
Space twisted and ripped as an instant after the tendrils of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority didn't work, an entity that seemed like a billowing spillage of Records and ancientness stepped out.
They were grand in stature as their size was akin to a tenth of a Cosmos- a tenth of the size of the Existential Dungeon Monolith that had appeared with its blazing royal purple light!
Their body...was a striking one to see as even though it was humanoid in nature, it didn't hold any clothing or adornments as their physique seemed to be made of pure dazzling obsidian light.

Their very existence emanated a profound symphony of nothing else other than Vacuous and Vacuous alone- as if with a single wave of this Entity's hand, all of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority could be mobilized.

On their back, a pair of blazing obsidian wings closely resembling those of eonic butterflies stretched out majestically, each of them having a white eye at their very center that seemed capable of distorting existence itself!
Their body seemed like a systemic engine of Vacuous Extremity Authority as it constantly glowed with authority that traveled upwards to their face.

Their face...that held no mouth or nose, only a single fiery serpentine eye whose pupil blazed with black flames. Intricate horns rose above their ancient head as a similar, single eye with just as much power and majesty could be seen on their chest- its brilliance and serpentine glare being just as stunning!
Their appearance caused a sense of trepidation in those within the Raid Boss Throne Room as everyone was somber.
This was because none of them...could gauge what stage in the Gradations of Extremity this being was in.
Yet in front of this entity they saw on the illusory screen that displayed the surroundings of the Monolith, all of them felt as small as ants!
As if this Entity could just step on th-
BZZT!

When they just had this thought, they shockingly saw the right leg of this Entity rise up and strike down as if they were swinging- their perception not fully capturing it as an instant later, a massive tenebrous foot materialized with raging extremes of nothingness, being ten times as massive as the cosmic sized Monolith!

The Extremities within the bodies of all those in the Raid Boss Throne Room pulsed and activated as if they felt their very existence was in danger, the massive foot stomping into the Monolith as if it were stepping on mere ants before it!
But...
BZZT!
There seemed to be a terrifying force that denied the intricate weaving of droves of innumerable Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures stacked on top of each other.
The massive and intricate layering of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vacuous was repulsed without smashing into the Monolith due to an undeniable force.
An undeniable force that placed constraints on both sides equally.
It was the force of Absolute Existential Authorities and Limitations!
For a particular existential authority, one could place upon themselves an equally existential limitation!

An immense amount of power was required for this shocking usage of Existential Extremity Authorities, and over 50% of all operating costs of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven were directed towards enforcing this.
Noah himself could not be involved in the Existential Dungeon Apocalypse, and nor could the Primogenitors or Controllers of the other Existential Extremity Authority he was Invading.
At this moment, this ruling was upheld in a shocking show of a clash of Existential Extremity Authorities!
The entity shrouded in dazzling obsidian light stably allowed their legs to descend after this scene as their eyes blinked and became eerily sharp.

They gazed at the pulsing Monolith and its authority that seemed to already be slowly devouring the surrounding Records silently as inside it, those in the Raid Boss Throne Room breathed heavily as if they were the ones just attacked, their souls buzzing in a sensation of unrealized fear!
