chapters.title: Chapter 2850 Ushering Apocalypse Unto Vitalis and Vacuous Domains! V
paragraphs: {Fuck!}
The Cimmerian Architect cursed out loud at the sensation of fear as she placed her hand on her chest and regulated her extremes.
She felt what even Ishtar on her throne felt.
That the single swing of the foot of this Entity could erase them entirely out of existence effortlessly!
This feeling...was not a great one to have.
They could not even see the depth of their enemy.
They couldn't properly grasp or understand their power.
But their very existence and Concepts of Extremity told them they couldn't stand against such an Entity!

And a millisecond after this Entity had tried eviscerating the Existential Dungeon Monolith out of existence and saw the resulting action, they continued to stare at it coldly as within their single serpentine pupils, one could see immense power and ancientness burning.
And a moment after...
RIIP! RIIP!
Records tore to the left and right of this Entity as beings of similar stature to it appeared!
Similar humanoid bodies that seemed like the convergence of millions or even billions of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures.

A pair of wings that held eyes on their very center, with the eyes on the pairs of each of these Entities holding variations within their pupils as undoubtedly, their faces only held a single serpentine eye and one on their chests that burned with glorious obsidian flames.
The two newly appearing Entities gazed at the apocalyptic monolith that had appeared silently as they turned towards the being that had appeared here first.
And...
The eyes on the center of their wings released unseen vibrations and intent of indiscernible extremes as these Entities...communicated.
Indiscernible.
Something that others could not even begin to understand!
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
In a domain veiled upon layers and layers of Records.

Liquified waves of existential authority flowed as a dazzling throne in the form of an infinity symbol lay empty, the manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven not currently situated on it as her figure could be seen floating beside the imposing visage of the Extremity of Quintessence!

She stood to his right as the crimson gold visage of Ruination stood on Noah's left, their surroundings roiling with starry and gorgeous Existential Extremity Authorities as they had their gazes focused on what was ahead.
Standing at the forefront, Noah gazed at the two illusory screens ahead of them that showed the unfolding reality around the two Existential Dungeon Monoliths he had sent down.
One had entities bathed in obsidian light, with butterfly-like wings and a blazing eye on their head and their chest.
This was the Existential Dungeon Monolith that arrived in Anarchos.
The second Existential Dungeon Monolith with Sargon in it at the lead had arrived in the Haven of Dissolution as here...they were able to see similar figures of comparative size and stature appear!
The ones within the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains had humanoid Entities of similar stature, but bathed in a holy white transparent light of Vitalis.

In the Haven of Dissolution, two such beings appeared simultaneously and tried to eradicate the Existential Dungeon Monolith before they stopped a moment after they affirmed the Absolute Existential Authorities and Limitations wrapping around it.
At the scenes, Noah's gaze was fiery as he knew the moment he began this, he would set off a chain of events that would not be stopped.
He would get a chance to see his enemies for who they truly were as when he stared at them now...
{What are you? Are you connected to the Ones Above Extremity...or are you such an Entity yourself? Primogenitors? Controllers? Influencers?}
Which Entities was he exactly looking at right now?
Were they ones that stood Above Extremity, or were they Entities still within the Gradations of Extremity? This...he couldn't tell!

But when their winds began to release indescribable vibrations...the flames within Noah's pupils buzzed as he was shocked to find out that they were communicating with none other than the intents of their extremes.
Their language was one that could only be understood if one could see the weaving of their Extremes!

The flames around his pupils burned furiously as he found that at this moment, he couldn't grasp the weaving of the Extremes around these beings as even from afar, they gave him a great sense of oppression.

And this seemed like a challenge to his own existence as Oraculum began to burn ever brighter, his pupils becoming outlined with heavily burning flames as Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny began to pulse heavily!
He focused on the three obsidian Entities as even while gazing at them...
{Undefined Existence}
{Undefined Existence}
{Undefined Existence}

This was the only burst of information he could come up with. And when all three of his Existential Extremity Authorities supported his existence as Oraculum burned brightly...he tried to read the weaving of the intents of the language of these beings!
The first entity to appear squinted the single serpentine eye on his head as to his right, the eyes centered on the wings of the other Undefined Existence vibrated.
The moment this entity finished expressing his intent, the eye on his chest turned down eerily as his dazzling hand then pointed down and beckoned towards the churning white sea of Anarchos.

From its depths, a terrified Light Flame Serpent was instantly pulled up as with a flicker of the hand of the Undefined Existence, the massive body of this Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity was tossed towards the Existential Dungeon Monolith.
A flicker of purple light flashed, and the Light Flame Serpent disappeared into it.
It was a surreal scene.
The butterfly like wings of the Undefined Existence that had done this buzzed powerfully as they were about to release another intent when...
It came to a halt.
The predatory eye on its head and on its chest instantly burned with the light of millions of Extremity Rune Scriptures as they locked onto the Existential Dungeon Monolith.
It seemed to be staring straight at the monolith, but its cold and emotionless eyes...currently seemed centered on the illusory screen Noah and the others were looking at!
As if...it could see that other parties were gazing at it.
HUUM!

The eye on the chest of this Undefined Existence then pulsed and released a terrifying mass of Obsidian darkness that instantly wrapped the surroundings of the massive Monolith, and the clear illusory screen in front of Noah's eyes was instantly obscured with complete darkness as they could no longer see anything!

At the same time, Noah felt the hands of Ruination tenderly land on his face with concern as her crimson gold skin very quickly became painted with a bloody liquid gold, with Noah coming out of a trance as he realized from his burning eyes, golden blood had begun to drip down ever so slowly.
This...was from him analyzing his enemies and trying to grasp just their communications.
This...was from him coming in contact for the first time with the Entities feared and made ancient stories about in the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains!

sentences.text: {Fuck!}
The Cimmerian Architect cursed out loud at the sensation of fear as she placed her hand on her chest and regulated her extremes.
She felt what even Ishtar on her throne felt.
That the single swing of the foot of this Entity could erase them entirely out of existence effortlessly!
This feeling...was not a great one to have.
They could not even see the depth of their enemy.
They couldn't properly grasp or understand their power.
But their very existence and Concepts of Extremity told them they couldn't stand against such an Entity!

And a millisecond after this Entity had tried eviscerating the Existential Dungeon Monolith out of existence and saw the resulting action, they continued to stare at it coldly as within their single serpentine pupils, one could see immense power and ancientness burning.
And a moment after...
RIIP!
RIIP!
Records tore to the left and right of this Entity as beings of similar stature to it appeared!
Similar humanoid bodies that seemed like the convergence of millions or even billions of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures.

A pair of wings that held eyes on their very center, with the eyes on the pairs of each of these Entities holding variations within their pupils as undoubtedly, their faces only held a single serpentine eye and one on their chests that burned with glorious obsidian flames.
The two newly appearing Entities gazed at the apocalyptic monolith that had appeared silently as they turned towards the being that had appeared here first.
And...
The eyes on the center of their wings released unseen vibrations and intent of indiscernible extremes as these Entities...communicated.
Indiscernible.
Something that others could not even begin to understand!
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
In a domain veiled upon layers and layers of Records.

Liquified waves of existential authority flowed as a dazzling throne in the form of an infinity symbol lay empty, the manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven not currently situated on it as her figure could be seen floating beside the imposing visage of the Extremity of Quintessence!

She stood to his right as the crimson gold visage of Ruination stood on Noah's left, their surroundings roiling with starry and gorgeous Existential Extremity Authorities as they had their gazes focused on what was ahead.
Standing at the forefront, Noah gazed at the two illusory screens ahead of them that showed the unfolding reality around the two Existential Dungeon Monoliths he had sent down.
One had entities bathed in obsidian light, with butterfly-like wings and a blazing eye on their head and their chest.
This was the Existential Dungeon Monolith that arrived in Anarchos.
The second Existential Dungeon Monolith with Sargon in it at the lead had arrived in the Haven of Dissolution as here...they were able to see similar figures of comparative size and stature appear!
The ones within the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains had humanoid Entities of similar stature, but bathed in a holy white transparent light of Vitalis.

In the Haven of Dissolution, two such beings appeared simultaneously and tried to eradicate the Existential Dungeon Monolith before they stopped a moment after they affirmed the Absolute Existential Authorities and Limitations wrapping around it.
At the scenes, Noah's gaze was fiery as he knew the moment he began this, he would set off a chain of events that would not be stopped.
He would get a chance to see his enemies for who they truly were as when he stared at them now...
{What are you?
Are you connected to the Ones Above Extremity...or are you such an Entity yourself?
Primogenitors?
Controllers?
Influencers?}
Which Entities was he exactly looking at right now?
Were they ones that stood Above Extremity, or were they Entities still within the Gradations of Extremity?
This...he couldn't tell!

But when their winds began to release indescribable vibrations...the flames within Noah's pupils buzzed as he was shocked to find out that they were communicating with none other than the intents of their extremes.
Their language was one that could only be understood if one could see the weaving of their Extremes!

The flames around his pupils burned furiously as he found that at this moment, he couldn't grasp the weaving of the Extremes around these beings as even from afar, they gave him a great sense of oppression.

And this seemed like a challenge to his own existence as Oraculum began to burn ever brighter, his pupils becoming outlined with heavily burning flames as Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny began to pulse heavily!
He focused on the three obsidian Entities as even while gazing at them...
{Undefined Existence}
{Undefined Existence}
{Undefined Existence}
This was the only burst of information he could come up with.
And when all three of his Existential Extremity Authorities supported his existence as Oraculum burned brightly...he tried to read the weaving of the intents of the language of these beings!
The first entity to appear squinted the single serpentine eye on his head as to his right, the eyes centered on the wings of the other Undefined Existence vibrated.
The moment this entity finished expressing his intent, the eye on his chest turned down eerily as his dazzling hand then pointed down and beckoned towards the churning white sea of Anarchos.

From its depths, a terrified Light Flame Serpent was instantly pulled up as with a flicker of the hand of the Undefined Existence, the massive body of this Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity was tossed towards the Existential Dungeon Monolith.
A flicker of purple light flashed, and the Light Flame Serpent disappeared into it.
It was a surreal scene.
The butterfly like wings of the Undefined Existence that had done this buzzed powerfully as they were about to release another intent when...
It came to a halt.
The predatory eye on its head and on its chest instantly burned with the light of millions of Extremity Rune Scriptures as they locked onto the Existential Dungeon Monolith.
It seemed to be staring straight at the monolith, but its cold and emotionless eyes...currently seemed centered on the illusory screen Noah and the others were looking at!
As if...it could see that other parties were gazing at it.
HUUM!

The eye on the chest of this Undefined Existence then pulsed and released a terrifying mass of Obsidian darkness that instantly wrapped the surroundings of the massive Monolith, and the clear illusory screen in front of Noah's eyes was instantly obscured with complete darkness as they could no longer see anything!

At the same time, Noah felt the hands of Ruination tenderly land on his face with concern as her crimson gold skin very quickly became painted with a bloody liquid gold, with Noah coming out of a trance as he realized from his burning eyes, golden blood had begun to drip down ever so slowly.
This...was from him analyzing his enemies and trying to grasp just their communications.
This...was from him coming in contact for the first time with the Entities feared and made ancient stories about in the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains!

chapters.title: Chapter 2851 Ushering Apocalypse Unto Vitalis and Vacuous Domains! VI
paragraphs: His eyes bled with golden blood.
On them, the burning flames of Oraculum were extremely heavy and active as if they had seen something exciting, and yet it also held a great sense of apprehension and unknown surrounding it!
Undefined Existences.
These were what had come down since Noah ushered in his Apocalypse, and from this point onwards, he would only be shown more of how their authority and power worked as he learned about these enemies!

In front of him, Ruination tenderly passed her fingers below Noah's eyes as the golden blood coming down stopped and was burned away. Her eyes held fearsome anger as if she wanted to grind down the one responsible for causing the eyes of the Extremity of Quintessence to bleed, not mattering in her heart whether such beings were within the Gradations of Extremity or not!
Noah's voice echoed out as he craned his neck and took stock of his Existential Extremity Authorities.
{My existence is inclined to say they're likely at the 9th Gradation of Extremity, that they haven't exceeded the Gradations of Extremity themselves...}
This was what he currently felt.

And even this thought was a terrifying one as if it were true, it meant the power he had just seen displayed was only the very minuscule tip- and it wasn't even one that exceeded the Gradations of Extremity!
That what he was looking at were not even the genuine Entities termed the Ones Above Extremity.

The reason for this was simply the fact that from the little Noah could discern, the glances of these entities showed the convergence of millions of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures from their movements and any weaving of their extremes that he could grasp.
It was a heavy and shocking power, but it should still be in the scope of the Gradations of Extremity!
{Likely. The next few moments will be extremely critical...}
Behind Noah and Ruination, the voice of the manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven echoed out as terrifying tendrils of existential authority coursed around it.
The next few moments would be extremely critical, yes.
The response of their enemies would be shown as this would give them a better picture of their influence and power across the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
Since they themselves couldn't enter, who would they send forth?
Gazing at the obsidian illusory screen that now showed nothing of the movements of his enemies, Noah nodded while around him, plasmic flames of Oraculum began to converge.

{Yes. We'll uncover the layers of history and records...on whether across the eons, the Ones Above Extremity held and maintained contact with any of those in the Eighth Gradation of Extremity or lower. Whether any of the Primogenitors of Vitalis and Vacuous are under their heel, or if in their supremacy and history of shooting down those who shine too bright...all they have within the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains are dissidents and fearing Entities who do not trust them.}
WAA!
Noah outlined the possible realities forward.
Frankly, he very much preferred the reality where the Ones Above Extremity would have no followers they could quickly mobilize.
That they would have no defenders to fight on their behalf and that their reaction against him would be a weak one!
But...he also knew that things were never so easy.
What was in store in this war was the very makeup of Existence and non-existence.
The very being of Vacuous and Vitalis.
They had existed for untold eons as Noah knew...when placed in jeopardy, their response would be something he may not currently even be theorizing!
After all, if he placed himself in their position.

If the Infinite Hyperversal Haven had foreign substances appear within that would weaken and ultimately destroy his Existential Extremity Authorities of Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny...he knew what terrifying lengths he would go to!
{Release an Existential Dungeon Gift Pack for all current entrants within it. Let them be even more prepared.}
As tendrils of golden Oraculum began to gather around him, Noah gave the command as the Infinite Hyperversal Haven nodded.

On the side of the dazzling throne made of an Infinity symbol, two mountains of loot were being built and rising at a shocking pace, with the multiplicative light of Ruination wrapping around all newly appearing loot constantly as a wondrous system of the emergence of loot was formed!
Instantly, over half of the mountains of loot holding Cerulean, Colorless, and Amethyst colored Planalith Krystallos disappeared into a glimmer of light.
The number...was in the tens of thousands to match those at the Third Gradation of Extremity or higher who had entered the two currently active Existential Dungeon Monoliths.
Tens of thousands of Existential Low Grade Planalith Krystallos.
And they...were just merely a fraction of what the Infinite Hyperversal Haven was producing with the aid of Ruination!

To truly understand where Noah currently was, one had to take stock and understand that since he stretched his Records towards Infinity within a second and attained Extremity within it, only another few seconds had passed.
Since he attained Extremity and the Infinite Hyperversal Haven began its unimaginable production of Armaments of Extremity and Planalith Krystallos, only seconds had passed.
That was just how obscene and balance breaking it was.
That there were already Planalith Krystallos to support tens of thousands freely.
That there were already a terrifying amount of Armaments of Extremity.
All of this was present within the span of seconds as this was why Noah was calm and not despairing even at the power that his enemies unveiled.
With him in the lead, he would be ushering in an era of traversal of the Gradations of Extremity that had never been seen or imagined before.
The reality of it taking thousands or millions of years to traverse across the Gradations was already being abolished by him, and it would only accelerate.
From what he and the Infinite Hyperversal Haven could currently do...he would be capable of mass producing entities that very rapidly broke across the Gradations in obscene numbers!
Yes, his enemies were strong. But what changes would there be to him and the Infinite Hyperversal Haven after a few minutes?
After a few hours or even a day?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2852 Ushering Apocalypse Unto Vitalis and Vacuous Domains! VII
paragraphs: The possibilities under Noah and what he could do were endless!

It was this power that gave him solace in these times of uncertainties and Undefined enemies, his grand visage floating back and sinking into the dazzling throne formed from a curved Infinity symbol as he was now surrounded by heavy flames of Oraculum.
{Bring it on...}
With a tyrannical light of majesty, he spoke towards the screen of darkness he could no longer see anything through as he waited.
A moment after, tens of dazzling illusory screens arose as they showed the scenes within the Dungeon Monoliths within Anarchos and Dissolution.
He was ready for the response of his enemies- whatever it may be!
Between the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.

An ongoing war was put into high gear as in the last seconds, the Titanic visage of the worm-like Prime Devourer appeared on the chaotic battlefield, his oppressive aura spreading out madly and openly as it seemed like the battle was about to enter a shocking new stage!
With his involvement, powerful Primogenitors of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains would also likely be getting involved as a form of warfare full of casualties would begin.
The Primogenitor of the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Extremity Lineage had transformed into an utter menace at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity as just when he was about to unleash his might...
WAP!
His massive body disappeared.

The scene was a stark one for the Vitalis Hyperversal Legions as Emperor Shao who stood beside a Tier 5 Vitalis Entity that looked like an aged old man placed his hand that held a communication medallion down.
He was about to call for aid from the Celestia Extremity Lineage as now, he didn't fully know what was happening!
{Just what is going on...}
With Vitalis wrapping tightly around him, he wondered what all of this ensuing chaos meant!
But far from this location.
Across the foldings of reality and non-reality.
Within the Haven of Anarchos, above the churning white sea...
WAP! WAP!
The dazzling humanoid figure of the Prime Devourer and the massive figure of his Extremity Clone in his form as the Primogenitor of the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Extremity Lineage appeared.

Yet the moment he did, his existence began to tremble as behind him, a royal purple light devouring all nearby records was blazing while in front of him...there were three stifling figures that caused even he who was in the Sixth Gradation of Extremity to feel like a mere ant!

He saw three terrifying existences surrounded by a glorious obsidian light, with terrifying wings spanning behind them that held ancient serpentine eyes at their center, with their chest and head holding similar eyes filled with a terrifying light of power and majesty as their gazes alone were enough to cause his soul to feel a great sense of oppression.
The Prime Devourer felt the stillness of existence itself while in front of these beings as he kneeled with his humanoid true body and bowed with his huge worm like figure.
{O Celebrious Ones, I thank you for your previous compassion.}
He remembered the power that had flowed into him and elevated him from the Fifth to the Sixth Gradation of Extremity as he spoke in a heavy and respectful tone.
He never thought it was free.
He always knew it would come with a price!
And as he waited for a reply, he shockingly felt the Extremity Rune Scriptures within his very soul pulse as from within them, an intent flowed out.
|Observe and Report|
An intent was passed through the Extremity of Vacuous that caused his back to bend even more.
In his astonishment, he saw the centermost Celebrious One move his hand as without his control, his Extremity Clone in the form of the giant Worm was flung towards the amethyst Dungeon Monolith!
His main body remained in this place as he...came to understand his purpose.
At the same time, he wondered.
Who the hell would dare to do something that required the intervention of the Ones Above Extremity? And why would such a thing even require the intervention of someone as small as him?
He didn't have the answer, but he would simply do as he was told.
Observe and Report!
BOOM!
The Existential Dungeon Monolith vibrated as another entrant went into it.
In the Raid Boss Throne Room, Ishtar saw an illusory scene rise up that showed the massive body of a Yog-Nyarvax Worm appearing in a domain that held shattered singularities and dead stars.
{A Defender of equivalent Gradations to the Raid Boss has entered the Dungeon. Would you like to transport them to the Raid Boss Throne Room?}
Such a prompt rose before her as the domain the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Worm appeared in was filled with a hundred Entities at Tier 3. They would be bulldozed within milliseconds as...
{What? How did this fucking guy attain the Sixth Gradation?}
The foul mouth of the Cimmerian Architect opened in surprise as Ishtar made a choice.
And a moment later, in the massive Throne Room, the crimson black wriggling skin of the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Worm appeared.

The pressure he released was just slightly less than the dominant air that Ishtar had while seated on her throne, and his will spread out in his surroundings instantly as he was shocked to see the Cimmerian Architect and the gorgeous figure of another Primogenitor renowned in the Records of the Vacuous Annals of Extremity here!
{You? You would blatantly stand against the Ones Above Extremity?!}
His devouring will boomed out.
His existence felt a myriad of pulsing intents of extremes weave as he felt like he had truly settled on a new purpose.
What if the holy wars between Vacuous and Vitalis?
What of the conflicts that had gone on for eons?
If he was chosen to be a blade for the Ones Above Extremity- the ones they all feared and revered...could there be a greater purpose?
BOOM!

Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vacuous began to spill from him madly as undaunted by the throngs of enemies, the first True Defender of the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains entered an Existential Dungeon and faced its invaders!

chapters.title: Chapter 2853 Terrifying Means! I
paragraphs: The reality playing out within the Raid Boss Throne Room of the Existential Dungeon Monolith that had appeared within Anarchos was an astonishing one.
But it was also a reality that was not entirely hidden from the eyes of pertinent entities!

Outside of the Monolith, the eyes of the Main Body of the Prime Devourer were wide open as they shot out beams of dark light that came to reflect an illusory screen that displayed everything his Extremity Clone was seeing.

The three Entities he called the Celebrious Ones gazed at the scene coldly as the one who had appeared first, the Undefined Existence floating at the very center...was the first to express his will as Extremity was weaved together uniquely into a certain frequency that could only be understood by the two around it!
|So the insurgent is the same one. And he is quickly extending his reach and corruption as that little thing...|
The single eye of the foremost Celebrious One squinted while weaving its intent to focus on the figure of Ishtar.

|...that little thing was not under the banner of this Insurgent seconds ago. It has now become another Lost Seed. And such a thing occurred without our knowledge, meaning the Insurgent already has the means to mask himself outside the scope of our gaze.|
The way the Entity spoke was unique and told a tremendous amount of information about its standing.
One was the way they referred to entities like Ishtar.
It.
Little thing.
Lost Seed.
As if Ishtar wasn't a pertinent existence or entity under their eyes!
Besides the foremost Celebrious One, the Undefined Existence to the right spoke next.
|Don't forget the fact that the Insurgent can already utilize Existential Restrictions. Missing him was a grave mistake that we will be punished for. How did he slip through the cracks?|

|He didn't slip through. He was placed under observation as a Sui Generis Cultivated Seed since both Vacuous and Vitalis were being refined by him. When he veered off track, he was stricken out of the Records procedurally. But yes, he has found a way to bypass our gazes. Whether by coincidence or intentionally, multiple things occurred simultaneously.|
The conversation was a heavy one that if other entities heard, they may very well question their own existence and purpose.
Their own reason for living in the first place and for seeking Extremity!
And yet these beings weaved their intent and spoke simply as they watched the unfolding scene playing out in the Raid Boss Throne Room.
|His Insurgent Existential Authority may lean towards ambiguity and paradoxes. His Records are gone, but I do recall whispers of Infinity and Quintessence. His-|
|It.|
The Undefined Existence at the centermost location interrupted as his intent blazed out with obsidian brilliance.

|It. Do not give it any more distinction than necessary. It is still but a Seed that has merely become more cognizant. Before the corruption of this Seed spreads, it must be erased. A report must also be made and sent above about this change. After eons of calm cultivation, we have just come across an unruly animal that needs to be reined in, caught, and be made an example of.|
|Before it's corruption spreads further.|

|Before it's corruption spreads even more, yes. It may begin to give off pheromones and weavings of hopes and possibilities, so it must not be allowed to get close to the other Seeds, especially any Sui Generis Cultivated Seeds under watch.|

|But this brings the issue of the Existential Restriction. We cannot enter ourselves, and we can't send in any pertinent Seeds that may be corrupted and further exacerbate this issue. Seeing the dim Seeds it has put forth in this construct, the means of this Insurgent are still weak with little ammunition. It cannot gain any more headway. Of course, when it comes to possible Seeds that will not be corrupted...|
The gazes of all three turned and locked onto the visage of the Prime Devourer.
As if he could see their gazes, his existence trembled unstably under the pressure!
|The Seeds considering it an enemy will not be corrupted. Just...the quality of this Seed is abysmal.|
The Prime Devourer continued to shoot beams of light from his eyes that showed the events occurring within the Raid Boss Throne Room as he didn't know the contents of the conversation occurring.
He only did his best to maintain a respectful demeanor before the entities he called Celebrious Ones as he only felt like he became a target of their gazes!

|Even if the quality of the Seed is abyssal, raising it across the Gradations is still feasible. There are other enemy seeds of the Insurgent under the Vitalis Domains. Those Whitehats should be thinking alongside the same lines as us since another one of these constructs fell in their domain.|
|Of course, we can also see about the means of bypassing the Existential Restriction and take care of things ourselves, but for this...we will need guidance from above.|

|That will be admitting our weakness to handle this matter. We will have no use then. After all, this is just another Insurgent. One that has gotten further than most, but an Insurgent nonetheless. And there have never been any successful insurgents.|
|No, there will always be Vacuous, and there will always be Vitalis. Even if everything has to be erased to start anew, this will never change.|

|Of course. But the aim is never to reach such a path. Otherwise, uncountable eons will be for nought. No...for this Insurgent, we have to be quick and decisive, but it will not be too much trouble. Even when thinking of the Corruption it may already cause, there are still many other means we could utilize...|
WAA!

|Ameldyra, scour the Gradations of Extremity for signs of this Insurgent. Keep a line of communication with the Whitehats to see if they have observed anything else. And most of all...observe the Records of prominent Seeds, those that can be bent and those that cannot. And you never know, we may need to enact a play as Seeds after all this time...|

chapters.title: Chapter 2854 Terrifying Means! II
paragraphs: |Understood, Cavalier Tseviax.|
Intents weaved and flowed as they veiled shocking machinations and wonders within.
The Undefined Existence to the right who was referred to as Ameldyra gave a nod of acknowledgement towards the Undefined Existence at the very center that she referred to as Cavalier Tseviax!

The three Undefined Existences spoke amongst each other as within moments, the center-most one, Cavalier Tseviax, snapped their fingers as below the figure of the Prime Devourer, space split open once more as droves of Records spilled out.
This time, a deeply tenebrous light emerged as if jaws were opening up that would swallow everything, with the existence of the Prime Devourer beginning to tremble but...
HUUM!

He found that an obsidian bubbling pool appeared below him, and a clear black circular crystal floated at its very center as atop it- the illusory figure of an entity closely resembling the Celebrious Ones floating in front of him could be seen!

The Prime Devourer blinked as he felt his body be pulled towards the black circular crystal atop this blood pool resembling an Altar, his humanoid figure coming to stand at its very center as the illusion of a Celebrious One became superimposed with his existence.
Thereafter, he simply heard a voice stemming from his Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vacuous.
|Rejoice.|
BZZT!

The deeply tenebrous liquid within the Altar churned as from its depths, dazzling and radiant obsidian Planalith Krystallos emanating waves of nothingness and nonexistence arose and began to spin around him!
Thereafter...
{...! GAAAA!}

The Prime Devourer felt like his very existence began to be torn into pieces as the obsidian Altar bloomed with a shocking devouring force, parts of himself being taken away as new things were replaced in their stead!
Pain.
Immense pain as if his very records were being re-written!

But this pain was worth it as wondrously, the Prime Devourer felt his stagnant and rapid arrival in the Sixth Gradation of Extremity actually begin to edge upwards, his Soul also feeling the exponential increase of his Extremity Rune Scriptures by the hundreds of thousands.
He wanted to scream and cry out, but he held himself in as he knew he couldn't show the Celebrious Ones before him such a sorry state.

He had to show that he had the strength to bear the gracious baptism the Celebrious Ones were giving to him right now, and that he would be an immutable chosen champion of these beings without an issue!
Such emotion was relayed and could be earnestly felt within his soul as even the figures of the Celebrious Ones before the Prime Devourer felt it easily.
The Celebrious One Ameldyra had the eyes on their chest shine with calm ridicule as their voice echoed out for only them to hear.

|Look at this imbecilic Seed and his grand aspirations. You would think the ones on the Gradations of Extremity at least would not be as cretinous and uncultivated...but they continue to disappoint. Until now, I cannot grasp how Seeds such as these ever-|
|Now now.|
The words of Ameldyra were stopped as Cavalier Tseviax raised his hand up while the serpentine pupils within his eyes swiveled and gazed around eerily.

|Do not reveal the weaving of any unnecessary information. You never know whether it is being recorded, nor if any eyes will gaze upon it. And the intent of the words you were about to say are not ones that should be uttered freely in a domain such as this. Especially not until we can grasp the nature of the Existential Extremity Authority the Insurgent has managed to grasp.|

Terrifying sets of words were mixed in the intents of their extremes as on the body of the Undefined Existence at the very center, a dark light heavier than any before it began to gather in obscene amounts and of much greater quality!
The serpentine pupils on its head, chest, and wings blared with magnificence as its intent echoed out.

|The Weaving of Records, Existence, and Extremity are of insurmountable importance as no breadcrumbs should be left behind for anyone to pick up. Ages of Extremes come and go, but only their weavings remain intact. Always obscure this weaving as much as possible, and...|
An ineffable light bloomed and wrapped around this unfolding reality- this unfolding Record as...
The record was seemingly no longer in existence.
In the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.

Two Undefined Vitalis Existences floated before a blazing purple Monolith, their skin and very being radiating a powerful transparent white light as the butterfly like wings behind them pulsed with intense majesty.

In front of them, three transparent white Altars pulsing with an overabundance of life could be seen as on top of circular alabaster crystal, the figures of the Extremity of Lunacy, the Seer of Avernus, and the Avernus Extremity Overlord could all be seen in their own respective altars-with their images being superimposed with the glorious form of the porcelain white Undefined Existences!

|A Dungeon...a primitive thing but also a genius thing at the same time. Its corruption and entropy will continue to spread overtime as if the source holding it together as per the Existential Restriction isn't destroyed, an even larger burst of corruption should take place. This insurgent is a unique one. I wish to dissect his Existence like all the others and understand what mutation- what deviant gene within it was coded wrongly to allow it to expand an Existential Extreme and stay under our radar at the same time.|
The Undefined Vitalis Existence on the left spoke as the one on the right swiveled the pupil on their chest while replying.

|All the other Seeds we have dissected held nothing special, just variations of the makeup of their Souls grasping the frequency of a profound Weaving. Even the Existential Extremes they sought to expand were nothing special in their weak state. This thing...it is different in what it had managed to achieve. I added this to the report for better directions on how we can proceed forward. Because these dredges in front of us...|

The Undefined Vitalis Existence locked their serpentine pupils on the figures of Extremity Blue, the Seer of Avernus, and the Avernus Extremity Overlord as they spoke with cold apathy in their intent.
|...Even if these dredges manage to stop the spread of corruption of this Perfidious Dungeon before us, they will not be sufficient for the ones that will follow.|
Tomorrow's working chapter titles: Terrifying Means! III & IV

chapters.title: Chapter 2855 Terrifying Means! III
paragraphs: Dredges.
This was the term utilized to refer to the Entities that the Celebrious Ones were utilizing for their own purposes!
And at this moment, one of the Undefined Vitalis Existences stated that such dredges would not be sufficient for the dungeons that would follow.
It meant that they were expecting more of such constructs to appear.

|We must not be reactive to allow for even more to follow. The task is to locate this Insurgent wherever it may be hiding as it is critical to not allow their Existential Extreme to develop too much. The level of corruption is currently small as it can be contained, but if we don't approach this properly, this contagion could spread. What are the Blackhats saying?|

|Nothing substantial, same information as us. When it comes to this Insurgent though...what comes to focus are the whispers of Infinity and Quintessence. They are grand concepts if ever elevated to the Existential level as if that is the case, the Insurgent needs to be located at the earliest possible time. The Blackhats will send one of theirs to scour the Gradations of Extremity...|

|That alone isn't enough. Gather all traces of this Insurgent, any prior Records still available and any connection there may still be- however small. Create a database of this...Osmont and also pass it above. In the best case scenario, we locate him and stop this contagion before it spreads to any Prominent Seeds within these domains. If the corruption of this Insurgent reaches a critical level...the actions we will have to take will be ones that even this Insurgent cannot bear.|
A critical level!
If the so called corruption brought about by the Insurgent- by Noah Osmont reaches a certain level, a reality that even he could not bear may be forced to unfold!
It was a terrifying thought.
A terrifying possibility.
And yet at this moment, everything was only in its early stages.
Within the very same Vitalis Hyperversal Domains, but in the veiled folds of Recorded and Unrecorded Histories.

In a Record filled with stellar bodies and ancient mountains melting from a burning singularity at its very center, an entity advanced in the Gradations of Extremity was gazing towards the direction of the unfolding reality of a huge Dungeon Monolith.

But for him, what he could feel the most was the aura of Entities he never expected to come across even from afar again, and this time...their aura seemed anchored in space as they were staying in the unfolding reality freely! But even though the weaving of Records and his own Extremes told him that they were there, he never actually pierced across the veils of Records and reality to gaze in that direction.
Nobody who had seen and knew what he did would do such a thing.

But their appearance here after the emergence of something foreign...made a few things click within the mind of this Entity as within a moment his figure turned away from the unfolding reality far away as he went somewhere else entirely.

Millions of Extremity Rune Scriptures weaved intricately around his existence as he traversed through singularities within records- gaps of Unrecorded Histories and veiled Recorded Histories until ultimately...
WAP!
He appeared at the edges of a grand history.

Before him lay a paradisiacal domain with dazzling white clouds forming the earth below his feet, and these clouds stretched out for light years as thousands of miles away from his position, tall porcelain skyscrapers began to rise in large numbers!
The intense aura of life could be felt in abundance within these skyscrapers as the auras of Entities across the levels of Gradations could be felt throughout.
It seemed like a grand isolated domain that very few would ever gain access to, but the Entity that had just entered knew it by its name as he called out with passing memories.
{The Veil of Arcadia...}
His words were serene ones, but the moment they finished, another voice.

{Steel...a surprise to see you here. You wouldn't be thinking of peeking into the auras that have just emerged, would you?} A voice of serenity and power echoed out as a man with locks of golden hair and fair skin appeared, contrasting the tan skin of the Extremity of Steel who gazed at this golden haired entity calmly.
{I do not have an early death wish, Curagulus, but it is related to that.}
WAA!
Curagulus.
The founder of the Curagulus of Extremity in the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains turned out to be hidden here- in a domain known as the Veil of Arcadia!
{Oh?} He smiled brilliantly as he pointed behind him while beginning to float back towards the porcelain citadel.
The Extremity of Steel followed calmly while continuing.
{The Most Recent Honored One that should have just perished...it seems that such a reality may not be the case. And I've heard whispers of this being passing through your ranks.}
Whispers.
Records of records.
The figure of Curagulus came to a halt at such words as he gazed out towards Arcadia- the land filled with refugees and Entities who wished to be lost in the eons of Records!
{Why do you say this?}

{Their only recent appearance was seconds ago at the height of his Honorariums, and just as things should have gone back to their norm, they make their appearance again now after the emergence of a foreign authority. Likely, they weren't successful in eradicating this Honored One seconds ago and now, something outside of their scope of control appeared. Something they cannot resolve right away.}
Curagulus was silent after hearing such a shocking hypothesis, as if it wasn't one that may be entirely foreign to him!
His golden hair waved serenely in the arcadian winds as he asked Steel a question that was not a question at the same time.
{You believe this Most Recent Honored One has managed to achieve it. You believe that somehow, an Existential Extremity Authority was actually born from the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.}
WAA!

You wouldn't be thinking of peeking into the auras that have just emerged, would you?} A voice of serenity and power echoed out as a man with locks of golden hair and fair skin appeared, contrasting the tan skin of the Extremity of Steel who gazed at this golden haired entity calmly.
{I do not have an early death wish, Curagulus, but it is related to that.}
WAA!
Curagulus.
The founder of the Curagulus of Extremity in the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains turned out to be hidden here- in a domain known as the Veil of Arcadia!
{Oh?} He smiled brilliantly as he pointed behind him while beginning to float back towards the porcelain citadel.
The Extremity of Steel followed calmly while continuing.
{The Most Recent Honored One that should have just perished...it seems that such a reality may not be the case.
And I've heard whispers of this being passing through your ranks.}
Whispers.
Records of records.
The figure of Curagulus came to a halt at such words as he gazed out towards Arcadia- the land filled with refugees and Entities who wished to be lost in the eons of Records!
{Why do you say this?}

{Their only recent appearance was seconds ago at the height of his Honorariums, and just as things should have gone back to their norm, they make their appearance again now after the emergence of a foreign authority.
Likely, they weren't successful in eradicating this Honored One seconds ago and now, something outside of their scope of control appeared.
Something they cannot resolve right away.}
Curagulus was silent after hearing such a shocking hypothesis, as if it wasn't one that may be entirely foreign to him!
His golden hair waved serenely in the arcadian winds as he asked Steel a question that was not a question at the same time.
{You believe this Most Recent Honored One has managed to achieve it.
You believe that somehow, an Existential Extremity Authority was actually born from the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.}
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 2856 Terrifying Means! IV
paragraphs: 2856 Terrifying Means! IV
The words of Extremity Steel had shocking implications!
One of them.
An Entity just like them had managed to do what few distinguished others could not.

[My very Existence states it can only be so. It should be the foreign authority that descended not too long ago, with...them descending afterwards. The successful design of an Existential Extremity Authority means too many things as for this, I believe a meeting must be held. And your Veil of Arcadia was the last place that held the Primogenitors of Vitalis and Vacuous eons ago...]
The two Primogenitors far advanced in the Gradations of Extremity thought of memories of ages gone and past.
What seemed like eons ago and yet as recent as yesterday.
The gaze of the Curagulus was deep as he sighed while turning to gaze at the Extremity of Steel.
[Noah Osmont...we know too little about him as he appeared and disappeared too quickly. We know nothing about him apart from mere intents of what his dead paths were. We-]
[It doesn't matter.] The Extremity of Steel waved his hands dismissively as he spoke cooly towards the Curagulus.

[At the end of it all, it comes down to what choices we will make if this Honored One goes really far against them. Whether we will stand with him and risk everything we have built, or whether we will stand with them and protect the foundations we have enacted for eons.]
Two pathways.
But the choices to make between them were too heavy.
They all knew the undeniable power of the Ones Above Extremity.
They understood just how little they could stand against it.
And now, there was this foreign power that had somehow slipped through the cracks and was bound to be an issue for the Ones Above Extremity!
But they knew nothing of this foreign power.
They knew nothing about what it stood for.
Would they really risk everything they had built over the eons at the mere whispers of someone else's hopes and dreams? At the weavings of an Honored One none of them truly understood?
[...I will pass word and call the meeting. My Veil of Arcadia welcomes all lost souls and those seeking peace from Existence.]

Curagulus spoke with burning golden pupils as the burly figure of the Extremity of Steel only quietly nodded, his gaze filled with undaunted light as he sought to measure even a grain of sand of the coming future.
Inside an Existential Dungeon.

A Dungeon Raid was currently occurring as two defenders from the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains entered the depths of the Existential Dungeon, one distraught Light Flame Serpent and the Prime Devourer of the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Extremity Lineage!

The latter was filled with terrifying ambition as within the Raid Boss Throne Room, his massive wriggling worm like body radiated a profound obsidian light as on its Apex, skin bloodily tore open to reveal an emerging serpentine eye.

On the Aurora of wriggling wings behind its back, serpentine eyes appeared at their very center as they opened to radiate a terrifying authority that nearly turned the whole Raid Boss Throne Room into a domain of darkness!
[Fucking hell...]

The Cimmerian Architect cursed as she felt the wall of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity get looser and looser, her main Body within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven devouring an Infinity Planalith Krystallos as her existence produced more and more Cerulean Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Infinity!
Yet this roided out worm in front of her seemed to gradually be transforming into something that actually caused her intuition to buzz with a sense of danger.
Just what were those fuckers outside doing to elevate the power of this worm to such a level?

This thought was not just in the mind of the Cimmerian Architect, but also in the hearts of all those in the Raid Boss Throne Room as the most powerful combatant- the designated Raid Boss herself, Ishtar...moved with a powerful sense of urgency.
She felt Infinity coursing through her.
She had spent significantly less time with it in comparison to the Existential Extremity Authority of Vacuous, but she was gradually getting familiar with its intent!

It wasn't so easy to grasp it as she wished...she just had a little bit more time to understand this extreme for what it truly was, and after that...she felt like she would be able to apply it at an unimaginable level.
To the extent that this enemy before her wouldn't be able to stand against it!
She just...
[The Extremity of Skill Trees feels your sense of urgency.]
[The Extremity of Skill Trees provides possibilities for the application of Existential Extremity Authority.]
Her soul buzzed as from the new lineage flowing through her, she felt another intent coursing through it and beginning to fill her with strands of information!
[The Obsidian Tier Existential Skill, Existential Hyperversal Embodiment has been granted.]
A weaving of records flowed into her soul.

And she felt a construct that held intricate designs of how an Existential Extremity Authority could be applied in a smooth manner- if only for the great cost of the authority of nearly 50% of all her Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures and 25% of her Soul Values.
For one who didn't truly understand the weaving of an Existential Extremity Authority, this Skill would allow them to display it based on the design granted by the Extremity of Skill Trees!
Ishtar let go of any and all reservations at this moment as she looked at the rising aura of the Prime Devourer while uttering out calmly.
[Existential Hyperversal Embodiment]
The moment she uttered the three words, the Existential Infinity Authority within her surged as it began to weave in an intricate manner.

Terrifying blue waves of Haki rose and shrouded her whole figure as in the next moment, a deeply ultramarine blue covered her figure as all around her- whether above, below, or to her left and right...similar ultramarine figures of herself began to manifest.
They began to manifest one after another as within a nanosecond, more than a hundred of her figures appeared as each one genuinely seemed to be her!
An expression of herself.
An Embodiment of the Existential Authority within her.

She felt her very existence buzz as more of herself began to fill the Raid Boss Throne Room, the number quickly approaching a thousand as she felt liek it would continue infinitely, but she was nearing a threshold for what she could bear as the she released all this authority towards her target.

The wriggling worm that had began to open multiple serpentine eyes filled with tenebrous darkness at this moment only felt a dazzlign blue brilliance fill up its surroundings as hundreds of gorgeous figures all wielding an aura of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity appeared, their hands pressing down unto him at this moment in a dangerous and unfathomable light that stemmed from all directions!
In front of this blinding light from 1,000 Existences, his brooding and tumultuous concentration of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority seemed so...little.
BOOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 2857 Immaculate! I
paragraphs: 2857 Immaculate! I
What made one Existential Extremity Authority overcome another?
What it stood for and signified? Its quality? Or quantity?
While some could debate the significance of one Existential Extremity Authority over another, one could not make an argument regarding its quantity!
And at this moment, just purely based on the concentration of Existential Extremity Authority descending...the Prime Devourer's Vacuous Extremity Authority held no chance!

The expression of Infinity under the Existential Hyperversal Embodiment was so domineering that it expressed the descent of 1,000 Entities at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity for a brief moment in time.
Under the eyes of the Prime Devourer, it only felt like endless waves of blue seas wrapped all around him.

The obsidian Vacuous Hyperversal Authority all around him stood no chance in front of this endless sea as his massive worm like body was entirely encompassed instantly, all Vacuous Authority burned and erased as truly...the ultramarine sea seemed infinite!
Just as quickly as they had arrived, the hundreds of copies of Ishtar faded.

There was immense silence in the Raid Boss Throne Room as even she seemed numb and in shock at what had just occurred, but her spent Soul Values and dim Extremity Rune Scriptures told her that she had indeed been the one to do such a shocking action!
[The Extremity of Skill Trees nods in appreciation.]
[The Extremity of Cheats scoffs and says it is acceptable.]
A myriad of dazzling intents buzzed within her lineage as she fully accepted what had just happened, but this was just her.
Around her, others were just as dazed to see a powerful Entity at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity be wiped out in a single move as...
[Yo what the fuck?] The Cimmerian Architect couldn't stop herself as her eyes shone blue with Infinity, wanting to understand what had just occurred as before she could say anything else...
HUUM!
She felt her blood burning as an intent she couldn't fully fathom rose from it.
And dazzling information bloomed in her mind.
[You have participated in a battle and successfully defended against a Defender, no matter how small your contribution is.]
[The Extremity of Skill Trees grants the Obsidian Tier Existential Skill- Existential Hyperversal Embodiment, as a prize after it met its acceptable range of utility.]
Information began to rise within her as she marveled at it, and it wasn't long before all those in the Raid Boss Throne Room began to feel a similar sensation!
They, or really Ishtar, had pushed back against a Defender who sought to stop the Dungeon Break they were trying to cause.
It was the first successful repulsion of those seeking to destroy the Source of Existential Dungeon Monolith as the Celebrious Ones outside of this Dungeon...
Nothing regarding their records could be seen or expressed as their reactions and subsequent actions were only known to them.
In the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.

Within Dissolution, the Existential Dungeon Monolith to have appeared here finally had its first entrants, and they were three in number as the Main Bodies of Extremity Blue, Seer Amestris, and the Avernus Extremity Overlord all remained in the holy transparent white altars as the enigmatic Celebrious Ones floated behind them, and their clones were the ones to enter the Dungeon Monolith!
The serpentine eyes of the Celebrious One to the right flashed as their intent moved at this moment.
|Ho? The Blackhats are saying their first Seed to enter the Dungeon on their side, supported by a half-completed Paramount Vacuous Awakening, has perished under an endless brilliance of...Infinity.|
|Oh? The Existential Extremity Authority of Infinity...this Insurgent opened a dangerous pathway.|
|Only if it can be developed, and only if he lived long enough to develop it. But the issue still remains that another Seed was defeated, these ones...|
Their gazes fell on the figures of the top Avernus Clan leaders as the distaste in their eyes was clear!

|...they have at least completed a single Paramount Vitalis Awakening with their Existence spurred to the Sixth Gradation for the one whose breadth of Soul could still handle it, with these two only capable of being elevated to the Fifth Gradation currently.|

Their gaze was on Extremity Blue and Seer Amestris as they talked about those they had raised towards the Fifth Gradation of Extremity, while the Avernus Extremity Overlord...had been forcefully raised to the Sixth Gradation of Extremity!
|With them, we can at least get a feel of Infinity.|

After granting them a Paramount Vitalis Awakening and refining their existence with a shred of their intents, just like the Blackhats...they would be able to feel a feedback when the Existential Extremity Authority of Vitalis came in contact with the enemy Existential Extremity Authority.
|After that?|

|We can better react against the nature of this opposing Existential Extremity Authority. And even these dredges...can slowly have the breadth of their Souls expanded while being elevated across the Gradations of Extremity. Of course, we should be expanding our hands into more viable seeds that won't be corrupted when they do come across the Insurgent and its Corrupted Seeds...|
The two Celebrious Ones weaved their intent and wills together as inside the Monolith before them, grand activity picked up!
Inside of this Monolith, within a domain filled with typhoons of shattered cosmos dead quasars.
[Haha, could any of you have predicted such a day would come hours ago- much less days ago?]
A voice tinged with controlled Lunacy echoed out as Extremity Blue's gorgeous figure could be seen floating behind Seer Amestris and the Avernus Extremity Overlord.
Both her and Seer Amestris truly displayed auras at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity as the Avernus Extremity Overlord powerfully stood on the Sixth Gradation!

[Just imagine telling this to yourself a day ago- most of the forces of the Seven Clans and Major Inheritances will be fractured and disappear, our powerful enemies would be turned into enemies of the Ones Above Extremity, and we would even be chosen to-]
[Can you shut the fuck up?]
The monologue of Extremity Blue was interrupted by a frowning Seer Amestris who seemed to be thinking of many things.
Why they were here.
Why they were chosen.
And every part of her soul and remaining capability as a seer pointed to a single reason.
The reason it felt like reality was burning in the last few seconds.
The Most Recent Honored One.
Noah Osmont!

chapters.title: Chapter 2858 Immaculate! II
paragraphs: 2858 Immaculate! II

The intuition of Seer Amestris seemed to be so extremely spot on that she couldn't keep listening to the ramblings of the Extremity of Lunacy that she was frankly displeased with for her recent actions.
[You talk so fucking much that you fail to realize the so called enemy who was smitten out of-]
[It's Osmont who is behind this. You think I didn't put that together?] The brows of the Extremity of Lunacy rose as she sneered.
[Can I still not be excited? Can I not look forward to seeing the downfall of this guy firsthand? I-]
BZZT!

Their figures were suddenly warped from the room they were in to appear in a domain filled with royal purple crystals lining up all surfaces, a tall amethyst throne visible in the distance as atop it, the burly figure of a man hardened by years in the forge could be seenseated.

His gaze was cold and full of power as he stared coldly at the three Avernus Clan Leaders, sitting in this Raid Boss Throne Room alone as he designated all others at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity or below to other regions of the Existential Dungeon!
He utilized his authority to bring the enemies that had just entered here as the only one to recognize him was none other than the Avernus Extremity Overlord.
[You...I've seen whispers of you Records from the Senatus of Extremity. The Anvil of Anarchos, Sargon! You fell under the banner of Osmont?]
As he spoke, a grand purple light began to cover the Avernus Extremity Overlord as normally, figures such as these were only ones he learned to gaze at from afar but could never reach.
Yet now...
[How grand fate is to allow me to stand in front of a past legend and actually match them in battle!]
HUUM!
His body began to flicker with royal purple flames.
Beside him, Amestris and Blue became stern as they prepared to support him against this enemy!
And yet...Sargon's burly figure had cold eyes as an even deeper royal purple light surrounded him.
A light of grand tyranny as when he looked at the Avernus Extremity Overlord before him, his voice boomed out!
[You...are still not worthy to stand before a legend as an equal.]
Heavy words of utter disrespect and tyranny echoed out as without missing a beat, the seated Sargon spoke out with churning waves of Existential Extremity Authority.
[Existential Hyperversal Embodiment]
WAA!
A magenta-colored glow absolutely colored everything as boundless waves of tyranny arose.
Tyranny
As an Existential concept, just what would its embodiment entail?

Sargon answered such a question at this moment as around him, reality twisted and turned as the throne he was on was made larger and even grander, his figure on it becoming draped with purple robes of utmost Royalty as a lilac flaming crown manifested above his head!

He looked like an Emperor from ancient times whose will would be undeniable, with the figures of the Avernus Extremity Overlord, Seer Amestris, and Extremity Blue feeling an unprecedented sense of danger

Around them, a glorious purple light flashed as near them and stretching out to cover this whole Domain, illusory figures began to manifest en masse as each one had a respectful expression, gazing towards the far distant throne while kneeling to show their fealty!
These illusory figures appeared all around them as if to let them know...they were mere subjects too.
Lunacy blared.
Vitalis blared.
Hundreds of thousands of Extremity Rune Scriptures sought to rise and prevent it!

And yet the figure of the Anvil of Anarchos that was bathed in a royal light of Tyranny seemed to lock onto the three figures amongst millions that were not kneeling at this moment as he brought his hand down.
As if an Emperor was passing an edict!
As if a commandment was laid down that had to be followed!
[Kneel.]
HUUM!
Extremity Blue and Seer Amestris were the first ones who could not resist for a fraction of an instant as they were instantly forced to their knees, and along with this action...
every line of authority surrounding them was shattered to oblivion.
The moment their knees hit the ground, their Extremity Clones dimmed and shattered as if the last action they would ever do was to pay respects to the Emperor ahead!
BOOM!

After them, the Avernus Extremity Overlord took another fraction of an instant to also fall on his knees, disbelief prevalent on his face as the newfound power at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity he was just granted...he didn't think it would be so pitiful before this being!

The potent Vitalis Extremity Authority around him tried to blare with defiance at his submission, but it was nowhere near enough as Tyranny pressed in from all around and kept the Avernus Extremity Overlord on his knees, his body splintering and being ground down to nothing a moment later as all that was left behind...were millions of illusory subjects kneeling towards the visage of the Extremity of Tyranny.
This...was the Existential Hyperversal Embodiment of Tyranny!

An instant later, the dazzling illusory scene began to fade as Sargon's figure returned to normal, his eye showing a bit of exhaustion but also...a hint of marvel at the expression of this Existential Extremity Authority.
These were his thoughts.
Then...there were those outside of the Existential Dungeon Monolith.

On the Altars outside of the Monolith, the main bodies of Extremity Blue, Seer Amestris, and the Avernus Extremity Overlord trembled with great injuries as their Extremity Clones perished, but their pain was not even considered under the gazes of the Celebrious Ones behind them as at this moment, both of these beings turned to stare at each other with their dazzling Serpentine pupils as their intents weaved.
|That...was not Infinity.|
|The Insurgent has two Existential Extremity Authorities opened up.|
A heavy finding.
One that made the eyes of these Celebrious Ones sharp and filled with blinding light of focus as from this point on, they knew that things had to drastically change!
|Pass the word above and proceed with the other plans. Notify the Blackhats too.|
The Weaving of Extremity churned and began to flow towards an intricate direction.
At this moment, nobody came even close to imagining what the results of this weaving were bound to be!

II

The intuition of Seer Amestris seemed to be so extremely spot on that she couldn't keep listening to the ramblings of the Extremity of Lunacy that she was frankly displeased with for her recent actions.
[You talk so fucking much that you fail to realize the so called enemy who was smitten out of-]
[It's Osmont who is behind this.
You think I didn't put that together?] The brows of the Extremity of Lunacy rose as she sneered.
[Can I still not be excited?
Can I not look forward to seeing the downfall of this guy firsthand?
BZZT!

Their figures were suddenly warped from the room they were in to appear in a domain filled with royal purple crystals lining up all surfaces, a tall amethyst throne visible in the distance as atop it, the burly figure of a man hardened by years in the forge could be seenseated.

His gaze was cold and full of power as he stared coldly at the three Avernus Clan Leaders, sitting in this Raid Boss Throne Room alone as he designated all others at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity or below to other regions of the Existential Dungeon!
He utilized his authority to bring the enemies that had just entered here as the only one to recognize him was none other than the Avernus Extremity Overlord.
[You...I've seen whispers of you Records from the Senatus of Extremity.
The Anvil of Anarchos, Sargon!
You fell under the banner of Osmont?]
As he spoke, a grand purple light began to cover the Avernus Extremity Overlord as normally, figures such as these were only ones he learned to gaze at from afar but could never reach.
Yet now...
[How grand fate is to allow me to stand in front of a past legend and actually match them in battle!]
HUUM!
His body began to flicker with royal purple flames.
Beside him, Amestris and Blue became stern as they prepared to support him against this enemy!
And yet...Sargon's burly figure had cold eyes as an even deeper royal purple light surrounded him.
A light of grand tyranny as when he looked at the Avernus Extremity Overlord before him, his voice boomed out!
[You...are still not worthy to stand before a legend as an equal.]
Heavy words of utter disrespect and tyranny echoed out as without missing a beat, the seated Sargon spoke out with churning waves of Existential Extremity Authority.
[Existential Hyperversal Embodiment]
WAA!
A magenta-colored glow absolutely colored everything as boundless waves of tyranny arose.
Tyranny
As an Existential concept, just what would its embodiment entail?

Vitalis blared.

chapters.title: Chapter 2859 Immaculate! III
paragraphs: Not a single person understood what the weaving of a myriad of Extremes would lead to at this moment!

But what was immensely clear was that for the first round of defenders of the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains, they had faced a calamitous loss as thereafter, as of emboldened with even grander authority...
HUUM!

The two Existential Dungeon Monoliths blared with domineering purple light as the records and reality they Devoured expanded ever further, the rate of progress of the apocalypse they brought only increasing at this moment!

While the unfolding reality couldn't be seen on the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains side due to the interference of certain Entities, the reality unfolding with Dissolution of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains showed the two Celebrious Ones becoming stern with their serpentine eyes as they could only observe their surroundings deteriorate further and be pulled into the Dungeon Monolith as if it were an abyssal behemoth.
Their eyes were callous and filled with a deadly light as they already knew what they had to do!
For now, the three Altars they conjured churned as the figures of Extremity Blue, Seer Amestris, and the Avernus Extremity Overlord screamed out silently.

They were undergoing forceful rounds of refinement and strengthening from an authority they weren't even close to understanding right after their Extremity Clones faced true death, with the breadth of their souls being expanded ever so slowly as the Celebrious Ones sought to make them into somewhat more useful dredges along their many plans.
But the Dungeon Monolith before them continued to pulse and expand its devouring light unhindered.
More of the Records and Reality of the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains began to be absorbed.
In such a process, seconds began to pass.
And seconds flowed into minutes as the weaving of time or the absence of it was relentless!
Minutes. It was now a few minutes since a certain Insurgent was first smitten out of existence.
And when it came to him who was behind all of this...he was gazing at something few others could see as his will was currently observing the somewhat clear waters of the Gradations of Extremity.
In the past few minutes, many changes had taken place as some beings the Main Body of the Cimmerian Architect could clear the Obsidian Difficulty of the Dungeon Raid Rift within seconds.
Others took minutes just for the Golden Difficulty.
And as of right now, a heavy and ecstatic battle was wrapping up with the members of the Harem and Ruination!
The names on the Banner of Quintessence had been ever changing in the last few minutes as at first place was of course, the True Emperor of Quintessence.

Second on the list...was shockingly still the Daughter of Hatred that was stacking up achievements and currently forming new connections with the past Scions of the Major Inheritances and Clans that she was introduced to through Ayame!
Third was the Cimmerian Architect as Fourth on the Banner of Quintessence...was Henry Osmont.

He had fallen slightly behind in the beginning, but the moment he attained the Extremity of Nepotism...his whole outlook changed as he began by Solo Clearing Golden Difficulty Dungeon Raid by himself!
And he went on a grinding mode and completed such a difficult over and over again in the last minutes as he culminated a few Planalith Krystallos and even 3 Low Grade Armaments of Extremity.
Soon...he would be ready to challenge the Obsidian Difficulty again and put down Oppenheimer as he did before!

Fifth and Sixth on the Banner of Quintessence were none other than Sargon and Ishtar as these new being collected accomplishments with their much higher strength, with the rankings below this constantly shifting every minute as entities complete Dungeon Raid Rifts.
Suffice to say, the Infinite Hyperversal Haven had begun to move like a well oiled machine as many Entities adapted to the shocking Lineage they now held and chose an Existential Path to follow.
This meant that in the last few minutes, the usage and exploration of Tyranny, Quintessence, and Infinity was only exponentially increasing!
And the result for this...was displayed and observed by none other than Noah himself.

In the slightly clear waters of the Gradations of Extremity, Noah's existence was facing an unprecedented emergence of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures as the number had long since exceeded 3 Million, and it only continued to rise as more and more Existences utilized and became intune with the weaving of his Extremes!

The more that his people refined, purified, and baptized themselves with Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny- whether through Planalith Krystallos or through pure usage of these authorities, the more their Weaving was strengthened.
It was as if with every passing minute, their Weaving became more intimate and more robust, with their power as Existential Extremity Authorities only increasing.
And in a form of feedback...all of this was reflected on Noah as over 3 million dazzling Colorless, Cerulean, and Amethyst Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures swirled beneath his skin silently.

It also meant that instead of being pushed down or just stabilizing on the Sixth Gradation of Extremity, he had begun to once more rose up slowly as after Oraculum, he also began to recover the convergence of the other Dynamis as he rebuilt and expanded the Weald within his existence!
There were very little gaps around his body now.

Even if it weren't Dynamis of Extremity allowing for a flow to form, Noah's understanding of the Weaving of Extremity had risen to the extent that even non-converged concepts...he could now set them on a unique flow as this allowed him to nearly close all gaps around himself.
It also meant that every few seconds...
WAP!
Noah's figure silently warped higher across the Sixth Gradations of Extremity.
It was slower than his previous ascensions, but it was still much faster than all others.
And-
The waters of the Gradations of Extremity stilled.

A distance away, the menacing visage of an Entity covered with a radiant obsidian luster appeared, the serpentine eyes on their face, chest, and butterfly like wings carrying tremendous coldness rapidly moved across the waters of the Gradations all around!
An overabundance of chains was not present on their body, but on the top of their head- a long and endless obsidian chain stretching upwards towards the latter Gradations of Extremity could be seen.
But this Entity freely and with great speed moved across the Gradations of Extremity, its eyes locking onto all beings near it as it covered substantial grounds every moment!
