chapters.title: Chapter 2860 Immaculate! IV
paragraphs: An endless obsidian chain was connected to its head as it stretched upwards towards the latter Gradations of Extremity!
Its eerie and shockingly robust visage wades across the waters of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity as if it were looking for something.
For someone.

Its eyes were just as sharp as when it scoured the more advanced Gradations, with the knowledge within its intent telling it that the Insurgent they were looking for should be within these advanced Gradations for it to be capable doing what it was currently doing!
But the Eighth and Seventh Gradation of Extremity has no anomalies out of sorts.
And now the Sixth Gradation...
This entity had arrived towards its preliminary low stage as its eyes buzzed with distaste.

It didn't think the Insurgent who could enact Absolute Existential Restrictions would be in this Gradation. They simply wouldn't have the power to do it as the cost and expenditure of Existential Extremity Authorities was immense.
The breadth of an Entity- the Weaving of their very Existence...it had to at least be on the Eighth Gradation of Extremity to even have enough support of enacting Absolute Existential Restrictions!
But still, it stared at the figures of shackled Seeds across this Gradation before rapidly moving on.
All of them were the same- a few chains around their bodies with stern expressions as they barely began grasping the weaving of Extremity and slowly inched upwards.
|Futile...|
Its intent weaved with further distaste as it came to float in front of yet another Entity bound by few chains.
Its face was filled with dignity and majesty greater than many, but it was still a seed bound by chains like all the others.
|In all your lifetime, you will never be free of even these insignificant chains as why do you all put up such a futile struggle?|

Its distaste was clear as it spoke while its serpentine eyes confirmed this Entity was not one it was looking for, moving even further down and horizontally across the Seas of the Sixth Gradations of Extremity while occasionally letting its intent be known!
The area that it just left though...churned silently without any changes as a bubbling aura filled with emotions was contained!
{The Extremity of Quintessence shines with endless splendor to ensure safety!}
{The Extremity of Tyranny seethes with immeasurable rage!}
The place where the Undefined Existence just passed...was right in front of the Extremity of Quintessence.
The very Insurgent they were looking for!
When the intent of the Undefined Existence expressed themselves, Noah had managed to grasp some of it.
|#-$-....insignificant...#-_-#$& tile $&ruggle?|
A futile struggle!
Was this his path? Was this what he was doing? Struggling in a futile manner against beings he couldn't even understand?

His very existence trembled as even though he understood that he did not currently have the strength to stand against terrifying enemies far more advanced than him in the understanding of the weaving of Extremity, it didn't make it any less frustrating to himself and his own extremes for what had just occurred!
He had to sit still?
He had to play dead while his greatest enemies were right before him?
He?!
BOOM!
He felt something within the depths of his soul rise and respond to the weaving of his emotions.
{The Extremity of Cheats rises from its slumber.}
{The Extremity of the Protagonist declares that its extreme cannot be in existence unless its concept truly lives up to its name!}
{The Extremity of Quintessence, Tyranny, and Infinity surge with Existential Extremity Authorities as they work in synchrony to elevate the breadth of your soul!}
HUUM!
His figure, unchained and unbound, instantly disappeared as it began to shoot up the clear waters of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity, warping as he constantly appeared further and further up.
His weaving adopted a tyrannical flow as his extremes jumped in a dance of intents!
{The Extremity of the Protagonist steps off of its high throne and stares with a profound intent at all converging Extremes.}
{The Extremity of Apocalypse watches with silent contemplation.}
{The Extremity of Systems ponders with a complicated gaze.}
{The Extremity of Wisdom says it is only but a matter of time.}

A myriad of intents weaved within him while the breadth of his soul reached a critical level- a level that was being expanded since Tyranny took its seat minutes ago! {The Extremity of Tyranny states to stop wasting time and proceed forward.}
{The Extremity of Cheats scoffs at the race to become Existential.}
{The Extremity of Cheats states it does not need the distinction of Existential to do what it wishes to do!}
WAA!
{The Extremity of Cheats throws its support towards the Extremity of the Protagonist for the purposes of what it wishes to accomplish.}
One extreme gained the support of another.

Noah's existence vibrated as he stared up at the clear waters, the breadth of who he was rapidly being stretched out as he felt as if his very existence could reach a point where he could break with all of his extremes spilling out instantly, and yet...
{Quintessence blares with brilliance and approves the nomination.}
{The Weaving of the Protagonist resonates with your existence.}
{The Weaving of your Existence and the Weaving of the Protagonist are one and the same.}
{You are the undeniable Protagonist within the Domains you exist in.}
{The Extremity of the Protagonist reaches for the throne of the Existential Tier!}
{The Extremity of Cheats moves forward with its plans and pulls on the Extremities of Systems, Paradox, Loot, Skill Trees, Infinity, Tyranny, Devouring, and Quintessence.}
{The Extremity of Cheats begins the forging and designation of a Weaving that will allow the Extremity of Cheats to truly move as the Protagonist.}
{The construct of the Infinite Log On and Log Off is being forged under the lead of the Extremity of Cheats on the backbone of the forming Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist!}
A terrifying progression unfolded.
From being forced to play dead under the gaze of an Undefined Existence, the Protagonist rose to grasp a heavy throne while Cheats went on to conduct an unfathomable construct!

{The construct of the Infinite Log On and Log Off is being forged under the lead of the Extremity of Cheats on the backbone of the forming Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist!}
A terrifying progression unfolded.
From being forced to play dead under the gaze of an Undefined Existence, the Protagonist rose to grasp a heavy throne while Cheats went on to conduct an unfathomable construct!

chapters.title: Chapter 2861 The Protagonist! I
paragraphs: A new construct was being forged from the backbone of the elevating Protagonist!
A construct similar in nature to the Existential Dungeon Apocalypse and yet vastly different, with the Extremity of Cheats being the lead designer as it pulled in others as well.
Infinite Log On and Log Off.
Just what was the Extremity of Cheats envisioning when forging such a ridiculous-sounding construct in response to today's recent event?
{The Extremity of Paradox smiles with glee as it begins to understand the intent of the Extremity of Cheats.}
{The Extremity of Loot and Systems marvel at the revealed intent and focus their authority on the elevating Protagonist!}
Protagonist took steps forward.
And with its rise towards the Existential level, a construct was being forged to be supported by such an extreme as only the Protagonist could bear such a weight!
{The construct of Infinite Log On and Log Off is being defined.}

{When coming across Entities vastly outstripping your current stage and power, and they release any intent that is harmful towards your Existence, Authority, or any form of Weaving surrounding you- you will automatically enter a paradoxical state of non-existence.}
The chosen authorities under the Extremity of Cheats churned as they continued to pile onto the construct, with Noah feeling the depths of his soul buzzing gloriously as the prompts continued.

{The state of non-existence will grant the choice of remaining in such a state and returning to the same domain, at the same coordinates, or light years around it. The second choice is that of re-entry to be randomized to any recognizable domain you have traversed into before.}
{Points of acceptable re-entry will only be within domains where no harmful Weavings of Extremes against you are ongoing or still present.}
The Extremity of Systems, Cheats, Paradox, Skill Trees, Quintessence, Tyranny, and Quintessence all converged together to allow for the shocking definition above to bloom, but they weren't alone.
There were also the Extremities of Devouring and Loot!
But before they expressed themselves fully...
{The Extremity of Greed inserts itself and states that it cannot miss such a mixture of authorities.}
One of the past seven deadly sins arose and made its intent flow in!

{At the moment of your existence entering a paradoxical state of non-existence, your existence will devour a percentage of the Weavings of Extremes of the target that caused the feature of Infinite Log On and Log Off to be triggered.}
The gaze of the Protagonist rose as ridiculous capabilities were tacked on it.
And even more prompts followed!

{No matter their level of power, so long as they cause the construct of Infinite Log On and Log Off to be triggered, the extremes of Devouring, Greed, and Loot will pull upon any semblance of their Records or Authorities to be devoured, with the percentage devoured tremendously reducing and being less efficient depending on how vast the gulf of power between you and the target are.}

Under the support of three Existential Extremity Authorities, and a Fourth Extremity Authority that was coming to fruition- the ridiculous feature of Infinite Log On and Log Off was being scribed into existence.
The authorities of Devouring, Loot, and Greed were supported by Existential Extremity Authorities to cause a terrific feature within it to bloom!

{The quantification of the gulf of power between you and enemies who can trigger the Infinite Log On and Log Off feature is currently immeasurable as the approximate devouring percentage is currently set at 0.0001%. The elevation of the Extreme carrying the weight of the Infinite Log On and Log Off construct as well as the elevation of your other extremes will only go towards elevating this percentage.}
Log on. Log off.
A simple idea based on the constructs of games from Noah's time on the blue planet.
Yet they were made into something grandiose and nonsensical as with such a tool in his roster...what did he have holding him back?
Who was he?
Why did he have to fear?
Why did he have to play dead in front of others?!
HUUM!
{The Extremity of Tyranny reigns free.}
The fake shackles around Noah's visage fell.
{The Extremity of Quintessence shines with interminable splendor!}
A brilliant purple Emperor's Robe adorned him as his exquisite figure was freely visible without any chains around him!
His aura was no longer receded and camouflaged.
Around his body, a wondrous glow of a myriad of lights of extremes permeated as the weavings of many desires ran free and wild!
{The Existential Extremity Authority of Quintessence has Quintessentially risen.}
{The Existential Extremity Authority of Tyranny has Quintessentially risen.}
{The Existential Extremity Authority of Infinity has Quintessentially risen.}
{The Extremity of Cheats nods with a placated smile.}
{The Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist has been successfully established as it carries with it a profound construct!}
The fourth Existential Extremity Authority was forged.
Along with its coming, Noah felt every part of his existence be filled to the brim- as if he was a ceramic vase that could not take any more things in lest he broke.
The breadth of his existence was so heavily saturated that any more thoughts of Existential Extremity Authorities were far away!
But the Protagonist taking its seat at the table of Existential Extremity Authorities was terrifying enough as its full effects were not yet even unveiled!
{The Extremity of Plot interlocks its weaving with devilish machinations at the advent of the Existential Extremity of the Protagonist.}
{The Extremity of Paradox laughs with glee at what is to come!}
Noah felt his existence changing ever so subtly at this moment, balancing four Existential Extremity Authorities as this last one held a unique connection with him!
But before he could delve top deeply into it...
HUUM!

A weaving boomed out behind and below him as with their serpentine eyes shining with a sense of incredulity, an Undefined Existence that was about to delve into the less clear waters of the Fifth Gradation of Extremity felt his now unveiled brilliance as he instantly traced it and appeared!
Yet this time, the Protagonist did not play dead.

chapters.title: Chapter 2862 The Protagonist! II
paragraphs: The Protagonist did not play dead!
With his eyes radiating a profound light of tyranny, he turned around to stare straight into the obsidian brilliance of the Undefined Existence.
He looked into the serpentine eye on its face and chest, and the serpentine eyes on its outstretched wings freely without fear!
At the same time, his existence was undergoing subtle changes as his Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures of the Protagonist began to attain their own glorious color.
A color of triumph and achievement.
A color and glory and brilliance!

Out of all the colors it could have chosen, the Protagonist did not hesitate to radiate a heavy halcyon light as one after another, the Aurum Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of the Protagonist began to proliferate.
Aurum!
A color of brilliance and glory!

This had barely begun to blaze within Noah's eyes that were staring at the figure of the Undefined Existence when after all this time, this entity seemed to finally come out of its stupor of actually finding Noah as within it, an Intent was about to begin a weaving.
About to begin.
But even at the point of its inception, before the weaving even took place...
WAP!
Like a golden bubble popping, the visage of Noah disappeared!
It was too fast.
Faster than speeds that even Entities in the Seventh or Eighth Gradation of Extremity could explode with!
But this wasn't the speed and power of the Extremity of Quintessence, but the speed and power of his enemy that was weaving an intent against him!
Noah's construct of Infinite Log On and Log Off was activated the moment the intent began to weave and took him to a state of non-existence instantly.

At the same time as the Undefined Existence became stern at such a scene, it gazed down as it felt like somehow, however impossible it was...a minuscule shred of its authority- an insignificant portion truly, had been taken away.
The situation was astonishing as the Undefined Existence knew...so long as the Insurgent was on the Gradations of Extremity, they could not leave it.
So, its existence blazed as it first sent word that it had located the insurgent, and its intents exploded out as it deeply looked at the surrounding waters nearby!

In this same span of an instance, light years away from the position of the Undefined Existence, Noah's figure reappeared with a flash of Aurum Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures as his visage buzzed with majesty.
{Infinite Log On and Log Off was activated automatically after sensing your Existence being targeted!}
{A miniscule shred(0.0001%) of the Authority of your enemy was successfully devoured!}
{You Existential Extremity Authorities are refining and purifying the foreign Existential Extremity Authority.}
Quintessence blazed with colorless flames.

Tyranny and Infinity surged while the Protagonist itself released a glorious halcyon brilliance- a point of darkness that Noah had taken in quickly becoming reduced and transformed into something pristine that acted akin to fuel.
A fuel that caused his Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures to explode by hundreds of thousands as in addition to all this...
{The Weaving of Extremes is gradually becoming clearer to your Existence.}
{Your understanding of the Undefined Existences is slowly increasing!}
His soul felt the pristine resonance and brilliance as the terror of his Infinite Log On and Log Off construct revealed itself.

Not an instant passed, and he found himself returning to a state of existence in another region of the waters of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity, the visage of the Undefined Existence nowhere to be seen as beside him, the stern figure of a Vitalis Extremity with a stern expression could be seen- a variety of chains around him.

The first test was a tremendously successful one as it showed Noah a new reality where he didn't have to be fearful of meeting Undefined Existences, and it would be of great benefit if he did come across them as every time, his Existential Extremity Authorities made it so that he would be able to siphon and devour a portion of their- however insignificant this portion was!
If it occurred hundreds or thousands of times, it would add up to a percentage that may rapidly elevate the level of his existence across the Gradations of Extremity.
It would rapidly open up his eyes to better understand the Weaving of Extremity!
It meant that there were many more paths that he could now take. HUUM!

His figure buzzed with even greater power as he continued ascending the waters of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity, albeit ever so slowly and not even close to how rapidly he rose in the lower Gradations. But he was making progress nonetheless as within his Existence, thousands of Aurum Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of the Protagonist began to proliferate and cause subtle changes that were slowly making themselves prevalent to him!

But, seconds after he began his ascent, vibrations spread across the waters of the Gradations of Extremity as in the far distance, the glorious figure of an obsidian Undefined Existence flapped its butterfly-like wings and surged over.
Its serpentine eyes were deadly as it began to weave an intent, and...
POP!
Noah's grand visage disappeared once more.
The serpentine eyes of the Undefined Existence became stern.
Once more, it felt a minuscule amount of its authority slip away along with the visage of the Insurgent.

The two were intricately linked as they gave a glimpse to a complex utilization of Existential Extremity Authority that the Undefined Existence did not at all like seeing in the hands of the insurgent!
It showed one of the terrifying truths of Existential Concepts.

They could bridge the gulf of power between different entities across the Gradations of Extremity or beyond it if elevated to a certain level, and this Insurgent...was showing signs of increasingly more adept utilization of his two Existential Concepts!
This couldn't be allowed to continue.

The intent of this Undefined Existence weaved as he sent communications to alert even the Whitehats of his findings, the eyes on his wings opening like brilliant suns at this moment and causing a circular blast of vibrations to spread out across the nearby waters as he felt for something.

And before long, he sensed a blinding brilliance far, far away in these endless waters of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity- a brilliance of a being who seemed unfettered as he continued to rise freely!

chapters.title: Chapter 2863 The Protagonist! III
paragraphs: Every time that the intent of the Undefined Existence even began to weave against the Insurgent, he disappeared!

With this reality established, the brilliant figure of the obsidian Entity sensed the brilliance far, far away in the Waters of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity as its body flickered towards this direction.
And within moments, it neared the Insurgent once more.
But this time, no intent was quickly formed against this being as ever so slowly, the Undefined Existence approached the Insurgent!

Noah's figure was rising across the Gradations of Extremity once again as he Refined even more devoured authority, his whole existence pulsing with an ecstatic sensation as everything continued to rise to a greater level.
He felt the overpowering aura of the Undefined Existence once more.
And this time...he didn't disappear right away.
His eyes flickered with golden brilliance as he came to a stop and stared towards the calmly floating Undefined Existence before him.
Their exquisite features. The serpentine eyes and wide spanning wings. The gazes that portrayed utmost coldness and immensity as if everything was in the palm of their hands!
The pair of serpentine eyes on the center of its tenebrous wings that seemed just about to pulse and eradicate everything out of existence!
Noah stared at this glorious Undefined Existence as he spoke out with a flash of tyranny.
{An ugly little thing, aren't you?}
WAP!
Not even an instant passed after his words were uttered, he disappeared out of existence right away!

|...| The eyes of the Undefined Existence that had begun to inadvertently weave its Extreme vibrated with terrifying apathy as after having its dignity trampled on, its authority had moved automatically!
And the Insurgent before him had disappeared before this weaving could be expressed.
The Undefined Existence took a moment as the buzzing apathy in its eyes calmed, their gaze beginning to pulse and release vibrations outwardly a moment later.
It couldn't allow a mere Seed's words to interfere with its plans as within a few milliseconds...
|There...|
BZZT!

It once more sensed a blazing brilliance that was even brighter than before, its massive figure making its way across the waters of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity and appearing before the Insurgent again.

This time, the Insurgent was doing something even more extreme as an illusory purple throne of royalty had materialized behind him, his figure being seated on it as he turned to look towards the Undefined Existence!
As if a seated Emperor was gazing at a visitor with his immeasurable majesty.
Noah's eyes held burning golden flames as his brow rose while he spoke again.
{Can't even control your anger at a slight provocation...you do not seem as advanced and terrifying as others see you to be.}
His words were meant to cut to the one weakness he had sensed- the weaving of the emotions and thoughts of pride and majesty of this being!
Yet the Undefined Existence did not erupt with any weaving out authority as it continued to float towards him slowly.
The obsidian chain rising from its head shone with profound tenebrous brilliance as it cooly spoke.
Words that Noah could grasp very little of echoed from the Undefined Existence as its face holding a singular eye had its feature curve into a terrifying smile.
The singular serpentine eye...smiled!
|You could not even understand my words unless I wish you to, and you think you're something that will cause waves and disruptions?|
BOOM!
At this moment in time.
On this momentous day!
The Extremity of Quintessence and an Undefined Existence connected the Ones Above Extremity appeared face to face and exchanged words!
Noah's eyes were calm at the provocation of this creature before him as it continued.
|Do you know what I first said to you, little thing?|
As the Undefined Existence spoke, it continued to float ever closer towards him as its massive figure only became more and more menacing.
Its eye smiled with horrifying cruelty as it continued.
|I said that everything you're doing, the fight you think you're putting up, the Existential Extremity Authorities you are forging and elevating...all of it is hopeless.|
WAA!

|It's not even a matter of uncertainty whether you will go far. Whether your Existential Extremity Authorities will somehow reach a level to match Vacuous and Vitalis. Even if you struggle to reach that point, those Above can very easily erase everything about you. Hopeless, Little Insurgent. That is what your struggle is. That is what your whole existence is. A Hopeless endeavor...so why not stop this futile struggle and end things early? Why not save yourself the heartache, blood, sweat, and tears that will uncontrollably flow from your orifices in time? Come, let me help you resolve this struggle you are starting early and give you liberation. Let me help you, you worthless little Seed.|
Utmost cruelty and unfathomable brilliance shone within its serpentine eyes as it radiated pure emotions of extinction and cataclysm with its words alone!
It came within a mile of Noah's visage seated on the throne as it spoke such heavy words!
On the Throne, the Extremity of Quintessence buzzed with tendrils of Tyranny he tapped on his throne with a devilish smile while looking ahead.
{Were my actions hopeless, you wouldn't be here wasting my time with monologues, Ugly Thing.}
{But...do you know what I love to see the most, Ugly Thing?}
He leaned forward on his throne.
The Protagonist leaned forward while gazing with cold brilliance at the Undefined Existence as his words echoed out like booming symphonies.

{What I love the most is seeing that expression of pride on beings like you. That expression of arrogance and narcissism that you are at the very peak, untouchable and above all others. I love seeing that because it makes it all that much more fulfilling when inevitably, you will soon be groveling at my feet with that arrogance nowhere to be seen. The only thing left of your hubris will be shock and disbelief at how it was even possible, how a being like you is kneeling at my feet about to die. I can already see that a weak one like you, in particular, may even beg for your life when that point comes and ask for mercy. What is your name, Ugly Thing? Just so that I can remember what you are when the day you grovel at my feet comes.}
HUUM!

|...| The eyes of the Undefined Existence that had begun to inadvertently weave its Extreme vibrated with terrifying apathy as after having its dignity trampled on, its authority had moved automatically!
And the Insurgent before him had disappeared before this weaving could be expressed.
The Undefined Existence took a moment as the buzzing apathy in its eyes calmed, their gaze beginning to pulse and release vibrations outwardly a moment later.
It couldn't allow a mere Seed's words to interfere with its plans as within a few milliseconds...
|There...|
BZZT!

It once more sensed a blazing brilliance that was even brighter than before, its massive figure making its way across the waters of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity and appearing before the Insurgent again.

This time, the Insurgent was doing something even more extreme as an illusory purple throne of royalty had materialized behind him, his figure being seated on it as he turned to look towards the Undefined Existence!
As if a seated Emperor was gazing at a visitor with his immeasurable majesty.
Noah's eyes held burning golden flames as his brow rose while he spoke again.
{Can't even control your anger at a slight provocation...you do not seem as advanced and terrifying as others see you to be.}
His words were meant to cut to the one weakness he had sensed- the weaving of the emotions and thoughts of pride and majesty of this being!
Yet the Undefined Existence did not erupt with any weaving out authority as it continued to float towards him slowly.
The obsidian chain rising from its head shone with profound tenebrous brilliance as it cooly spoke.
Words that Noah could grasp very little of echoed from the Undefined Existence as its face holding a singular eye had its feature curve into a terrifying smile.
The singular serpentine eye...smiled!
|You could not even understand my words unless I wish you to, and you think you're something that will cause waves and disruptions?|
BOOM!
At this moment in time.
On this momentous day!
The Extremity of Quintessence and an Undefined Existence connected the Ones Above Extremity appeared face to face and exchanged words!
Noah's eyes were calm at the provocation of this creature before him as it continued.
|Do you know what I first said to you, little thing?|
As the Undefined Existence spoke, it continued to float ever closer towards him as its massive figure only became more and more menacing.
Its eye smiled with horrifying cruelty as it continued.
|I said that everything you're doing, the fight you think you're putting up, the Existential Extremity Authorities you are forging and elevating...all of it is hopeless.|
WAA!
|It's not even a matter of uncertainty whether you will go far.
Whether your Existential Extremity Authorities will somehow reach a level to match Vacuous and Vitalis.
Even if you struggle to reach that point, those Above can very easily erase everything about you.
Hopeless, Little Insurgent.
That is what your struggle is.
That is what your whole existence is.
A Hopeless endeavor...so why not stop this futile struggle and end things early?
Why not save yourself the heartache, blood, sweat, and tears that will uncontrollably flow from your orifices in time?
Come, let me help you resolve this struggle you are starting early and give you liberation.
Let me help you, you worthless little Seed.|
Utmost cruelty and unfathomable brilliance shone within its serpentine eyes as it radiated pure emotions of extinction and cataclysm with its words alone!
It came within a mile of Noah's visage seated on the throne as it spoke such heavy words!
On the Throne, the Extremity of Quintessence buzzed with tendrils of Tyranny he tapped on his throne with a devilish smile while looking ahead.
{Were my actions hopeless, you wouldn't be here wasting my time with monologues, Ugly Thing.}
{But...do you know what I love to see the most, Ugly Thing?}
He leaned forward on his throne.
The Protagonist leaned forward while gazing with cold brilliance at the Undefined Existence as his words echoed out like booming symphonies.
{What I love the most is seeing that expression of pride on beings like you.
That expression of arrogance and narcissism that you are at the very peak, untouchable and above all others.
I love seeing that because it makes it all that much more fulfilling when inevitably, you will soon be groveling at my feet with that arrogance nowhere to be seen.
The only thing left of your hubris will be shock and disbelief at how it was even possible, how a being like you is kneeling at my feet about to die.
I can already see that a weak one like you, in particular, may even beg for your life when that point comes and ask for mercy.
What is your name, Ugly Thing?
Just so that I can remember what you are when the day you grovel at my feet comes.}
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 2864 The Protagonist! IV
paragraphs: Words of utter disrespect echoed out from the Protagonist as he half expected to have the construct for Infinite Log On and Log Off activated an instant later!
But shockingly, the Undefined Existence only radiated a shocking splendor as its serpentine eyes shone with bloody murder.
They radiated such an intense emotion of apathy and cruelty unlike anything Noah had seen before!
{You didn't erupt with those unstable emotions of hubris swirling inside you after that?}
Noah's eyes squinted at this entity as he continued while leaning back on his throne.

{You may actually pose a slight challenge on my path, Ugly Thing. So, what is your name? Or I can only keep on referring to you as Ugly Thing. When more of you come, you'll be Ugly Thing I, and the next one will be Ugly Thing II. The next one is coming soon, right? I expect you've already called for help after sensing your own inadequacy and weakness, Ugly Thing I.}
His best weapon against them was currently their high pride and arrogance as his Authorities weren't able to do anything to them!
So he used this weapon to injure the mind of this Entity before him as much as he could as an instant later...
|Haha...|
The Undefined Existence placed its crystalline obsidian hands on its head as its singular eye was covered, its intent letting out a cruel laugh that held boundless anger within it!
|You worthless fucking Seed, you cannot imagine how much I'm looking forward to dissecting you and breaking you down from Existence.|
|But you have attitude, you nugatory little insect. So I'll give you the honor of knowing who will be the first to tear you apart.|
His hand left his head as his serpentine eye opened to reveal shocking animosity and cruelty.
|From the Legacy of Ignatius, I am Larseus Corvin.|
WAA!
Brilliance shone from the mere mention of his name as Vacuous Extremity Authority buzzed with majesty!
{Larseus Corvin, of the Legacy of Ignatius...}
Noah repeated the words with a smile as he rose, his throne disappearing behind him as he began to rise up ever so slowly once more.
{Thank you for sharing information of your name and where you come from, you dumb fucking thing. I'll see you soon.}
HUUM!
With such words left behind, Noah began to rise across the Gradations again as a mile from him, the figure of Larseus buzzed powerfully!
But not an instant later...a blinding white light bloomed as from another direction, Vitalis Extremity Authority blared with wild abandon as another Undefined Existence appeared.
The moment they saw Noah's figure, their arms rose and began to weave with authority as...
WAP!
Noah's figure automatically disappeared.
The Vitalis Undefined Existence came to float a distance away from Larseus Corvin as its eyes buzzed with brilliance.
|I had to test it to confirm your words. But...was that insect just calling you and insulting you by your name, Larseus?|
The newly arriving Undefined Existence raised their brows as beside them, Larseus burned with interminable rage as he spoke.
|Countermeasures need to be drawn against him. The Gradations of Extremity need to be covered as much as possible-|

|The Gradations are nigh endless for all of us to cover, you know that. I say we reach out to the Existential Engineers. They are most adept on Absolute Existential Restrictions and may be able to counter and isolate the Insurgent before he grows any further.|

The gaze of Larseus shone at such words as he turned towards the Entity beside him. |You Whitehats are always so quick to reach out for help. We invoke the Existential Engineers, and we won't stop hearing about it for eons-|
|It's better than allowing a threat of corruption to spread. It's a measure of safety that you Blackhats can't seem to grasp.|
A sense of tension filled the surroundings as both of these Entities stared at each other coldly!
Far, far away from them within these very same Sixth Gradations of Extremity, Noah's figure appeared once more as dazzling prompts bloomed before him.
{Infinite Log On and Log Off was activated automatically after sensing your Existence being targeted!}
{A miniscule shred(0.0001%) of the Authority of your enemy was successfully devoured!}
{You Existential Extremity Authorities are refining and purifying the foreign Existential Extremity Authority.}
{Your Understanding of the Undefined Existences is nearing a critical level.}

Tremendous gains were being made as his Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures exploded past 6 Million, with his own Existential Extremity Authorities continuing to rise to a shocking level as at this time...
{The Existential Authority of the Protagonist fully resonates and settles with your existence.}
{With its advent, new Absolute Existential Constructs viable only for you are born!}
As he rose upwards across the clear waters, his visage shone with Aurum brilliance as the Protagonist and its unique state of being with himself made way for something unfathomable.
{The Protagonist asks for all authorities to remember what its weaving actually means.}
The other Concepts of Extremity within Noah were pulled upon to listen as existence shattering prompts unveiled themselves!

{In certain stories, a Protagonist is surrounded and guided by a Prophecy as a form of MacGuffin. You can now design your own prophecy to go towards fulfilling your aims. Once a prophecy is made, the Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist will distort reality through any means necessary to fulfill the prophecy.}

{In other stories, the Protagonist starts out average and normal, yet as the Plot progresses, they come to find out they descend from an ancient faction, or carry a royal or unique lineage, Innate ability, or a power of some hidden fantastical world or dimension that they then delved into and explore, or that they're some Chosen One. You can now design something Innate or unique to you that will inexplicably come to aid you on your journey.}
Two ridiculous constructs came forward from the Protagonist as just by looking at them, Noah saw their potential for utterly existence breaking actions!

chapters.title: Chapter 2865 The Protagonist! V
paragraphs: The two prompts that had just come down were utterly ridiculous ones.
Noah's vision shifted greatly as instead of the Waters of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity being his main focus, his eyes shone with brilliance inside the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

The Infinite Hyperversal Haven that was abuzz with activity as entities went in and out of Rifts, their eyes holding a sense of awe and majesty as by this point in time- they all knew the Dungeon Raid Rift System and how they could attain wondrous Loot that propelled their power rapidly.
The emotion being weaved in their hearts was a unique one that was closely coming to the border with obsession!

Many Entities were also spurred on after watching the battle between the Queens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and a single terrifying enemy that stood against them- the Existential Raid Boss, Ruination!
This battle had been the longest one that had played out as it showed multiple beings at the peak of power facing a single one...and yet they still couldn't attain victory against Ruination.
It was a lesson in the understanding of Extremes.
How even though the Queens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven had multiple Concepts of Extremity in their hands through the Extremity of Quintessence, they didn't truly understand them!
How could they manipulate their intent? How could they understand their weaving?

Such a reality was why at this moment, the figure of Barbatos was surrounded by broken skeletons as dozens of Middle Grade Armaments of Extremity surrounded her, and the visage of Queen Adelaide was standing in front of Ruination herself as while encased in ice...she sighed and spoke lightly.
{Worthiness aside, we need to spend time familiarizing ourselves with everything. Thank you for the reminder...I yield.}
Her figure disappeared into stellar snow willingly as she replied to the question Ruination had asked about in the beginning of their battle.
{Fuck!} A profanity was the last thing heard on the battlefield as the rows of illusory Armaments of Extremity struck down from all sides to finish off Barbatos!
This...was the battle streamed live for all to see.
An exchange of the extremes of the Extremity of Quintessence!
A glimmer of Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny!

Unbeknownst to them, Noah had added a Fourth Existential Extremity Authority at this moment as with his main body secluded in the pocket of space where a curved throne made of an infinity symbol stood, he was currently reading the weaving of this new concept and what opportunities it laid out for him.

Beside him, Ruination pulsed with the weavings of Intent that explained the battle she had finished where she systematically broke down his Harem, part of his mind sighing and preparing for the trouble to come as he prepared dozens of Planalith Krystallos and Armaments of Extremity for them.
At the same time, the Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven had a serene gaze as she uttered out.
{A Prophecy, or a Hidden Descent...}
The means of the Protagonist were unique ones as even she was computing what could best be done with them.

In some stories, there was always a prophecy passed down since ancient times that would come to revolve around the Protagonist. From the past stories Noah read, he knew they mainly came in verses or riddles that the Main Character and his friends had to solve to better understand where the conflict and difficulty was heading.

A lot of the times, the characters wouldn't find out what the prophecy truly meant until it actually occurred and played out, with the excerpt of the book being abruptly ended as the main character looks at an unfolding reality in shock while repeating out the words of the prophecy- setting up the next stage of their journey and giving the readers a wait time of years before the next installment was produced by the author.
Now, Noah could design his own prophecy as if he were truly the main character, and he would know its meaning intricately as if he were the author that designed it in the first place!
{Hmm...} His eyes burned with ingenuity and possibilities as he thought of the current unfolding reality around him and the enemies that he faced.
A prophecy could foretell a journey in a short term or span a really long time, but what he knew of the Unrecorded Histories was limited.

He could design something abstract and yet capable of influencing his immediate future and beyond, with his eyes beginning to burn with an Aurum glow in the next moment as the Aurum Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of the Protagonist began to radiate a grand and mighty power!
His lips were curved into a smile as he spoke, beginning to etch a prophecy into reality as if he were the author of his own story!
{Waters crossed with unimaginable speed.
Immeasurable extremes all brought under a single creed.
One by one, Legacies shall fall.
White and black will come under the heel of the call.
Only one Extreme will be left at the end of it all.
Unshackled lands will rise above Recorded Havens.
Annals will fall as an endless weaving awakens!}
HUUM!
Every line Noah spoke resonated and buzzed with the surrounding reality as the words were etched with golden brilliance before him!
A prophecy!
He had designed his own prophecy as it foretold of multiple futures, and he also wanted one that would have a direct effect on his current unfolding reality.
{Waters crossed with unimaginable speed}

The moment this line of the prophecy was etched, the hundreds of thousands of Aurum Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of the Protagonist blared as they pulled upon the Existential Extremity Authorities of Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny- along with the weavings of all of Noah's other concepts.
It did all of this as once more, when Noah's vision shifted back to the waters of the Gradations of Extremity...
BOOOM!

His body was shooting upwards like a speeding bullet as the waters around him converged and were swallowed up by his existence rapidly, his Extremity Rune Scriptures jumping by hundreds of thousands each moment as he scaled at an unprecedented pace!

chapters.title: Chapter 2866 The Protagonist! VI
paragraphs: It was the first line of the prophecy, and yet its unfolding effects absolutely ignored the heavy pressure and reality of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity as Noah climbed up at a shocking speed, with this only being the first and immediate result so far as it was only the beginning.
This was because the other concepts of the Protagonist were weaving in their own unique ways due to the advent of this prophecy!
{The Extremity of Plot dances with glee at the development.}
{The Extremity of Paradox pulls on every ounce of its power to express the established prophecy!}
His extremes weaved as above the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, a booming symphony began to echo out as a booming paradoxical voice echoed out.
{The Extremity of the Protagonist has laid down a prophecy!}
HUUM!
The minds of all beings in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven shook.
They gazed up towards the peak of the Extremity Vein as golden words began to form, each one spoke out with great valor and power as if they deserved to be known!
{Waters crossed with unimaginable speed.
Immeasurable extremes all brought under a single creed.
One by one, Legacies shall fall.
White and black will come under the heel of the call.
Only one Extreme will be left at the end of it all.
Unshackled lands will rise above Recorded Havens.
Annals will fall as an endless weaving awakens!}
The visage of the Cimmerian Architect, Ishtar, and Sargon trembled at the golden words the size of cosmos etched near the peak of the Extremity Vein brilliantly for all to see.
Henry gazed at the means of his father calmly as the Queens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven reflecting on the power they had attained also gazed up wordlessly!
Kazuhiko blinked as he could barely get his words out, but his thoughts were vibrant ones.
'A prophecy? Protagonist? What the fuck?!'
Shock and pure adulation coursed through the minds of Noah's closest people as they wondered what crazy reality altering things he was doing now.
But they would be among the minority.
Because the announcement of the First Prophecy...did not just end within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
In the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.
Within the Havens of these lands bathed in their own Existential Extremity Authorities!
A paradoxical light of existence and nonexistence boomed out as within each Haven...
Golden words began to be etched as a heavy and resonant voice boomed out with it as if it were a grand declaration.

Within the Supernal Haven of Dissolution, the main body of Emperor Shao was within a gorgeous white pool of Vitalis as he grasped a Middle Grade Vitalis Planalith Krystallos, his expression full of complexities when he raised his head in shock, his will spanning outwards and gazing at the far distant skies of the Supernal Haven of Dissolution as grand golden words began to be etched along with a resonant voice ringing out.
{Waters crossed with unimaginable speed.

The moment these golden words appeared and began ringing out, tendrils of pure Vitalis Hyperversal Authority instantly erupted and rained down to tear them apart, with Emperor Shao witnessing something shocking as in the skies- a rift tore open as Records spilled out to reveal an Undefined Existence shining with glorious light.

Its serpentine eyes were currently blazing with mad anger as it waved its butterfly like wings behind its back, gusts of white light instantly blooming out to entirely erase the golden words that had appeared!
A moment later, this Undefined Existence flickered out and disappeared.

A sense of awe and trepidation filled Emperor Shao as the whole Celestia Extremity Lineage in the surrounding Archipelagos were roused to activity, powerful beings raising their eyes and Wills as the voice of the golden words that had appeared still rang out in their minds!
In the veils of Records and far distant histories.
Within the Veil of Arcadia.
The burly tanned figure of the Extremity of Steel opened his eyes with a trace of shock and spoke out heavily.
{One by one, Legacies shall fall...White and black will come under the heel of the call!}
These words were profane and filled with utmost disrespect against the very Existential Extremity Authorities governing Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.
And they rang out across Records and Havens as this single action caused the Primogenitor of Steel to gaze towards Curagulus with shining eyes.

The two beings looked at each other as they realized...someone was truly waging war against the Ones Above Extremity, and they had enough authority to even taunt them and lay out some form of a prophecy!
It was a shocking development as they knew on this day...winds of great change were about to bloom!
Far away from them, within the Nether Haven of Dissolution.
In front of the massive purple Monolith floating in space.

Yet, their serpentine eyes were filled with coldness as at the forefront, an Undefined Existence with golden flames covering the exterior of her wings and the rims of her pupils spoke out as her intent was made known.
|One by one, Legacies shall fall...how does the Insurgent know about our Legacies already?|
Her voice was of utmost coldness and filled with immeasurable weight as of the multiple Undefined Existence that had appeared here, all were silent until one began to weave their intent carefully.
|A Blackhat that came across it in the Gradations of Extremity was loose with their intent.|
A heavy silence descended as the foremost appearing Undefined Existence pulsed with coldness.
|This Insurgent has gone too far and is growing bolder by the minute. A resolution is a must, and quickly.|
A terrifying weaving began to bloom as at this moment in time, the honor and glory of powers that very few knew or even understood were brought to light!

His extremes weaved as above the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, a booming symphony began to echo out as a booming paradoxical voice echoed out.

Henry gazed at the means of his father calmly as the Queens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven reflecting on the power they had attained also gazed up wordlessly!
Kazuhiko blinked as he could barely get his words out, but his thoughts were vibrant ones.

What the fuck?!'

chapters.title: Chapter 2867 The Protagonist! VII
paragraphs: The newly appearing Undefined Existence that took the lead amongst the over a dozen currently in front of the Existential Dungeon Monolith was a particularly terrifying one as her word seemed to be the law.

|Our Legacy of Al-Abalem is not one to loosely mince the Weaving of Existence. Our Existential Engineers have spoken- they need samples of these two Existential Extremity Authorities being utilized by the Insurgent and the other Corrupted Seeds.|
The Legacy of Al-Abalem!
This was the second Legacy mentioned after the one that Noah had learned about- the Legacy of Ignatius.
|Yes, Cavalier Reylyra.|
As the Intents weaved, the Undefined Existences waved their hands to reveal glistening white glass tubes that had tremendously sharp needles at their very ends.

In addition to this, the visage of the one called Cavalier Reylyra brought her hands in front of her chest as the serpentine eye in front of it pulsed with bright milky white light, space tearing open above them as a massive construct began to spill out!
Being the size of a Cosmos, the aura it radiated far exceeded a Middle Grade Armament of Extremity as it had to be a High Grade Armament of Extremity or even more sublime than this!

It looked like a massive cylinder connected to a circular balloon that extended forward to form a sharp needle like end- the balloon like portion of the construct constantly expanding and contracting as it drew in the surrounding authority.
The purple light emanated from the Existential Dungeon Monolith began to be drawn towards this construct ever so slowly as Cavalier Reylyra watched on coldly.

|Due to the Absolute Existential Restrictions, gathering and containing samples will be hard. Use the smaller versions of the Imbibing Needle Guard on the Corrupted Seeds within the Dungeon to obtain more samples. Once the Existential Extremity Authorities are broken down by the Engineers, we can better learn how to track it down and how to counter it.|
Imbibing Needle Guard!
This was the massive construct that appeared above, its circular portion pumping and contracting constantly as the needle end drew in the surrounding authority.

Cavalier Reylyra called the small white glass tubes with sharp ends that could be grasped within one's hands a smaller version of such a construct, even though these small tubes released the aura of Middle Grade Armaments of Extremity!
|The seeds are prepared?|

Her intent turned to those behind her who had been present since the Dungeon Monolith appeared as two Undefined Existences noded, one waving their hands to cause another rift to open where another Undefined Existence stepped out of...but they weren't alone.

In between the wings of the Undefined Existence stepping out, the figures of a man and a woman could be seen as terrifying white tendrils of Vitalis wrapped around them like chains, their faces in pain as their very souls seemed to be getting constricted!
Shockingly, these entities surrounded by tendrils of Vitalis were at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity.

Beside this Undefined Existence stepping out, two humanoid Entities expressing powerful Auras at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity could be seen as their faces held insurmountable rage and helplessness- both looking towards the two prisoners in between the wings of the Undefined Existence as if they could feel their pain!

|The so called Primogenitor of the Sword and the Primogenitor of Dust. We hold those they are inseparably weaved with emotionally as the chances of them being corrupted are minuscule. If they want their people safe and still in existence, they will achieve what we wish for them to achieve.|

The two Entities between the wings of the Undefined Existences were prisoners. The ones following behind, one being the Primogenitor of the Sword- a middle aged man with white hair dancing wildly on his shoulders, and the Primogenitor of Dust- a woman with gray hair and pristine beauty with eyes full of pain could be seen!
Their loved ones were held hostage as they had to do the bidding of the Undefined Existences!
This was a pathway for the Undefined Existences to select as the threat of more Seeds being corrupted was high of they simply threw them into the Existential Dungeon Monolith.
The Seeds had to be given a reason for going against the Insurgent and the Corrupted Seeds under him, not to eventually join them in such corruption.
And holding those who were intricately connected to them as the bargaining chips...was a much more thorough pathway.
|Use these on the body of any Enemy you meet at the Fourth Gradation or Higher.|

Cavalier Reylyra spoke coldly as the Miniature Imbibing Needle Guards were granted to the Primogenitor of the Sword and the Primogenitor of Dust who accepted them with complex emotions while glancing far behind them!

|No need for dramatics. Serve your purpose and you can continue your Records as you were. Ahead of you are Insurgents who are the Prime reason why the weaving of reality led to your current situation. They may try to appeal to you. They may try to get you to join their cause. Know that this is a lost cause and only a recipe for destruction.|

After the Miniature Imbibing Needle Guards were given out, the three Altars behind also shone as the dazzling Extremity Clones of the Blue, Amestris, and the Avernus Extremity Overlord were formed once more- their auras grander than ever.
But their eyes held a sense of hollowness as if they weren't fully who they were minutes ago.
As if they were there...but there were simply fewer of them.
As if their very existence was somehow being used up!

But their gazes were resolute as they also grasped the Miniature Imbibing Needle Guards, following the lead of the Primogenitor of the Sword and Dust as they disappeared into the Existential Dungeon Monolith!
The reality around them distorted and changed as in an instant, they appeared in a cavernous pathway lined up by shattered purple cosmic stars.

The instant they delved in, the far distant Raid Boss in the furthest location within the Existential Dungeon Monolith was alerted as the eyes of Anvil of Anarchos, Sargon, lit up with a domineering royal purple light!

chapters.title: Chapter 2868 Of Interminable Descent! I
paragraphs: Sargon sensed the auras of the enemies that had just entered as these ones were nothing to scoff at, the ones leading the way being past Legends at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity!
The Primogenitor of the Sword- Soldenius!
The Primogenitor of Dust- Livia!

Their eyes currently showed resoluteness as they instantly turned into streams of light that followed the weaving of Extremity, beginning to tear through the Dungeon rapidly as behind them, the Avernus Leaders with their existence being eaten up followed.
Sargon's Intent moved as even though he trusted in his new power, he didn't know whether it would be enough to withstand two Entities in the Seventh Gradation of Extremity.
One was a possibility with such a powerful Existential Extremity Authority and Bloodline coursing through him, but two was pushing it!
But even as his intent began to weave...
{The Extremity of Systems has discerned the weaving of reality and is sending reinforcements.}
An intent could be felt budding within his bloodline as Sargon settled.
His bright eyes filled with age flashed as he knew he was one of the most powerful Entities within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
If the Extremity of Systems himself wasn't coming, who would he send that would be capable of aiding him against Entities at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity?
HUUM!

Behind his throne, space cracked and fissured as it tore open a portal that revealed beautiful legs coming through, the figures of three drop dead gorgeous women making their way through as they were none other than Barbatos, Athena, and Xiaomi.
Their bodies coursed with a unique power as Athena in particular was wielding a multicolored spear so heavy that her right arm was slightly trembling from it!
Barbatos was draped in Middle Grade Armaments of Extremity formed from bones and steel while Xiaomi had a Middle Grade Armament Battledress that shimmered with endless quasars and Singularities.
{Alright girls, time for our redemption. Remember, Little Fish wants us to only use Tyranny and Infinity against the enemies we come across for now.}
The voice of Barbatos rang out as the three women nodded towards Sargon.
Trust was innately budding in Sargon's Will as if the Extremity of Systems sent these beings as the reinforcements, then he would choose to believe him!
With this in mind, his authority as the Raid Boss moved.

The Defenders who were about to come across entities at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity were instantly swept with a light of spatial displacement that took them from one location of the Existential Dungeon Monolith and into another, and they very quickly appeared within the Raid Boss Throne Room and came face to face with Sargon seated on the throne and the figure of Barbatos, Athena, and Xiaomi!
{Ho? This won't be easy...}
Barbatos smiled as a deathly authority began to rise behind her, six massive rifts beginning to open as each one radiated a terrifying glow of an Undead at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity.

Xiaomi's figure buzzed with marvel as she pulled upon the weaving of Infinity, her body lighting up like a cluster of endless stars while Athena... gripped the spear in her hand tightly as her battleborn eyes gazed closely at the two strongest enemies in front of them.
{You two...do not have your heart in this battle. Why are you fighting?}
She could see it in their eyes.
They were filled with unwillingness and pain, with their intent seemingly forced to be here as they weren't resonating with this battle here!
The ancient eyes of the Primogenitor of Dust vibrated as she stepped forward while shaking her head.

{Our people were taken hostage to make you all our enemies...but this woeful tale does not matter. Whether we want to fight or not, doesn't matter. We were all once mere dust in the stars, and we shall return to dust. Ashes to ashes, dust to dust!}
HUUM!
A terrifying weaving erupted from her as an extreme gray light permeated the surroundings, intent on turning everything back to how it once was!
Athena gave a heavy nod as the spear in her hands buzzed, and she carried it forward by circulating every ounce of authority she had as this spear...had gone by many names before.
Atlatl.
Xyston.
A Spear based on the weight and majesty of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven itself.
She couldn't truly wield the real thing, so she held an imitation of it currently as permitted by the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
She hoisted such a spear up at this moment as with great momentum, she surged towards a Legend!
But in the next moment...
SHIING!
A sword light bloomed as an extremely sharp point of a sword appeared inches away from her forehead.
Inches away, and yet it didn't go any further as on the sharp blades of the sword, the claws of an Abyssal Hyperversal Undead Record Devourer held it still.
The jaws of an Abyssal Hyperversal Undead Dragonoid held it down, and the chains of the Abyssal Hyperversal Undead Grave Emperor wrapped all around it!

Rising up while seated on the skull of an Abyssal Hyperversal Undead Qilin, Barbatos crossed her legs with a devilish smile as she felt the explosive power of this entity at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity.
{My oh my, we have an excited one here. I won't be able to hold him for long if you all want to jump in now!}

Her words spurred Xiaomi and Sargon on as the figure of Athena dipped sideways to evade the halted sword tip, her spear thundering towards the blooming cloud of dust and the insignificant figures of the Avernus Leaders in the back!
A great battle bloomed here as its unfolding reality was relayed to the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, and of course, to the Extremity of Quintessence.
Within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
In an isolated domain.
{Utilizing the loved ones of Primogenitors as Hostages to make them fight on their behalf and reduce the chance of them joining my ranks...well, that's one way to go about it.}
The voice of the Protagonist who had just enacted a prophecy was resonant as he gazed at the unfolding scenes and tremendous power of entities at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity.
The gulf between Gradations was a heavy, but he had crossed multiple gulfs before due to his Concepts.
And at that point in time, he didn't even have his concepts at the Existential level, and he now held multiple!

These concepts coursed within his people, and they coursed within Barbatos and the other Queens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven with abundance. Against those of the Higher Gradations- against beings that had begun to gain a deep understanding of the Weaving of Extremes...just how would his concepts and his people fare?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2869 Of Interminable Descent! II
paragraphs: When it came to the current phase of battles, the concepts one had reigned supreme as no concepts were grander than Existential ones.
They should be able to blur the lines between the Gradations of Extremity, especially since the enemies they faced only had a single Existential Extremity Authority to rely on!
Noah knew this well as he now sat with four Existential Extremity Authorities.
And the most recent one...still had an overabundance of surprises left in store as it gave Noah a unique but dangerous perspective.
The Extremity of the Protagonist.
It's Extreme was Noah, and the weaving truly lived up to this as even Noah himself had the perspective right now that he was the Protagonist of the unfolding reality!
It gave him a sense of bravado that everything would always be okay. That since he was the Protagonist, everything would somehow turn out okay.

This was powerful and dangerous at the same time as it meant the Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist had to always succeed in expressing its extreme, where even if there was a single time that its extreme couldn't be expressed- if Noah could not keep the mantle and reality of the Protagonist...a monumental disaster may occur!
So every move he made from here on out truly had to reflect the actions of the Protagonist.
Unlike Quintessence, Infinity, or Tyranny, this extreme had to always and constantly be expressed.

So when it came to the second feature apart from the grand Prophecy he enacted....he had to utilize it to allow an utterly overpowered and nonsensical reality of a true protagonist to come to fruition.

The second feature stated that in stories, a protagonist started out average, and yet over the progression of a ridiculous and cliche plot, they come to find they are somehow connected to an unimaginably powerful lineage, hold an Innate power deep within them, or that they're some Chosen One that the world was waiting for!
Noah didn't have some hidden lineage or history attached to himself.
He was born from a drunkard father and a hardworking woman in the healthcare field as through his own power and twists of coincidences and fortune, he was where he stood today.
From being connected to the Mana of his home world to the Spiritual Land, to the Ruination Core and gradual ascent until he held the Infinite Hyperversal Haven that he grasped now.
His Lineage was one that he forged himself through Quintessence.
So was his Soul, Origin, and Body!
Each one was Unrecorded and had not appeared in the eons of History as he forged them himself.
And now, he wanted to take a step forward where through his own sheer concept of Extremity, he would design for himself an identity to match that of a Protagonist!
{My identity...is a unique one.}
Noah began to speak as the Aurum Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of the Protagonist began to churn!

Near him, the Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and Ruination gazed towards him with somber gazes as they felt a single Golden Existential Extremity Authority pull upon all others along with Noah's other concepts to achieve what he was about to enact.

{It is not an identity one is born with, but one they come to inherit after eons of Quintessential Honorariums across Existence. It is a state of being that stems from the Weavings of Extremity and Existence itself...a Lineage of Histories Recorded and Unrecorded that understands the Weaving of Extremes as if they were mere extensions of their limbs.}
WAA!
As he spoke, Noah seemed to be more and more confident and convinced of his words- as if what he was saying was true all along, and has always been true!
His eyes curved into a devilish light as he began to feel the Quintessential Annals of Extremity trembling.
The very Infinite Hyperversal Haven then began to tremble as its manifestation turned somber, its authorities churning to affirm just what changes were about to occur!
{Exceeding the spacetime continuum, Annals, existence and nonexistence, the state of being that flows within the very core of the Extremity of the Protagonist is that of the Weaver...}
RUMBLE!
{The Weaver of Extremity...}

The moment Noah finished these words, his whole existence became suffused with terrifying golden light as the Aurum Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of the Protagonist filled utterly everything.

They seemed to force a chain reaction with all of his Extremity Rune Scriptures as the golden light permeated everything, filling up the isolated domain Noah was in and beginning to expand outwards onto the larger Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
{The Quintessential Annals of Extremity are Recording down an ancient and interminable History that is being unearthed after unknown eons.}
{An unfathomable state of being is assimilating into your Lineage!}
An ancient and extremely old Vermillion colored light began to bloom amidst the gold.
The gold that even at this moment was stretching out to cover all of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and permeating across its myriad of records!
{The Distinction of your Lineage has begun to change.}
{The Lineage of the Tyrannical Quintessential Existential Weaver of Extremity has been born!}
The moment such a prompt came.
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven paused as Noah's visage radiated a tremendous vermillion colored light amidst waves of gold.
This vermillion light was encompassing and pervasive as it passed over all concepts flowing across Noah's existence, and...
{All your Extremes are attaining a synchronized flow.}
A flow.
Not a convergence of Dynamis of Extremity, but simply a flow that all his extremes weaved together!

Like an interminable ancient engine, his extremes felt like innumerable rivers flowing across his body to form a singular immeasurable sea- attaining a sense of power that far surpassed his previous self!
{The Authority of your Extremes following the same synchronized flow is automatically being shared.}
{Your most potent and elevated extremes can empower all others with a semblance of their power!}
A set of prompts came that caused the eyes of the Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven to dilate, and for Ruination to open her lips in shock!

chapters.title: Chapter 2870 Of Interminable Descent! III
paragraphs: He unearthed an identity for himself that he termed the Weaver of Extremity!
The first thing that occurred the moment this state of being settled on Noah was all of his extremes flowing across his existence in synchrony.
And the prompts that followed stated that his most powerful extremes could bathe and empower others with the light of their power!
This caused something glorious for the light of the Aurum glow of the Protagonist.
The Amethyst glow of Tyranny.
The Cerulean glow of Infinity.
The Colorless glow of Quintessence.

Four fantastical glows covered in Existential Extremity Authorities now proceeded to bathe over the innumerable rivers of extremes forming into a sea, the glow of Existential Extremity Authorities coming to cover all of his concepts!
Plot felt the pristine light of the Existential level.
Apocalypse felt this pristine light wash over its Extremity Rune Scriptures.

Loot, Systems, Cheats, Plagiarism...all of Noah's concepts felt the glow of the Existential level wash over them as even though they did not reach this level, their extremes gained a small depth of empowerment of such a level as they reached new heights!

Loot, Systems, Cheats, Plagiarism...all of Noah's concepts felt the glow of the Existential level wash over them as even though they did not reach this level, their extremes gained a small depth of empowerment of such a level as they reached new heights!
{Under the light of the Weaver of Extremity, your Concepts have gained Existential Empowerment.}
First was his concepts.

The Infinite Hyperversal Haven felt the effects of this firsthand as Manadynamics, Entropy, Dreams, Elysium...all of the extremes of the Natural Laws and Decreta were affected as the domains of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven began to churn and elevate.
And after his concepts...
{The Weaver of Extremity is a child born and bred under the light of innumerable extremes.}
{They understand the weaving of extremes to an unfathomable level as they reach adulthood.}
{In your stage of infancy, the weavings of extremes begin to lay themselves bare before your eyes!}
His blood churned as an ancient vermillion light covered it entirely, his soul becoming filled with a light of scrutiny and a vision that could pierce eons of Records and Existence.
Around his body, vermillion colored flames began to rise as they danced on his skin.
A blazing coagulation of Haki formed into a Vermillion aura of flames that seemed to contain the weavings of all of his extremes- of all of their desires and intents!
As for the full effects of this...it could truly be discerned within the waters of the Gradations of Extremity as at this moment, in the clear waters Noah was slowly climbing...
His body began to burn with vermillion colored flames that caused the waters around him to churn, his whole existence leaving no gaps as he held a flow far exceeding that of a Dynamis of Extremity!
The heavy pressure he used to feel was disappearing at an alarming pace as his figure buzzed against the waters he was in, and in the next moment...
WAP!
He disappeared.
And moments later, the conflagration of vermillion flames reappeared far, far above across light years as it arrived at the demarcation between the Sixth and Seventh Gradations of Extremity.
BOOM!

An influx of the waters of the Gradations of Extremity surged into him as his existence was elevated, his eyes resolute as his hands reached out towards the thin barrier that once passed- he would arrive in the waters of the Seventh Gradation of Extremity!
This...was just moments after he attained his identity as the Weaver of Extremity.
As his Lineage became that of the Tyrannical Quintessential Existential Weaver of Extremity!
Now, something unique in all of this was the fact that this was his lineage, yes.
But he shared his lineage with many others.
Most of them held much less purity and potency of his lineage, but they had it nonetheless!
And since it changed at this moment to become the Tyrannical Quintessential Existential Weaver of Extremity, so did the lineage coursing through his people gain a semblance of this madness.
In the Existential Dungeon Monolith within the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
Xiaomi was working in conjunction with Athena to rebuff the unwavering domain of the Extreme of Dust spreading towards them as it held the weaving of multiple extremes converged into it!
They felt the suppression and pressure of the entity at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity as they were only hanging on due to the sheer exemplary wonders of the concepts that supported them.
But at this moment, Xiaomi felt her existence burning as shocking, vermillion flames began to dance around her pupils.
They caused the quasars her body was made of to shine with a shocking light as a moment later, she felt the extremes within her body beginning to follow a synchronized flow!
She...was using Ruin at this time as when the flow began, she felt the light and glimmer of Infinity floating alongside Ruin and many of the concepts that coursed within her.

And since they held the same flow, she inadvertently felt tendrils of Infinity flow into her weaving of Ruin, and the rusty crimson light of this chaotic construct instantly gained a shade of blue as her eyes shot out a crimson blue light that went on to pierce the cloud of Dust ahead!
Ruin and Infinity had joined together...but it wasn't the convergence of a Dynamis as Xiaomi simply followed the flow of extremes that were cycling within her existence smoothly.

And after she did this once, she also found the synchronized flow of Tyranny as she brought it ever closer to Ruin and Infinity, her figure coming to release an archaic light of power at this moment that shattered the cloud of Dust proliferating ahead of them!

From behind, the visage of the Primogenitor of Dust could be seen gazing forth incredulously as she wondered how the entities who were struggling against her all of a sudden began to weave multiple shocking extremes together to the extent of being able to counter her.
But Xiaomi wasn't alone.
{Holy shit...}

The blessed chest of Barbatos shook as her extremes of Necromancy and Death found themselves intertwined with Tyranny, a terrific purple glow beginning to cover her Abyssal Hyperversal Undead as her own figure became bathed with a vermillion glow!
It was the advent of the changes of the Weaver of Extremity.
An identity chosen by the Weaver of Extremity himself!
