chapters.title: Chapter 2871 The Weaver of Extremity! I
paragraphs: 2871 The Weaver of Extremity! I
The phenomenon was a shocking one as Barbatos found her concepts flowing with a shocking sense of freedom and intent, and she found it easy to layer one intent on top of the other seamlessly!
Even more than this, she looked at the enemy ahead of her who wielded a sharp sword.
[You...are the sword itself...] She found herself muttering as her eyes saw something she couldn't see before.

She was seeing the weaving of the Extremity of the Sword as if it were laid bare before her eyes, and she could see its strength and barely any gaps of weakness to exploit as she saw the Primogenitor of the Sword in front of her...
[You're no longer a common Lifeform...for the extreme of the Sword, your very existence is transforming into such a thing!]
A shocking analytical light bloomed in her eyes as opposite her, the Primogenitor of the Sword opened his eyes in stern shock as if he was seen through.
The sword he was holding in his hands disappeared as Barbatos marveled at what she saw next.

The weaving of the Sword unfurled before her eyes as the entity at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity...turned into a gloriously sharp white sword pulsing with tendrils of pure Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
The extreme of the Sword.
His own physiology was changing to become an indomitable sword!
Yet even as she saw this...

[Haha!] Barbatos laughed out as she felt her Abyssal Hyperversal Undead radiate an even more domineering light as in addition to Tyranny and Infinity, she felt like she could stack the weaving of multiple more extremes on top of Necromancy and Death up to the extent that her soul could bear!

It gave her a tremendous sense of versatility as she could switch out the concepts she was allowing to weave together at any time, unlike a converged Dynamis of Extremity. It was a sense of freedom that could only come from the actions of a single being!
'Little Fish, just what are you doing now?'
She wondered about the Weaver of Extremity.
And this being in question was experiencing a shocking phenomenon in the distant Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
Before his body that was surrounded by an ancient aura of raging vermillion colored flames, dense amounts of prompts continued to fall.
[A Member of your lineage gazed upon the weaving of the Extremity of the Sword.]
[As the Weaver of Extremity, the weaving of this Extreme has become prevalent in your eyes.]
[You have attained the Extremity of the Sword.]
[A Member of your lineage gazed upon the weaving of the Extremity of Dust...]
He wasn't even there.
Just his people were fighting against others utilizing their own extremes as wisps of his lineage caught this, and as a result- he somehow gained understanding in the weaving of these concepts!
The identity he has set for himself...was more outstanding than any unique power or standing as a Chosen One could have granted as its boons seemed to only be getting started.
[As the Weaver of Extremity, the very workings of Extremity, Existence, and Records have begun to communicate with you.]
[From this point forward, Records, Extremes, and the Weavings of Existence prevalent to you will be transmitted and understood.]
[Holy...]
Just what had he done?
HUUM!
His existence buzzed with an immense influx of information and records that seemed to stem from innumerable sources!
Records prevalent to him.
Extremes or weavings prevalent to him would all be felt by him!
Just these words alone weren't enough to fully encapsulate just the wonders Noah was experiencing at this moment as a part of his will began to receive an influx of Records he had no idea about.
[Whispers relating to you and your actions are causing a specific weaving of extremes and existence to gather in distant records.]
His soul received information that stretched out towards the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.

More specifically, the Vitalis Annals of Extremity where in the depths of Recorded and Unrecorded Histories, he was receiving information about a particular veiled Record known as...the Veil of Arcadia!

[Two Entities, distinguished as the Primogenitor of Steel and Curagulus, have called for a meeting of the prominent Entities within the Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity in response to the weaving of your existence.]
[Prominent entities gather within the Veil of Arcadia, intent on seeing which paths will open up with the changes brought about by your advent.]

The scene within his mind burned as he could truly see the hidden domain known as the Veil of Arcadia crystal clear, along with the powerful auras continuing to appear within it as a meeting held because of his actions was about to take place!

[Whispers of those they call the Ones Above Extremity cloud their hearts and minds as they seek for direction, and at the same time, these very same beings want to ensure that no more anomalies appear within those they refer to as Seeds. Thus, the weavings of this meeting are not those of the native Primogenitors of Vacuous and Vitalis alone, but also the ones they refer to as the Ones Above Extremity who are bound to present themselves.]
They weren't alone.

Powerful entities like the Extremity of Steel and Curagulus were watching as many powerful Entities gathered, and yet amongst them, those they referred to as the Ones Above Extremity were bound to appear to ensure that they retained their identities as perfect Seeds without any corruption!
Noah...was this corruption.
The fact that he veered off track and created an Existential Extremity Authority was against the wishes of the...
The...
The eyes of the Weaver of Extremity turned cold.
[What are you all?]
A blazing vermillion colored light covered him as he asked the uncountable weavings he was connected to on just what the identity of the Undefined Existences was.
He didn't know it before, nor could he find out about it easily as his gaze was obscured.
But now, he was the Weaver of Extremity.
And the musings of Records, Existence, and Extremity spoke to him with utter ease as he was still only in his infancy!

More specifically, the Vitalis Annals of Extremity where in the depths of Recorded and Unrecorded Histories, he was receiving information about a particular veiled Record known as...the Veil of Arcadia!

[Two Entities, distinguished as the Primogenitor of Steel and Curagulus, have called for a meeting of the prominent Entities within the Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity in response to the weaving of your existence.]
[Prominent entities gather within the Veil of Arcadia, intent on seeing which paths will open up with the changes brought about by your advent.]

The scene within his mind burned as he could truly see the hidden domain known as the Veil of Arcadia crystal clear, along with the powerful auras continuing to appear within it as a meeting held because of his actions was about to take place!

[Whispers of those they call the Ones Above Extremity cloud their hearts and minds as they seek for direction, and at the same time, these very same beings want to ensure that no more anomalies appear within those they refer to as Seeds.

Thus, the weavings of this meeting are not those of the native Primogenitors of Vacuous and Vitalis alone, but also the ones they refer to as the Ones Above Extremity who are bound to present themselves.]
They weren't alone.

Powerful entities like the Extremity of Steel and Curagulus were watching as many powerful Entities gathered, and yet amongst them, those they referred to as the Ones Above Extremity were bound to appear to ensure that they retained their identities as perfect Seeds without any corruption!
Noah...was this corruption.
The fact that he veered off track and created an Existential Extremity Authority was against the wishes of the...
The...
The eyes of the Weaver of Extremity turned cold.
[What are you all?]
A blazing vermillion colored light covered him as he asked the uncountable weavings he was connected to on just what the identity of the Undefined Existences was.
He didn't know it before, nor could he find out about it easily as his gaze was obscured.
But now, he was the Weaver of Extremity.
And the musings of Records, Existence, and Extremity spoke to him with utter ease as he was still only in his infancy!

chapters.title: Chapter 2872 The Weaver of Extremity! II
paragraphs: 2872 The Weaver of Extremity! II
He was only in his infancy, and even in this stage, the capabilities of the Weaver of Extremity were nothing to scoff at.
So with a commanding might, he asked about the Undefined Existences.
Those like Larseus Corvin of the Legacy of Ignatius.

And Records burned and twisted as Noah felt his Soul flare with usage and power, the flow of his Concepts of Extremity supporting him as his Existential Extremity Authorities in particular blared with brilliance!
And vermillion colored flames permeated over everything as new musings came to him.
[The Weavings of the Dikastes of Extremity flow into the soul of the Weaver.]

[Commonly referred to as Ones Above Extremity falsely, the Dikastes of Extremity appear through eons of time carrying out their administrative duties under the banners of the Legacies that oversee the growth and continued elevation of their respective Existential Extremity Authorities.]

[Their interference can be felt across eons of Recorded and Unrecorded Histories as they sift through what they consider good and bad relating to the continued elevation of their respective Existential Extremity Authorities- eliminating the bad and keeping the good as this has resulted in the closure and genocide of uncountable weavings of Records, Extremity, and Existence.]

[Possibilities of powerful weavings of Extremes had risen and fallen under the watch of the Dikastes of Extremity who answer only to those sitting at the top of their Legacies. The ones that are truly Above Extremity. The weavings of such beings have not made themselves prevalent to you currently as their Records, Extremity, and Existence are too cloudy for your current gaze.]
Powerful musings of the weavings of many things fell into the mind of the Weaver of Extremity!
The Undefined Existences were known as Dikastes of Extremity.
Dikastes.
A word that closely meant judge or executioner!
As he read about their weavings, Noah's eyes only became colder and colder as under the gazes of these beings, uncountable histories had been destroyed and burned.
Extremes that genius Entities came up with that came close to attaining the Existential Level.
Extremes of Dead Paths that may have been taken to Extremity!
All of it was lost from the Gradations of Extremity because of these beings!
As the Weaver of Extremity, Noah felt a tremendous sense of loss at the intent and Weavings of all the extremes that were snuffed out by the Dikastes of Extremity over the eons.
Of all the genius Entities that had risen and perished due to what they considered good or bad for Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities.
For all the Honored Ones that had fallen.

The Dikastes of Extremity moved within their own respective legacies as the Dikastes known as Larseus Corvin stemmed from the Legacy of Ignatius on the Vacuous side, and they were the ones that answered to some greater.
Someone, or likely multiple entities who truly were Above Extremity.
As the emotions of the Weaver burned, more information flowed into him as his understanding reached fantastical levels.

[The Authority of the Dikastes of Extremity is a unique one as in addition to standing at the Ninth Gradation of Extremity, the Weavings of the Existence of each one pulses with the modified and elevated Existential Extremity Authority that grants them distinctions of Controllers who can manipulate their respective Extremes to an unfathomable level.]
[They sit both within the Gradations of Extremity, and at the same time outside of it as it is due to this that they cannot be referred to as Above Extremity.]

[Your Existence has come in contact with the weavings of both Legacies under the banner of Vitalis and Vacuous, with the Legacy of Ignatius overseeing the Vacuous Existential Extremity Authority, and the Legacy of Al-Abalem overseeing the Vitalis Existential Extremity Authority.]
HUUM!
Al-Abalem.
The moment this word arose, Noah's vision was taken across the veils of existence as a new scene bloomed over his eyes.
It was outside of his Existential Dungeon Monolith within the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
Here, over a dozen Dikastes of Extremity could be seen as above them, a massive construct with a constantly contracting and expanding balloon and sharp needle could be seen!

[Leading the currently present Dikastes of Extremity of the Legacy of Al-Abalem against the tide of your weavings is Cavalier Reylyra who earned the distinction of Cavalier from the hands of the Primogenitors of Al-Abalem themselves. She brings with her the Imbibing Needle Guard to collect traces of your Weavings to be analyzed by specialized Dikastes of Extremity who are unique in their roles- the Existential Engineers.]

[The analysis of your Extremes would have granted them headway on countering the Absolute Existential Restrictions you placed on yourself and them, but this was before you reclaimed the identity you always had as the Weaver of Extremity.]
[Currently, your weavings are under your control as even under the analysis of others, truly understanding them is far too complex unless looked at by the Primogenitors of Al-
Abalem and Ignatius themselves.]

[The weavings of all your current Existential Extremity Authorities can now be masked to radiate the likeness of any chosen Existential Extremity Authorities. For the purposes of flooding the judgment of your enemies and keeping them with the knowledge that you have only expanded two Existential Extremity Authorities, all the Existential Extremes you portrayed will carry the light of Infinity and Tyranny.]

[They will only ever remember the whispers of Quintessence and not come across it, and they will come to mock the Weaver of Extremity and state how the path he raved about the most was one he couldn't even bring to the Existential level. They will call you a Corrupted Seed and an Insurgent that is trying to rise above the level of a mere insect. But they do not know of the weaving you are beginning to put into place.]
HUUM!

[They do not know of the identity you have reclaimed through the Existential Weaving of the Protagonist, nor what you can observe and understand with such an identity now. So let them mock and degrade. Let them sit on their high pedestals of their Legacies that have remained untouched for eons, and never before have they faced the burning intent of the Weaver of Extremity himself. The intent...that may just be the sword that cleavestheir pristine Legacies.]

chapters.title: Chapter 2873 The Weaver of Extremity! III
paragraphs: A tremendous flow of information continued to come as the identity of the Weaver of Extremity was truly mighty!
The truths Noah was exposed to.
The information about himself and anything relating to him towards other Existences!
The fact that at this moment, his Existential Extremity Authorities could mimic any others.
He could even mimic...the likeness of Vitalis and Vacuous if he wished to.
Now what would such a thing mean? What wonders could he pull off with this?!

{Eons of Existences, Records, and Extremes have come and gone. Existences can be erased. Records can be burned. And Extremes can be extinguished. Throughout everything, only their weavings have remained the only signature of their being- only their weavings remain across innumerable eons.}
{As the Weaver of Extremity, what you can potentially gain access to is truly and without a doubt- unfathomable.}

The vermillion colored flames around his body were so heavy and potent that Ruination and the manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven had to back away. They seemed like a storm of uncountable weavings and wonders that Noah was unlocking one by one, with each weaving being more astounding than the last as at this time...
BOOOM!
His aura underwent a great change.
The vermillion Haki burning around him raged gorgeously as at this point in time, his pressure was no longer that of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity.
He...had taken a step forward and pierced through the demarcation between the Sixth and Seventh Gradation of Extremity as at this moment, he arrived within the Seventh Gradation!
Minutes.
Mere minutes after he attained Extremity and laid foot on the First Gradation of it.
How illustrious was his path?
How Quintessential!
And at this point in time, he tapped into a fantastical tool that continued to surprise him even now.
{Of interest to the workings of the Weaver of Extremity are the machinations of the Dikastes of Extremity of the Legacy of Ignatius.}
{Feeling the peering gaze of the Dungeon Monolith before, they had concealed their weavings as nothing could be seen. But now...}

A new scene unfolded before his eyes. The darkness that veiled the outside of the Existential Dungeon Monolith within the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains peeled away and burned as the weavings of the reality within became readily apparent in Noah's eyes!

It showed an increase in the number of Dikastes of Extremity compared to what Noah had seen before, and currently, they held seven Vacuous Hyperversal Entities before them whose expressions were a mixture of shock, disbelief, and unwillingness!

{The methods that the Dikastes of Extremity could utilize to tackle the restrictions of the Existential Dungeon Monoliths were many, but the leading figure currently overseeing the so called Corruption of the Weaver of Extremity chose a more direct path of brute force.}

{Of the Legion of Ignatius, Cavalier Tseviax chose the path of holding the main bodies of selected Entities from the Sixth to Seventh Gradation of Extremity hostage while sending their clones into the Dungeon.}
Yes.

The Extremity Clones of four Tier 6 and three Vacuous Hyperversal Entities at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity could be seen in front of their main bodies that were wrapped around tendrils of obsidian light- the Extreme of Vacuous within their own souls seemingly acting as a binding tool as they came to find they could no longer freely control it.

{This was a gentle and simple reminder to all of them that when it came to Existential Extremity Authorities that were not theirs, the Primogenitors or Controllers of such authorities could make them utterly meaningless.}
What a woeful tale.
The very extreme they depended on for most of their power...could not resist against enemies who came to impose heavy restrictions on their very being!
|Get in and utilize these Existential Devouring Daggers on the bodies of the enemies you meet. Complete your task successfully, and you may go back to your mundane and meaningless lives.|
Their intent was full of surety and power.
As if they knew in the eons to come and eons past, they would reign supreme as even this rising problem they referred to as the Insurgent...would eventually be swept under the weaving of Extremity.
Noah's mind buzzed as even more waves of information came in.

{The Dikastes of Extremity knew they were dancing along an intricate line with the methods they were utilizing, and they knew that the methodology of taking loved ones or the Main Bodies of Entities hostage would foster greater animosity and possibly push more Seeds to be corrupted in the long run.}

{In the long run. In the distant future. In their minds, they minimized the risk of their actions as they knew that this unfolding situation with a certain Insurgent...should not remain present as an issue for that long.}

{This mindset stemmed from their eons of History of erasing what they considered issues for the Vacuous and Vitalis Existential Extremity Authorities. They had never failed. And they did not think they would start to fail now.}
Noah saw the screens of seven Extremity Clones entering the Dungeon Monolith along with the Prime Devourer once more as he repeatedly viewed the last prompt.
The Dikastes of Extremity did not believe they would start to fail when they had not failed for the eons that passed!
At such a reality, Noah smiled while weaving his intent.
His intent flowed across his lineage towards the entity most closely connected to him in terms of purity.
{Show them what the Son of the Weaver of Extremity is made of.}
WAA!
His intent flowed to his son who shared his lineage with the most purity. In addition to this, he also sent his intent towards Eowyn, Katelyn, and Tiamat!
They would reinforce Ishtar and the Cimmerian Architect within as now...
{The Weaver of Extremity turns their gaze towards the unfolding weaving of chaos and valor within the Veil of Arcadia.}
Noah's eyes held a devilish light as he came to gaze at this pristine meeting where the Dikastes of Extremity were bound to interfere!

chapters.title: Chapter 2874 The Weaver of Extremity! IV
paragraphs: Noah didn't just set his eyes on the weaving of the Veil of Arcadia, but from his main body bathed in vermillion colored flames, a clone arose and disappeared as it followed the weavings of Existence and non-existence.

It crossed the Records of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity and into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, delving with a paradoxical light as along the way, the air of Tyranny and Infinity he gave off gradually changed as a white glow began to surround him!
The white glow of Vitalis.
The Weaver could project the weaving of any Extreme outwardly.

He masked his Existential Extremity Authorities and made it seem that his whole existence was bathed in and stemmed from Vitalis, and his clone followed the weavings of the unfolding reality within the layers of Records hiding towards the Veil of Arcadia.
A veiled Record where powerful entities that had lived through eons lived in- and one where Legends from the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains would come to meet!

Noah went towards this Record as while he did so, the topic of past Legends had him reflect on the past eons where the Dikastes of Extremity had eradicated Honored Ones and the records of Entities who were close to elevating Existential Concepts of Extremity.

What were the Concepts they nearly brought to the Existential level? {The Weaver of Extremity seeks to unearth the weaving of Existence and Extremes purposefully lost and eradicated in eons of passing records.}

Back to his main body, the Haki around him only became more intense as he felt like he was flipping through countless pages of absolutely nothing- and in this endless field of nothing, he was trying to hone in on something that had been erased by the Dikastes of Extremity a long time ago!
{In the era before the spurred wars between Vacuous and Vitalis, the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains held a unified rule under the banner of a being who had risen from obscurity to become the Emperor.}
{All scattered factions fell before him as he focused on a single Extreme that he understood the weavings of to a tremendous level- the Extremity of Relativity.}
Relativity! A concept Noah already grasped as it was a past Natural Law!

{Against all other extremes of this era, Relativity triumphed as through it, the great Emperor Delbert saw the vision of a reality governed by his Extreme. The Weavings of Relativity were so potent that they began to push aside Vitalis, and within seconds, a Dikastes of Extremity had appeared silently behind Emperor Delbert in his abode.}

{A spiteful light of Extinction gathered behind the Dikastes of Extremity as they stared at Emperor Delbert, their intent weaving to utter a single message before this Extreme went on to be eradicated from Records and Existence.}
|Why do you all have such an overabundance of greed? Even with the whole Vitalis Hyperversal Domains under you, you still seek for more and more...|
Greed!

The Dikastes of Extremity had actually called it greed as Noah's eyes closed with a sharp light, as if he could see the day that this risen Emperor suddenly fell without even knowing why, and everything about him disappeared soon after.
It was a detestable thing for the Dikastes of Extremity to do.
And as Noah gazed at the weavings of the lost history of Emperor Delbert...
{The weavings of Relativity as seen by Emperor Delbert become prevalent to you.}
{Plucked from eradicated Records and Existence, the Extremity of Relatively is being grasped by the Weaver of Extremity.}
The wonders that Noah could currently perform just continued!
Even though he already had the Extremity of Relativity, this same extreme under the viewpoint of an Honored One named Emperor Delbert has nearly become Existential.
Such a phenomenon may just pave the way and indicate that Relativity and the other governing Natural Laws Noah held...may indeed have the capability of attaining the ranking of Existential!
The weavings of Relativity from a long gone Honored One flowed into Noah's mind as outside of it, fundamental changes continued to bloom throughout the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
And yet all of this was just the tip of the iceberg. —
Within the Veil of Arcadia.

A long spanning ancient metropolis stretched out towards the horizon as monumental auras continued to appear towards its very center- all entities floating towards a floating circular structure that had a cloud of Vitalis gloriously shining below it, waterfalls of authority serenely washing down any falsehood.

Inside this construct, thrones were etched into a golden floor in a circular fashion as everything seemed like a grand forum for entities of different origins to gather- huge golden pillars formed from Eonic Steel and Crystals shining with a gorgeous golden light.

Whether their true forms of the Entities being seated were ancient cosmic sized wonders, whether they were lineages of Animalia, Celestia, Yog-Nyarvax, Chthonian, or any nature...they would all appear in humanity forms to be seated on these thrones!
This was the sacred meeting place at the center of the Veil of Arcadia.
The Existential Arcadian High Hall!
Here, no matter if you were of the Vacuous or Vitalis Hyperversal Domains, all were welcomed.
Here, an Existential Symposium would take place!
Within it, powerful auras could be felt by the dozens as they ranged from Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity all the way to the Seventh Gradation of Extremity.
There were even some unique areas that made one unsure where they stood on the scales of Gradations- even possibly inching into or being within the Eighth Gradation of Extremity!
On the wide doors leading into this grand forum, one Entity after another walked in as most were utilizing their Extremity Clones.
Uniquely, two entities were standing left and right by the wide golden doors, their hands calmly behind their backs as they were the Extremity of Steel and Curagulus.
Their auras were hard to ascertain as they gazed at those coming in.

At this point in time, the brows of the Primogenitor of Steel furrowed as he felt the steps of a figure whose aura he didn't recognize, turning around to see the visage of an existence adorned in a royal purple robe.

His body emanated calm waves of Vitalis that didn't particularly belong to any Gradation, with his face showing devilish handsomeness and valor as he passed through the wide golden doors while giving a nod of recognition towards the burly figure of the Primogenitor of Steel!

sentences.text: Noah didn't just set his eyes on the weaving of the Veil of Arcadia, but from his main body bathed in vermillion colored flames, a clone arose and disappeared as it followed the weavings of Existence and non-existence.

It crossed the Records of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity and into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, delving with a paradoxical light as along the way, the air of Tyranny and Infinity he gave off gradually changed as a white glow began to surround him!
The white glow of Vitalis.
The Weaver could project the weaving of any Extreme outwardly.

He masked his Existential Extremity Authorities and made it seem that his whole existence was bathed in and stemmed from Vitalis, and his clone followed the weavings of the unfolding reality within the layers of Records hiding towards the Veil of Arcadia.
A veiled Record where powerful entities that had lived through eons lived in- and one where Legends from the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains would come to meet!

Noah went towards this Record as while he did so, the topic of past Legends had him reflect on the past eons where the Dikastes of Extremity had eradicated Honored Ones and the records of Entities who were close to elevating Existential Concepts of Extremity.

What were the Concepts they nearly brought to the Existential level? {The Weaver of Extremity seeks to unearth the weaving of Existence and Extremes purposefully lost and eradicated in eons of passing records.}

Back to his main body, the Haki around him only became more intense as he felt like he was flipping through countless pages of absolutely nothing- and in this endless field of nothing, he was trying to hone in on something that had been erased by the Dikastes of Extremity a long time ago!
{In the era before the spurred wars between Vacuous and Vitalis, the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains held a unified rule under the banner of a being who had risen from obscurity to become the Emperor.}
{All scattered factions fell before him as he focused on a single Extreme that he understood the weavings of to a tremendous level- the Extremity of Relativity.}
Relativity!
A concept Noah already grasped as it was a past Natural Law!
{Against all other extremes of this era, Relativity triumphed as through it, the great Emperor Delbert saw the vision of a reality governed by his Extreme.
The Weavings of Relativity were so potent that they began to push aside Vitalis, and within seconds, a Dikastes of Extremity had appeared silently behind Emperor Delbert in his abode.}

{A spiteful light of Extinction gathered behind the Dikastes of Extremity as they stared at Emperor Delbert, their intent weaving to utter a single message before this Extreme went on to be eradicated from Records and Existence.}
|Why do you all have such an overabundance of greed?
Even with the whole Vitalis Hyperversal Domains under you, you still seek for more and more...|
Greed!

The Dikastes of Extremity had actually called it greed as Noah's eyes closed with a sharp light, as if he could see the day that this risen Emperor suddenly fell without even knowing why, and everything about him disappeared soon after.
It was a detestable thing for the Dikastes of Extremity to do.
And as Noah gazed at the weavings of the lost history of Emperor Delbert...
{The weavings of Relativity as seen by Emperor Delbert become prevalent to you.}
{Plucked from eradicated Records and Existence, the Extremity of Relatively is being grasped by the Weaver of Extremity.}
The wonders that Noah could currently perform just continued!
Even though he already had the Extremity of Relativity, this same extreme under the viewpoint of an Honored One named Emperor Delbert has nearly become Existential.
Such a phenomenon may just pave the way and indicate that Relativity and the other governing Natural Laws Noah held...may indeed have the capability of attaining the ranking of Existential!
The weavings of Relativity from a long gone Honored One flowed into Noah's mind as outside of it, fundamental changes continued to bloom throughout the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
And yet all of this was just the tip of the iceberg.
Within the Veil of Arcadia.

A long spanning ancient metropolis stretched out towards the horizon as monumental auras continued to appear towards its very center- all entities floating towards a floating circular structure that had a cloud of Vitalis gloriously shining below it, waterfalls of authority serenely washing down any falsehood.

Inside this construct, thrones were etched into a golden floor in a circular fashion as everything seemed like a grand forum for entities of different origins to gather- huge golden pillars formed from Eonic Steel and Crystals shining with a gorgeous golden light.

Whether their true forms of the Entities being seated were ancient cosmic sized wonders, whether they were lineages of Animalia, Celestia, Yog-Nyarvax, Chthonian, or any nature...they would all appear in humanity forms to be seated on these thrones!
This was the sacred meeting place at the center of the Veil of Arcadia.
The Existential Arcadian High Hall!
Here, no matter if you were of the Vacuous or Vitalis Hyperversal Domains, all were welcomed.
Here, an Existential Symposium would take place!
Within it, powerful auras could be felt by the dozens as they ranged from Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity all the way to the Seventh Gradation of Extremity.
There were even some unique areas that made one unsure where they stood on the scales of Gradations- even possibly inching into or being within the Eighth Gradation of Extremity!
On the wide doors leading into this grand forum, one Entity after another walked in as most were utilizing their Extremity Clones.
Uniquely, two entities were standing left and right by the wide golden doors, their hands calmly behind their backs as they were the Extremity of Steel and Curagulus.
Their auras were hard to ascertain as they gazed at those coming in.

At this point in time, the brows of the Primogenitor of Steel furrowed as he felt the steps of a figure whose aura he didn't recognize, turning around to see the visage of an existence adorned in a royal purple robe.

His body emanated calm waves of Vitalis that didn't particularly belong to any Gradation, with his face showing devilish handsomeness and valor as he passed through the wide golden doors while giving a nod of recognition towards the burly figure of the Primogenitor of Steel!

chapters.title: Chapter 2875 The Existential Symposium! I
paragraphs: The Primogenitor of Steel was a being involved in many things across Vacuous and Vitalis. Even though he couldn't speak with complete confidence, he could say without a doubt that there were very few beings that he didn't know or at least hear of across the Annals of Extremity!
And there were even fewer who could make it so that their standing in the Gradations of Extremity could be veiled before his eyes.
And yet today...this was the second Entity he saw that he could not recognize nor understand the power of!

There were many possibilities for this, some simply being due to his own power and there being entities who hid themselves far too deep over the eons, and other reasons being extremely complex as they would involve even more terrifying possibilities.

The first unknown entity that had passed through these doors held an unfathomable smile as he was already seated on one of the far thrones, while this entity passing by him now also held a smile...but his was filled with interminable mystery!
Receiving his nod, the intent of the Primogenitor of Steel moved.
{Friend, I don't seem to have come across you before. You are?}
His intent was a calm but powerful one, honed over eons of forging and smithing as across Extremities, who else had forged more Armaments than him?!
His Honorariums and prestige were so high that many common Extremities at the Sixth Gradation and below found it hard to look at him. This was his glory.
His honor!
Yet this being before him...
The Extremity of Steel felt his veiled Haki buzzing with confrontation as he merely returned his gaze, coming to lock onto his pupils as Steel felt like he was staring into an unfathomable abyss!
And yet, calmness buzzed on his visage as he replied simply before continuing forward.
{The Weaver.}
HUUM!
{The Weaver of Extremity.}
This entity said such astounding words as opposite Steel, even Curagulus had his eyes turn extremely sharp!
But after this being had spoken, he simply continued as he entered the Existential Arcadian High Hall and floated towards one of the circular thrones laid out.
Uniquely, the throne was directly opposite to the other unknown entity that had passed through these doors earlier!
Steel and Curagulus gazed at each other with silent contemplation as after another second, a pair of beings also walked through the door as the moment passed.
The word had been spread across the Annals of Extremity.
Vacuous and Vitalis, all prominent beings within the Fifth Gradation or higher would have heard the news!

The meeting this time was of paramount importance as from the many years since they had stepped in the Gradations of Extremity- from all the history they had perused and the observance of the disappearance and downfall of multiple Honored Ones...no entity had succeeded in doing what the most recent Honored One did.
The elevation of a concept to the Existential level as at this very moment, The Ones Above Extremity were coming in conflict with him!
It was a momentous change that had extremely important implications for all of them!
What was of paramount importance...was the final result of all of this. Would it be cemented in stone that the Ones Above Extremity were untouchable even after one attained an Existential Authority?
Would an entirely different reality play out as the most recent Honored One...would they actually be capable of touching the pristine and never before touched grandeur of the Ones Above Extremity?!
These questions had to be answered as for now, the weaving of time continued to flow as more and more entities came.
Those of the Extremity Lineages stemming from the Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
Those of the Extremity Lineages and Clans of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains!
Many, if not most of those who had received the word across the Annals of Extremity came as very few chose to sit out of such a meeting.
As the minutes passed, Curagulus gazed at the many thrones arranged in a circular formation that had gradually been filled with hundreds of Extremities far advanced in the Gradations of Extremity.
After some time, he spoke with surety.
{It is time.}
Those who intended to come had come.
Even the Primogenitor of Steel knew this, but he had a cloudy gaze as he gazed outside of the Existential Arcadian High Hall- as if he was looking for an aura that never appeared.
{That Little Sword Fanatic should be here with his people...}
There were some that the Primogenitor of Steel had expected to see that he didn't see.
But everyone made their own choices as even though he may not know, he had to move on with the meeting here!
HUUM!

The golden doors began to close behind them as Curagulus and Extremity walked towards the center of the dome like space within the Existential Arcadian High Hall, many eyes honing in on their figures as the golden visage of Curagulus spoke walked with a profound sense of confidence while speaking.
{I welcome all the lost souls, from Vitalis and Vacuous alike to my tiny domain- to my Arcadia.}
Hundreds of eyes locked over towards the two figures arriving at the golden center filled with tall golden pillars as Curagulus continued.

{The reason we're all gathered here today is a single one. You may have heard whispers of it, rumors and possibilities. But we can affirm with high certainty that for the first time in Recorded History, one of us has managed to elevate their concept to the Existential level.}
WAA!
The eyes of powerful entities across the Gradations shone with a somber light.

On the thrones, there were ancient Entities reclined with grand auras of the Sixth and Seventh Gradations of Extremity. At this moment, the aura of one of these beings blazed as a hellishly beautiful woman with long legs and fiery crimson eyes spoke sharply, her gaze moving from Curagulus and onto the Extremity of Steel!

{So why exactly call for this meeting, Steel? We all know how this goes. We all know the death and destruction to follow, and the History that will be recorded of yet another one of us being made an example of.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2876 The Existential Symposium! II
paragraphs: They knew the script!
They could foresee how it would end!

They had seen time and time again how the Ones Above Extremity were simply that- above Extremity entirely as they laid down their heel against any who went against them. The Primogenitor of Steel gazed at the distant throne housing a powerful woman at the very peak of the Seventh Gradation of Extremity.
His reply was a languid one.

{We are in this meeting because for the first time in eons, it may not end in death and destruction. The most recent Honored One has gotten further than any of us in the past, and it is foolish to think that the rest of us will not be involved and embroiled in what is already occurring. So we are here to understand just what side we should take when that time comes...}
His words caused a great commotion as the majestic entities seated across the Existential Arcadian High Hall felt their intents buzz!
Would there actually be something so significant?
From the Celestia Extremity Lineage of the Supernal Havens of Extremity, a figure of a Tier 5 Extremity similar in expression and stature akin to Emperor Shao silently listened.
On a distant throne, the Bard of Vitalis could be seen as his monkey-like figure shone with lustrous white fur, his hands holding a guitar that he strummed with a sense of loss and desolation.

In another direction, a group of Vacuous Entities led by a humanoid male in the Seventh Gradation of Extremity were quiet this time as this man...this Primogenitor of the Extremity Lineage known as the Crimson Pitohui- he began to speak.

{Your words mean an extended conflict with someone like us against the Ones Above Extremity. Your words give this most recent one a lot of credit. From what we know, he only just recently stepped into the Gradations of Extremity. Against those exceeding Extremity...do we truly need to set such high expectations that his actions against the Ones Above Extremity would devolve into a long extended conflict that would draw all of us in?}
This was a forum of discussion.
Naturally, beings could and should share their opinions and ideas!
But the more people that spoke, the more that the expression on the Primogenitor of Steel became cloudy as a sense of ire rose in his eyes.
Before any more rising clamor could continue, his body buzzed with tendrils of power that drew in all eyes as he spoke powerfully!

{The Ones Above Extremity are swift and decisive in everything they do as it is taken care of instantly. Up to this point, a foreign Existential Authority has appeared that they have not been able to erase. More of this authority is spreading as not too long ago, the words of a prophecy burned across existence- you all saw this!}
WAA!
The Prophecy!
The golden words that appeared and rang out across Vacuous and Vitalis before Undefined Existences erased everything about them!

At this moment, the Primogenitor of Steel glared at all the entities seated on their high thrones as there was still a trace of hesitation in his eyes this whole time, but at this moment..he let this hesitation go and moved forward.
He spoke the golden words he had seen above the Veil of Arcadia!
{Waters crossed with unimaginable speed.
Immeasurable extremes all brought under a single creed.
One by one, Legacies shall fall.
White and black will come under the heel of the call.
Only one Extreme will be left at the end of it all.
Unshackled lands will rise above Recorded Havens.
Annals will fall as an endless weaving awakens!}

{White and black will come under the heel of the call- this is clearly Vitalis and Vacuous! With all this capable of being done right under the nose of the Ones Above Extremity, do you all really think this will be swept under the rug like always? Can you all not assume that truly, we are witnessing a moment at the precipice of a great change that may truly alter everything?!}
His tanned visage shone gloriously as flames burned within his eyes!
But the moment he finished speaking, multiple figures rose from their thrones as another robust voice rang out.

{You speak the same words that I saw the visage of the One Above Extremity appear to erase minutes ago. Such words are dangerous as just speaking them jeopardizes our lives...I will not be a part of this forum if you all are already seeking death!}
Even though they were Extremity Clones, they knew they may be targeted by association as they were fearful of the Ones Above Extremity linking all of them together.
So they sought to make their exit quickly as they knew even in the veils of history, the eyes of the Ones Above Extremity were pervasive!
Steel saw the scene of a major cluster of Entities rising from their thrones the moment he repeated the golden words as anger rose within his heart.
{You all spend your lives traversing your extremes...do you not have any backbone-}
PA! PA! PA! PA!
His words came to a halt.
They had to.

From one of the thrones where a being remained seated, a cruel and sharp smile became etched on their face as they clapped resonantly, each clap causing trepidation in the hearts of those who heard it as their extremes began to weave with a sense of shock!
And this shock further progressed to a sense of fear when in the next moment, their souls buzzed as they understood an intent being weaved from the entity clapping.
|It's great to see that there are some Seeds who still hold common sense.|
Those who had risen up from their thrones felt a sense of trepidation as those who had remained seated felt an even grander pressure!
The expressions on Steel and Curagulus changed rapidly as they felt a shocking authority settle into not just the Existential Arcadian High Hall, but all of the Veil of Arcadia at this moment!

And from the seated throne, the humanoid figure that had spoken began to have their visage twist and distort as akin to a caterpillar emerging into a butterfly, the shell broke apart as a massive and brilliantly milky white Entity appeared!
A single eye on the face and chest.
Wide spanning butterfly like wings with serpentine eyes at their center.
And a sense of suffocation and undeniability that all those in the surroundings could feel!
Such an Entity appeared amongst their ranks as his serpentine eyes came to lock onto the Primogenitor of Steel while his intent continued to weave.
|As far as Seeds go, I actually favored you, Steel. It is...such a pity.|

chapters.title: Chapter 2877 Shattering the Veil of Mystery! I
paragraphs: His visage was a terrifying one!
Transparent milky white tendrils of light spread out around him as his wings buzzed like a million vibrating blades!
He seemed capable of moving to eradicate every being here within a second if he wished to as his serpentine eyes came to lock onto the figure of the Extremity of Steel.

|Annals will fall as an endless weaving awakens? You actually wasted your life and existence you've built up for eons to say such rubbish? You wasted your Seed of Existence that has reached the Eighth Gradations to repeat rubbish you know nothing about. Annals will fall? You know nothing of Annals to even repeat such words.|
HUUM!
His presence spread out all around as a heavy sense of oppression fell.

The major powers of the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains were clustered here in the majority, with very few obscure entities choosing not to come to this Symposium. And now, those that came...the emotions weaving within them were complex ones!
The Entities they always spoke in hushed tones about. The ones they feared in the depths of their hearts. One of such beings was actually here!
And-
RIIP!
Besides this powerful entity, space tore as immense darkness of records spilled out.
From within, a figure clad in obsidian light appeared as an Undefined Existence controlling heavy Vacuous Extremity Authority made their entry.
|Do not scare the Seeds too much, Whitehat.|

The two appeared close to each other as if they were on the same side, but their authorities could be seen buzzing and clashing as there seemed to be other distinctions present. The newly arriving Vacuous Undefined Existence looked around the Existential Arcadian High Hall as their serpentine eyes blinked while speaking.
|We do not make it a habit to appear before you all as it is not conducive to your rise across the Gradations. But special times call for special measures.|
They don't normally appear before Seeds crossing the Gradations of Extremity.
This was because to seek Extremes, one had to always have a sense of confidence and surety in their power and extreme!

If they were exposed constantly to a force that could make all their extremes and everything about them hopeless with a tap...how could they proceed with their cultivation? They would all be stunted and living in fear!
The intents around Steel and Curagulus twisted at this moment as their thoughts were unknown, but their eyes held somberness.
At the same time, Steel's eyes held a sense of firmness as they seemed to be looking around...for something.
For someone.

Yet nobody appeared as in this oppressive space, the Vitalis Undefined Existence repressed his grand demeanor after the arrival of the Vacuous Undefined Existence as he continued. |You all know very little of us, so you were confident enough to even come to this little meeting. That shows your ignorance as if you were any smarter, you would have stayed far, far away. So I shall reveal a little to correct your ignorance. You...|

His serpentine eye was locked onto Steel as he continued with a cruel smile. |You achieved the Seventh Gradation of Extremity a thousand years ago and truly began to make progress on the Weavings of Steel, coming to achieve the Eighth Gradation just a few years ago as you kept it hidden from others. But did you really think it was hidden? Did you really think you masked your power, and that is why you're still moving around safely?|

Tendrils of pristine authority pressed down all around as it felt like the weight of skies and Havens were pressing down, the words of this entity continuing as its serpentine eyes smiled with cruelty!
|No, you are only alive because we deemed that it was okay for you to continue to be so. You stayed in line. But now...|
Terrifying intents weaved as the hearts of Entities shuddered.
Steel's face remained stern and somber in the face of this being as with the gaze of all Entities here, they expected to see a horrific scene next!
But...the Undefined Existence only squinted its eyes before it moved its gaze to another being.
It seemed...their purpose here today was not indeterminate destruction as they wanted to achieve something even more nefarious.
They wanted the spread of fear.
To break down the wills of these powerful beings systematically as they let it be known they wanted and could move against Steel at any time, but they let him stew!
And a moment later, the Undefined Existence locked onto another being as they continued.

|You. So called Primogenitor of Flames. You just recently arrived at the midpoint of the Seventh Gradation of Extremity as you feel a bottleneck in your extreme that you think will stop you from going any further. Your weaving...will only ever bring you that high.|
|You. A self proclaimed...|
Its intent continued to weave out.
One after another, it locked onto the figures of the powerful Entities here and spilled out secrets known only to them as it wanted to prove a point!
|Your intents...your weavings are all so obvious and pitiful that I truly don't know how any of you can soundly sleep at night.|
At this moment, the serpentine gaze of the Undefined Existence spun opposite him and came to look upon an Entity that was sitting with a calm smile amidst all of this.
This drew the ire of the Undefined Existence as he began to read the intent of this being just like all the others.
|And you, sitting there with a smile. You are...|
The Undefined Existence paused.
Its serpentine eyes blinked.
|You are...?|
It couldn't read the weaving of this being.
What?
This change was quickly grasped by the other Undefined Existence and all entities here as all eyes came to focus on an entity seated on a throne calmly!
Steel's eyes shone with brilliance as he also gazed over at this moment.
Two Entities he couldn't see through had passed through the golden doors and into the Existential Arcadian High Hall.
One turned out to stem from the Ones Above Extremity.
Would the other possibly be...that personage?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2878 Shattering the Veil of Mystery! II
paragraphs: The thoughts in Steel's weaving were his own as the words of the Undefined Existence showed sharpness at this moment- tendrils of Vacuous Existential Authority swirling around it!
|You are...?|
It was a question that this Entity asked itself, but the emperor seated on the throne reclined on it calmly as he replied with clarity.
{I am.}
I am.
An affirmation of an identity.
But what identity exactly?
Others may not know, but the weaving of the Dikastes of Extremity was a terrifying one as they instantly understood.
|You!|
BOOM!
And their authority exploded out as they moved out instantly.
They had to!
There was no time to wonder how this being had been sitting right under their noses and they couldn't find him until now.
There was no time to wonder how they didn't get feedback from the surrounding Records and reality about this being!
What mattered the most was that he was within the sight of multiple important seeds across Vacuous and Vitalis- and they couldn't allow these Seeds to be easily corrupted by the Insurgent.
The eye on the chest of the Vitalis Dikastes of Extremity flashed as a weaving began, but the instant it did so, the visage of the smiling Emperor on the throne disappeared!
Seeing this scene, Curagulus, Steel, and the other Primogenitors were shocked as some truly wondered.
Could it be?!
Yet there didn't need to be any mystery as a regal voice rang out from all nearby records- a voice was weaved into the very surrounding reality!
{The ones you all fear and hold in such high regard, the ones you call the Ones Above Extremity...do not even exceed the Gradations of Extremity.}
HUUM!

These terrifying words echoed out as a moment later, the visage of the disappearing Emperor reappeared between the halls of the Existential Arcadian High Hall, his hands behind his back as he gazed with a majestic gaze full of rising tyranny towards the Vitalis and Vacuous Dikastes of Extremity!
The Dikastes of Extremity didn't make another move.

They confirmed the knowledge that had begun to spread on how the Insurgent could disappear the moment an intent began to weave against them as likely, he may have utilized another Absolute Existential Restriction.
Since they couldn't get through this yet until they analyzed his Existential Extremity Authorities, they would go about it another way!
The wings of the Vacuous Dikastes of Extremity flapped as its intent weaved coldly.
|Veil.|
WAA!
An existential light flashed.
And then everything in the surroundings turned dark as if it had entered a state of non-existence!
Curagulus's gaze was somber as he gazed around him, and yet couldn't see or sense anything- with even the weaving of his extremes granting no feedback!

The Bard of Vitalis grasped a guitar in his hands as he seemed to have risen from his desolate state, a light shining within his monkey-like eyes even as he was surrounded by nothingness all around him.
TING!
His fingers naturally began to run through the strings of his guitar.
It felt natural to him.
Even though the weavings of Extremity were seemingly restricted and couldn't expand even an inch away from him...
TING!
He could feel the weavings of symphony permeate through him.
And he then began a heavy and instrumental beat as he closed his eyes!
Even though all of existence seemed to be stopped around him, a bright vermillion glow cut through as the majestic voice from before continued.

{Those you call the Ones Above Extremity are known as Dikastes of Extremity. Foot soldiers of Existences that are actually Above Extremity, and the ones that have been appearing through history to eradicate Honored Ones.}
WAA!
Tendrils of Vitalis and Vacuous surged all around as they were seemingly trying to contain this voice, but it wasn't utilizing an Existential Extremity Authority to spread!
It was as if the voice was spreading across the very weavings of extremes and existence around each of them.
The voice had spoken up twice, but the third thing it said was a statement so utterly cataclysmic that once it came out, everything was bound to change.

{There is no need to fear the Dikastes of Extremity...after all, you all are the ones providing them their power. All of those traversing the Gradations across the Existential Extremity Authorities of Vitalis and Vacuous automatically increase the power of Dikastes and those behind them. Leave these concepts behind...and such beings will gradually lose their power and authority. What is there to fear then?}
BOOM!
The instant these words were uttered, the space around and existence itself seemed to splinter and crack.
Over a dozen terrifying auras blazed as the oppressive authorities of multiple Dikastes of Extremity descended!
This Existential Symposium in the Existential Arcadian High Hall included many of the powerful Seeds across Vacuous and Vitalis.
If the message of the Insurgent spreads and a number of Seeds become corrupted...the effects would be too horrid to mention!

This meeting was observed closely and meant to be one where the Dikastes showed their power and reigned in the Seeds- reminding them of what they feared as they would have to think twice about ever following the whispers of the Insurgent.
They just didn't expect for the insurgent to be able to easily evade their gazes and even speak without them being able to stop him freely!
His words followed the weavings of extremes and existence as they rang in the ears of all entities here.
In the ears of the Bard of Vitalis and Steel.
In the ears of Curagulus and all other Primogenitors!
The unknown always held a sense of mystery and power.
The less that was known about something, the more terrifying it was!
At this moment, more and more knowledge was revealed about the Dikastes of Extremity as their honorable image and unfathomable power was gradually stripped away.
It turned out that they were still within the Gradations of Extremity! It turned out that all of them were granting them the tremendous power they held!
But...what was the solution to all this?
Such a question had barely begun to rise when another set of words rained down as over a dozen Dikastes spread their authorities all around.

{If you wish to be free of the shackles of the Dikastes of Extremity and those above them...simply be ready to relinquish Vitalis and Vacuous. Just call out to me. Call out to the Weaver of Extremity.}
A heavy and unfathomable weaving unfolded.
Simple words were uttered.
And yet the weight they held...was something no entity within the Gradations of Extremity could even handle!

chapters.title: Chapter 2879 Call out to the Weaver!
paragraphs: Words that seemed so easy to say, and yet their weight was something others truly could not bear!

Under the blooming authority of multiple Dikastes of Extremity, the Extremity of Quintessence voiced out that if the most powerful entities of the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains wished to break free of the influence of the Dikastes- they simply had to call out to him.
These simple words from the perspective of the Dikastes of Extremity were akin to a single Corrupted Seed seeking to spread its corruption wantonly to other Seeds!
And yet they couldn't contain these words.
After they weaved out and struck into the hearts of all Entities here, many had complex gazes as the visage of the Extremity of Steel seemed filled with age as he sighed.
He had been looking around earlier even after the Vitalis Dikastes revealed themselves as he didn't expect the reveal to be this drastic.
To the extent that now, after what he had said...there was no going back.
So he was the first.
His extremes buzzed as with the vast majority following a certain flow, he called out.
{O Weaver.}
HUUM!
The moment the words were uttered, a paradoxical light of existence and non-existence flashed.
Amidst the swirling cluster of records, extremes, and existence, Noah himself was in the midst of a terrifying storm as prompts rose before his eyes!
{The weavings of hope and eons of extremes call out to you.}
The moment the intent of Extremity Steel flowed, he was alerted as the Weaver!
Around him, Vermillion colored light gathered en masse as just when this authority began to flow...
Infinite Log On and Log Off was activated automatically after sensing your Existence being targeted!}
{A miniscule shred(0.0005%) of the Authority of your enemy was successfully devoured!}
{You Existential Extremity Authorities are refining and purifying the foreign Existential Extremity Authority.}
{Your Understanding of the Undefined Existences has reached the Golden Perspicuous level!}

The feature of Infinite Log On and Log Off was being triggered constantly since the arrival of over a dozen Dikastes of Extremity, and it was to the extent that during the 'Log On' where Noah would return to existence again- he wasn't able to do so in the Record of the Veil of Arcadia anymore.
Because now, every single spec of surrounding intent was filled with harmful Weavings as he couldn't return here!
So he automatically teleported towards the space where new entrants were about to come into.

At the same time, the number of .0001 had changed to .0005 as his identity as the Weaver instantly increased how much authority he could devour during Log On and Log Off, and his existence benefitted all the more for it!

As his existence was refined even more on the Seventh Gradation, his identity as the Weaver moved as his burning Vermillion flames instantly locked onto the one who had called out to him, their existence becoming wrapped by the light of Paradox, Tyranny, and Infinity as they began to traverse across Records and Existence.
Away from the Vitalis Annals of Extremity and these domains themselves!
At the same time, the Existential Extremity Authority of Vitalis within none other than Extremity Steel.
It was a fantastical occurrence as while this took place...
{The weavings of hope and eons of extremes call out to you.}
{The weavings of hope and eons of extremes call out to you.}
...! Even more Entities called out to the Weaver!
But the number was nowhere near enough to how many powerful beings in the Gradations of Extremity were in the Existential Symposium.

So his weaving unfurled with glory as he let it descend in the region of the Veil of Arcadia again, this time, it was carrying images and illusory scenes of what had occurred outside of his Dungeon Monoliths.
{In Dissolution, the Dikastes of Extremity currently hold hostage those with the Primogenitor of Dust and Sword to force them to do their bidding.}

{In Anarchos, the Dikastes of Extremity hold the main bodies of the Primogenitors of Vavulcan, Tenebrosity, and many others to do their bidding in their War against me as the rest of you...may soon follow. Escape your bindings and the sword hanging over your souls...Call out to me!}
BOOM!
The weaving intent reached unfathomable levels.
Vermillion colored light spread out all around as...
{The weavings of hope and eons of extremes call out to you!}
{The weavings...!}
{The weavings...!}
Intents called out to him en masse.
There were too many, and they all did not want to live under the threat of the Ones Above Extremity!
After eons of living in mystery and fear, they sought to see another path.
They sought to see what the existence who had managed to do what other Honored Ones could not have in store!
It was a great risk for them to take as if this bid did not go according to plans, there was no returning.
The Dikastes of Extremity would not spare them!
So they had to listen to the desires of their extremes before making this choice as even though the vast majority made it...others could not take that leap.
Others...did not call out to the Weaver of Extremity.
But for those that did...
HUUM!
They moved across existence and nonexistence as Extremity Steel was the first to arrive in a domain filled with a paradoxical light.
A domain under the stretch of authority of Schrodinger's Quintessential Domain of Indeterminacy has been laid down in the surrounding Records!
WAP!
When the Extremity of Steel appeared again, he found himself in a starry space that had a massive sandy gold Aletheian Haven in the distance.
It stretched out for an indeterminate number of light years as atop it, the visage of an emperor surrounded by vermillion flames could be seen with his hands clasped behind his back!

On the dreamy gold Aletheian Haven in the distance, figures of other Entities with their extremes masked- the clones of Henry, Barbatos, Adelaide, Athena, The Cimmerian Architect, Ishtar, Sargon, Solarium, and hundreds of the clones of others could be seen floating in rows gazing towards Steel!
Steel who was surrounded by Noah's Existential Extremity Authorities that were currently burning all of Vitalis within his body.

While in this domain under the authority of Schrodinger's Quintessential Domain of Indeterminacy, their weavings were obscured from being found by others similar to when Noah laid out such a domain when he first met Ishtar and Sargon!
